name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club “Rzeszów Biega,” in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square and takes place on November 11 at 11:11. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpackie region, offering age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, bib number and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish. The participant limit is 3,000, and entrants must confirm they are fit to run by providing a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers
Participant limit of 3,000; race pack includes a T-shirt, bib number and chip
additional: Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of 30 zł. The number of race packs available on race day is limited, and the entry fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 (minors require parental or guardian consent). Participants receive race packs containing a T-shirt, bib number and chip. The course is marked every 1 km, and the event includes warm-ups and refreshment stations along the course. Wearing the organizer’s T-shirt is mandatory.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event held to celebrate National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital, with the start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, and also offers a Nordic walking category and the accompanying Independence Mile, covering 1,918 m. The main race starts in waves to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. The organizers provide a varied program and efficient race services, including convenient pre-race bib collection dates.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw certified by the PZLA
Start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue, level with Miła Street
Wave starts for the main race, with runners divided into zones according to their expected finish time
additional: The main race starts at 11:11, with wave starts divided into time zones. The Independence Mile starts at 10:00. Athletes using active wheelchairs, handbikes, and tandems start at 11:08. Race bibs can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7–10. On race day, the race office is closed, except for package collection by participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00. Participants are asked to line up at the start wearing white or red shirts to form a red-and-white flag. The route is well-known and popular, and around 20,000 people take part in the event. The event includes various running categories, including the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, the event was the largest running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with celebrations of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and places are limited, with online registration open until 6 November.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre grounds and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska
The event combines sporting competition with patriotic celebrations
Nordic walking and children’s races of up to 400 metres are also available
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event takes place on 11 November, and registration is open online until 6 November. Participants can choose from the 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 m. Traffic disruptions should be expected along the race route. Traffic disruptions along the route; start at 9:00; registration until 6 November; event at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and on Sielska, Schumana and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix. The 10 km main race attracts runners of all ages, and there are also races for children and young people. The event combines sport and recreation, with participants able to expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Poland’s independence. Photos and video footage are taken during the event for the organizers’ promotional purposes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Races for children and young people
Part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix
additional: Photos and video footage will be taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of the City of Gdynia. Registration until October 28, 2026; results, photo galleries, and information about event partners are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The starts take place in scenic coastal locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office on the day before and on race day. The course is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the route before the start.
course_highlights: The course passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on 10 November 2025 from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo, and on 11 November 2025 from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The course is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration runs from 22 September to 5 November 2025; the event takes place on routes with moderate elevation gain, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The 38th Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual one-mile race held to celebrate Independence Day in Goleniów. The event offers an opportunity to celebrate Poland’s independence together through sport, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The race takes place in Goleniów and is open to everyone, regardless of age or experience level.
course_highlights: A one-mile race
Held to celebrate Independence Day
Supports the local community and promotes physical activity
additional: The race takes place on 11 November 2026 in Goleniów and is part of the region’s Independence Day celebrations.

name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

images.alt_text: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu-ultra reitin kartta. Selkeä kuvaus reitistä.
Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva lumisessa maastossa.

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai vyks Tauragėje lapkričio 17 d., šeštadienį. Renginys prasidės 11 val. vaikų ir tėvelių 600 m bėgimu, o 11.20 val. startuos 1,8 km distanciją pasirinkę bėgikai, kurie įveiks tris 600 m trasos ratus. 12 val. startuos 6 ir 12 km distancijų dalyviai. Registracija vyksta iki lapkričio 16 d. internetu www.begimotaure.lt, o kiekvienos amžiaus grupės nugalėtojai bus apdovanoti medaliais ir prizais.

images.alt_text: Lietuvos kariai bėga snieguotu keliu su vėliavomis.
Bėgimo renginio plakatas su kariu, nurodantis datą, vietą ir atstumus.
Bėgikai bėga lauke per Lietuvos karių dienai skirtą renginį.

name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.

Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 1
description: The MKFacade Road Running Cup was run in beautiful but windy weather, with 347 runners taking part. A total of 412 people registered for the first race, 233 of whom had purchased a race pass before registration day. There were 179 late entries, which caused a little congestion, but 347 runners ultimately received a result.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is run on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through the beautiful, flat terrain of Kaarina and Piikkiö. All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

images.alt_text: Kaarinan Syysmaratonin juoksijat lähtöviivalla.  Hyvä tunnelma!

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas išsiskiria ne tik šventine nuotaika, bet ir išskirtiniais dalyviais, bėgimo šventei specialiai pasidabinusiais kalėdiniais (ir ne tik!) kostiumais. Šiemet renginio programa pasislinko taip, kad dalyviai galėtų bėgti jau sutemus, kai sostinės gatvėse atsiskleis magiška kalėdinė dvasia! Kviečiame ruošti ne tik kalėdinius kostiumus, bet ir šviečiančius akcentus, kurie pavers bėgikų būrį tikra kalėdine švytinčia magija!

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children's race. The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat juoksevat asfaltilla sateisessa päivässä, Pukinmäki Run tapahtumassa.
Pukinmäki Run reittikartta, näyttää reitin ja sen pääkohdat.

name: VC TRAIL 2026-11-21 FINALINIS ETAPAS
description: Vilnius Challenge yra unikalus multisporto renginys, vykstantis nuo 2009 metų, kuris suteikia dalyviams galimybę išbandyti savo fizines ir psichologines ribas įvairiose trasose. Renginys apima bėgimą, dviračių sportą, orientavimąsi ir specialius fizinius iššūkius, leidžiančius patirti nuotykius Vilniaus miesto ir gamtos aplinkoje. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti trasos lygį pagal savo pasirengimą - nuo mėgėjų iki ekstremalių trasų su įvairiomis kliūtimis. Vilnius Challenge skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą, komandinius santykius ir bendruomeniškumą, jungdamas sporto entuziastus ir aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo mėgėjus.
course_highlights: Trasa apima bėgimą, dviračių sportą, orientavimąsi ir fizinius iššūkius
Galimybė pasirinkti trasos lygį: mėgėjų, iššūkių ir ekstremali
Ekstremalioje trasoje laukia lipimas, šliaužimas, plaukimas ir leidimasis virvėmis
additional: Varžybų centras yra pagrindinė renginio vieta, kur vyksta registracija, startas ir finišas. Dalyviai informuojami etapais elektroniniu paštu apie programą ir svarbią informaciją. Starto laikai ir dalyvių srautų valdymas gali būti organizuojami bangomis dėl saugumo. Varžybų programa ir trasos gali būti koreguojamos dėl objektyvių priežasčių. Trail bėgimo renginys su kelių lygių trasomis, registracija būtina, renginio data - lapkričio 21, 2026

name: II Mazowiecki Bieg Jesieni
description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

The races take place in forests and urban parks, promoting physical activity outdoors. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both the local and overall standings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with permission from their guardians. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Located in Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season
additional: A season pass for the entire series in a given city is available for purchase. The entry fee on race day at the race office is 60 PLN. The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and timing chips can be collected on race day. In Warsaw, the warm-up is at 10:30 and the main race starts at 11:00. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with permission from their guardians. The main race is scheduled for November 21, 2026. Online registration is available through the CITY TRAIL website; the rules also allow registration at the race office on race day. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
Mustaschmilen Stockholm
description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Solvalla in Stockholm, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a festival on November 21. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors, and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable arena experience.

Mustaschmilen in Stockholm has three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-meter course.

description: The 13th Maków Fifteen is an annual race held in Maków Mazowiecki, taking place on November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with the start and finish located at the municipal stadium. It is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club together with local authorities. The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners
additional: Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are displayed instantly on a television at the finish and sent to runners by SMS. The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare results over the years. In the 2026/2027 season, the Poznań edition also includes races on 11 October 2026, 17 January 2027, and 21 March 2027. The series also features races for children and young people.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as an autumn highlight for trail runners. The race offers several distances, making it accessible to both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Preliminary race information and courses are published on the website, along with information about course previews ahead of the event. Organizer pages and the registration link are collected on the race website.
course_highlights: Running in Bockeboda Forest — woodland terrain near Kristianstad
Several distances: approx. 25 km (25–26.4 km), 12 km (12–12.9 km) and 5 km (5.3–5.7 km), depending on the measurement method
Course distances are listed with variations depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: the page mentions individual and group registration. The website mentions insurance and includes a registration link for a previous year’s edition (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Course previews have also been held ahead of the race, and late registration has previously been announced as available via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year’s edition is available in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF’s website and the RaceID page.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run is a relaxed Halloween-themed running event for runners of all levels. In 2025, the event takes place on October 25 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The new route winds through Kalasatama’s urban surroundings and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can take part competitively against the clock or dress up in your most outrageous Halloween costume.

images.alt_text: Helsingin Halloween-juoksussa osallistujat mime-asussa. Hauska kuva!

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: „Nike Winterized Challenge“ su Temple Social – tavo motyvacijos injekcija šaltajam sezonui. Nesustok bėgti, kai dienos trumpėja ir oras stingdo. Junkis prie Nike ir Temple Social bėgikų bendruomenės – bėkime 4 savaites, po du kartus per savaitę. Kiekvienas žingsnis skaičiuojasi – rink taškus, o Nike tave apdovanos nuolaidomis ir dovanėlėmis. Keturi iš Jūsų turės galimybę laimėti naujuosius VOMERO GORE-TEX!

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running race held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The race course winds along the trails of Tuusula Korpikylä and Sammaloja and is marked with blue-and-yellow tape and signs. The entry fee includes the trail race, chip timing, a hot soup and a drink, and access to shower facilities at the ice rink.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa asfaltilla, metsä taustalla.

name: Saulėtekio maratonas
description: Saulėtekio maratonas 2025 vyks 2025 m. gruodžio 14 d. Vilniuje, VGTU sporto komplekse, Saulėtekio al. 28. Renginyje bus siūlomos kelios distancijos: 600m „vaikų bėgimas“, 4,2 km, 12,6 km, pusmaratonis (21,1 km) ir maratonas (42,2 km). Dalyviai gali dalyvauti įvairiose amžiaus grupėse, o nugalėtojai bus apdovanojami taurėmis ir prizais. Saulėtekio maratono šūkis: YOUR ONLY LIMIT IS YOU!!!

images.alt_text: Saulėtekio maratono reklama su bėgančiu žmogumi saulėlydyje.
Bėgikai bėga gatve. Viršuje oranžinis arkos vartai. Gausybė žmonių bėga.
Vilniaus maratonas 2023. Bėgikai gatvėje, renginio vieta.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. Nemokama bėgimo treniruotė su Monika Mile vyks gruodžio 2 d. (Antradienis) 18:30 Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelėje. Treniruotės trukmė bus apie 1 valandą, o distancija – apie 5 km, lengvu tempu, orientuota į pradedančiuosius, norinčius išmokti užtikrintai bėgti miške. Dėmesys bus skiriamas technikai, pojūčiui ir saugumui miške. Būtina turėti bėgimo batelius su protektoriumi, aprangą pagal orą, lempą ant galvos ir gerą nuotaiką.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026 yra virtualus renginys, vykstantis nuo gruodžio 1 iki 24 dienos. Dalyviai kasdien gauna naują užduotį, kuri apima bėgimą, fizines, tikslumo ir kūrybines užduotis. Šis iššūkis skatina ne tik greitį, bet ir atkaklumą, kūrybiškumą bei įsitraukimą per visas 24 dienas. Dalyviai varžosi dėl Advento čempiono titulo ir gauna dalyvio krepšelį bei galimybę laimėti prizų fondą.
course_highlights: 24 dienos su 24 skirtingomis užduotimis
Fizinės, tikslumo ir kūrybinės užduotys
Virtualus bėgimo iššūkis su galimybe rinkti taškus ir varžytis
additional: Dalyvio krepšelis kiekvienam dalyviui. Prizinis fondas - 175 € (gali didėti nuo dalyvių skaičiaus). 24 dienų iššūkis su užduotimis, prizais ir registracija per Google formą

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024 – gražiausias žiemos bėgimas, pasitinkant Kalėdas ir praleidžiant laiką su įsimintiniausiomis emocijomis bei užburiančia bėgimo energija! BĖGAME 2024 gruodžio 7 d. Vilniuje. Renginys išsiskiria šventine nuotaika ir dalyviais, pasidabinusiais kalėdiniais kostiumais bei šviečiančiais akcentais. Šiemet dalyviai galės bėgti jau sutemus, kai sostinės gatvėse atsiskleis tikra žėrinti bei magiška kalėdinė dvasia.

images.alt_text: Senelis Kalėda su maišu prie eglutės.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024. Šventinis bėgimas Vilniuje.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2023 metų logotipas su kalėdiniais elementais.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: Spalio 18 d., kviečiame visus į jau 11-ąjį kartą organizuojamą pagarbos ir paramos bėgimą „In Memoriam“, skirtą šiais metais mirusių karių atminimui pagerbti. Visos bėgimo metu paaukotos lėšos bus skirtos mirusių Lietuvos karių šeimų paramai. Dvi čempionato distancijos dedikuotos Lietuvos sporto legendų atminimui – Felicijos Karoblienės taurė (2000 m merginoms) ir Jono Pipynės taurė (5000 m vaikinams).

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: Kauno SK „Nemunas” 1000 m bėgimo taurės varžybos vyks 2024 m. gruodžio 14 d. Kaune. Šeštadienį 127 bėgikai rungtyniavo 1000 m distancijoje, o pirmąsias vietas užėmė Jaunimas – Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) su laiku 2:38.62 ir Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) su 3:04.08. Varžybose dalyvavo ir jauniai, jaunučiai bei vaikai, kurie taip pat pasiekė puikių rezultatų.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas lenktynėse su numeriu 49, SK Nemunas apranga.
1000 m bėgimo varžybų nugalėtojai ant pakylos.
Jauni bėgikai su medaliais ir dovanomis ant podiumo.
Dvi mergaitės po bėgimo su medaliais.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė yra Backyard ultra bėgimo varžybos, sukurtos tam, kad padėtų bėgikams kuo lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Jei dar nesate gavę DNF savo gyvenime, tai galimybė jį garbingai užsitarnauti jau čia. Nugalėtojas bus tik vienas arba viena, todėl pasiruoškite išbandymui Alytuje.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail running race taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the beginning. Participants run as many laps as they can within time limits that gradually decrease. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The race is open to all levels and ambitions, and is organised with a focus on enjoying the forest.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail course with 24 m of elevation gain per lap
A substantial hill at the beginning of the course
Running in the dark and cold weather
additional: Participants have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, with broth possibly also available. Prizes are awarded to many participants. The number of places is limited. Start at the Dalbybadet car park at 15:30. Lap times decrease gradually: 10 minutes for the first lap, then 9 minutes and 40 seconds, followed by 9 minutes and 20 seconds. Water, cola and light refreshments are available at the lap point. Places are limited; bring a headlamp.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: „Santa Fun Run“ – tai graži šiauliečių ir miesto svečių tradicija, kai bene 500 dalyvių, pasipuošusių Kalėdų senelių kostiumais, bėga Šiaulių miesto gatvėmis. Šio bėgimo tikslas kilnus – visos surinktos lėšos yra skiriamos labdarai. Dalyvių amžiaus apribojimų nėra, o simbolinę 1,3 km distanciją nesunkiai įveiks kiekvienas. Pasiekus finišą dalyvių lauks staigmena – Kalėdų senelius–bėgikus sveikins vienas garsiausių Lietuvos atlikėjų, Jovani.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: 2025 m. gruodžio 20 d. Varėnos sporto centras organizuoja Kalėdinį bėgimo renginį „Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis“. Renginys yra nemokamas, tačiau organizatoriai kviečia dalyvius, esant galimybei, prisidėti parama renginio kokybei gerinti. Jūsų palaikymas padeda mums kurti šventišką, sklandų ir įsimintiną bėgimo renginį visiems dalyviams.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: Kauno Kalėdinis bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Kaune gruodžio mėnesį. Renginys skirtas visų amžiaus grupių bėgikams, siekiant skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir bėgimo populiarumą. Varžybos vyksta Panemunės šile, o trasos yra asfaltuotos, tinkamos tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams. Po bėgimo dalyviai vaišinami kūčiukais ir arbata, o taip pat yra galimybė pasinaudoti baseino paslaugomis.
course_highlights: Trasa Panemunės šile, Kaune
Asfaltuota danga, galimas sniegas ir ledas priklausomai nuo oro sąlygų
Galimybė bėgti 1,7 km, 5 km (vienas ratas) arba 10 km (du ratai)
additional: Dalyvių numerių išdavimas varžybų dieną nuo 10:00 iki 11:40 val. Starto mokestis mokamas į Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubo sąskaitą. Po bėgimo vaišinimas kūčiukais ir arbata. Nuo 14:30 iki 15:30 val. galimybė išsimaudyti Žalgirio baseine (Karaliaus Mindaugo pr. 50, Kaunas). Registruotis galima tik savo vardu, numerio perdavimas draudžiamas. Registracija iki spalio 31 d., vardiniai numeriai dalyviams, renginio data - 2026-12-19

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...
Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: Pirmąjį žiemos šeštadienį vyks kasmetinis Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas, kuris šiemet švenčia 50-metį. Ši bėgimo šventė kvies tūkstančius dalyvių, išsiskirdama šventine nuotaika ir išskirtiniais dalyviais, pasipuošusiais kalėdiniais kostiumais. Renginio programa pasislinko, kad dalyviai galėtų bėgti sutemus, kai Panevėžio gatvėse atsiskleis magiška kalėdinė dvasia. Šiemet kviečiame ne tik ruošti kalėdinius kostiumus, bet ir šviečiančius akcentus, kurie pavers bėgikų būrį kalėdine švytinčia magija.

name: Kalėdinis bėgimas „AKTYVŪS TRAKAI 365“
location: Užutrakis Manor Estate Park, Trakai District Municipality, Lithuania

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Bėgimas į Naujus - tai kasmetinis bėgimas, kuris vyksta paskutinę metų dieną. Šis renginys suburia bėgikus ir mėgėjus, siekiančius švęsti naujų metų atėjimą aktyviai. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti skirtingas distancijas, leidžiančias kiekvienam rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį. Bėgimo maršrutas siūlo gražias miesto vietas ir unikalią atmosferą, kurią sukuria dalyviai ir žiūrovai.

images.alt_text: Didelis fejerverkas virš miesto, švenčiant Naujuosius metus.
Kalėdų eglutė su šventinėmis lemputėmis ir dekoracijomis, puikiai tinkanti Naujųjų metų šventei.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PAŽADŲ BĖGIMAS tęsiame 2018 metais pradėtą tradiciją. 2026-01-01 d. Rytas, kai ausyse dar aidi fejerverkų garsai, bėgimo metu patvirtinsite sau, jog Naujųjų metų pažadai tikrai išsipildys. Jokio varžymosi, registracijų, medalių ar prizų – tik jūs ir jūsų Naujųjų metų "PAŽADAI". Prabėgkite 10 km ir užrašykite savo tikslus, kad 2027-01-01 galėtumėte patikrinti, ar jie išsipildė. Startas vyks 2026-01-01 d. 14:00 val. Kauno santakos stadione.

images.alt_text: Bėgimas per miestą Naujųjų metų proga, daug bėgikų.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai kviečia visus klubo narius ir draugus į 1-ąjį Naujametinį RUONIŲ MARATONĄ, kuris vyks Pasvalyje. Šis maratonas yra dalis tradicinių jau 18-tų Pasvalio rajone organizuojamų ledinių maudynių. Po maratono vyks klubo narių susirinkimas, kurio metu bus apdovanoti aktyviausi klubo nariai.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Park im. Jana Kasprowicza, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year's Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 in Szczecin, by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children's races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia
The start and finish are by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: The race office is open on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30, where race numbers can be collected. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are located in the start area by the Summer Theatre. Capacity: 470 participants for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 for the Children's Races. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Nordic Walking and the Main Run each consist of two 2.5 km loops. Children's races are divided into three age-group heats, with distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. The program also includes Nordic Walking events over two 2.5 km loops and children's races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
location: Toruń city centre along the Vistula River, Toruń, Poland
description: The 5 km Road Race is one of the events at the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor, which will take place in the centre of Toruń along the Vistula River. The competition attracts masters runners from across Europe, offering a unique opportunity to compete on a scenic urban course. The route passes through charming parts of the city, providing both a sporting challenge and beautiful views. This event is an excellent opportunity to bring the athletics community together and promote physical activity among masters athletes.
course_highlights: Course in central Toruń along the Vistula River
Scenic views of the river and the city’s historic area
Flat, fast road course
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme for the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor, taking place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. It is a masters championship, meaning participants compete in older age categories. No information about entry fees or online registration is available on the website. The date listed in the materials is 7 January 2027, but it has not been officially confirmed. Do not confuse it with the 5 km race held during the European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń in 2026.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional end-of-year race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured the finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen, providing a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and ties to the club make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race information, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. Historically, the event has had changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen. Historical information and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: XIV tradicinis Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas vyks 2027 m. sausio 1 d. Startas bus Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryžoje. Tradicinė 20 km bėgimo trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, o finišas - Kauno gatvėje prie valymo įrenginių. Renginys pasižymi kalvota trasa ir žiemiškomis sąlygomis, o po bėgimo dalyviai kviečiami pasivaišinti arbata, užkandžiais bei atsiimti atminimo medalius.
course_highlights: 20 km tradicinė bėgimo trasa
Startas Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryžoje
Trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, finišas Kauno gatvėje
additional: Po bėgimo dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis ir prizais, gauna atminimo medalius bei gali pasivaišinti arbata ir užkandžiais. Trasa yra kalvota, o žiemą gali būti slidoka ir vėjuota. Trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, oras dažnai būna žiemiškas, o renginys yra populiarus tarp vietos bėgikų naujų metų pradžiai.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 yra greitas ir lygus 5K bėgimas, vyksiantis Naujųjų metų dieną, sausio 1 d. 2026 m., 10.15 val. Galway miesto centre. Maršrutas veda per miesto centrą, pradedant nuo Claddagh, per Wolfe Tone tiltą, Merchants Road ir Docks, grįžtant į Grattan Road ir Prom, kol greitai finišuojama South Park, prie Nimmos Pier. Šis maršrutas praeina pro daugumą žymiausių miesto lankytinų vietų. Varžybos yra AAI sertifikuotos.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 kviečia pradėti naujus metus energingai ir aktyviai. Tai puiki proga įgyvendinti Naujųjų metų pažadus bėgant kartu su entuziastingų bėgikų minia. Renginys garantuoja gerą nuotaiką, šypsenas ir smagų startą į metus Kaune.
course_highlights: Distancijos: 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km
Apšilimas visų distancijų dalyviams
Bėgimas Kauno miesto trasomis
additional: Dalyvių krepšelių išdavimas ir apdovanojimai numatyti renginio programoje. Renginio metu bus oficialus atidarymas ir apšilimas visų distancijų dalyviams. Renginys vyksta Kaune, organizuoja VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distancijos: 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km; renginys vyks Kaune; organizatorius siūlo šventišką startą ir bendruomenės dvasią.

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainių sporto centras organizuoja LBT 1 – Naujametinį bėgimą „KĖDAINIAI 2025“, kuris vyks sausio 5 d. 12:00 val. Kėdainių miesto centrinio stadiono (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.) teritorijoje. Bėgimo distancijos apima 400 m vaikų bėgimą, 4 km ir 8,5 km trasas.

Bėgimo lenktynės Kėdainiuose, startas. Sportininkai bėga stadione.
Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas, kur vyks bėgimo varžybos.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
description: The Three Kings Run is the first stage of the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on the beach in Brzeźno. Participants can take part in a 6 km cross-country run or 6 km Nordic walking. The event is open to various age and gender categories and also features a three-person team competition, with at least one woman on each team. The participant limit is 500, and the run is scheduled to start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course is 100% on the beach
6 km cross-country run and Nordic walking
Three-person teams may enter, with at least one woman on each team
additional: Race office opens at 07:30. Nordic walking starts at 10:00. Winners’ awards ceremony at 11:30. The participant limit is 500. Three-person teams (including at least one woman) can register at the race office. Choose between the cross-country run and Nordic walking. The limit is 500 participants. A three-person team may be entered, and it must include at least one woman.

name: Ultra CK Maraton
location: Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce, Poland
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.
course_highlights: Piekielna Pętla: 51 km ultra race with around 1,520 m of elevation gain
Czarci Oddech: 15 km race with around 422 m of elevation gain
Upiorna Trzydziestka: 30 km MTB route with around 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2026 at Hala Legionów Kielce from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 6:00. The cutoff for all distances is 18:00/18:30. Mandatory equipment for ultra-race participants: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, identification, and clothing suitable for the weather. The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the available information.

description: Backyard Ultra Warszawa - Bemowo is the first edition of a backyard-format race, held on the grounds of the Military University of Technology’s training area in Warsaw. The course is 6.706 km long, in accordance with the international backyard rules. The race lasts a maximum of 24 hours, during which runners complete successive loops. The participant limit is 80, and the winner receives cash prizes, a trophy, and gifts from partners. All participants receive a commemorative medal and certificate.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km course in accordance with the backyard rules
The race takes place on the grounds of the Military University of Technology’s training area in Warsaw
A 24-hour time limit (24 loops)
additional: The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase by the organizer. The winner receives a cash prize, a trophy, and prizes from partners. All participants receive a medal and certificate. The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase. All participants receive a medal and certificate. The registration and fee information provided relates to the October 2026 Warszawa - Bemowo edition; it does not confirm details of the edition on 9 January 2027.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest route and varied terrain create unique running conditions, allowing runners to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. This event is for everyone who wants to spend winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organisers ensure participants’ comfort by offering passes for the entire series as well as the option to take part in a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend in the Łyna River in the Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, varied terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. At the final race in the series, an awards ceremony and a campfire gathering with the Mayor of the Municipality are planned. On race day, single-race entries can be purchased at the race office. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 6 January 2027 at 23:59.

name: Viva Las Natalin
description: Viva Las Natalin is the 3rd Carnival Run, held in the picturesque forests of Natalin and attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the Mazovia region. The event takes place in a wintry setting, and participants start in colorful costumes, creating a unique, lively atmosphere. It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. Participants can take part in 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. Prizes are presented by the authorities of Wyszków Municipality. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.

The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.

Start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn at ul. Kopalniana
Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections

The pass allows one free start in another city, provided the participant registers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, with a group warm-up at 10:45. The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

The main race, approximately 10 km long, starts at 12:00. There will also be races for children and young people over various shorter distances. The start, finish and race village are located inside the hall, ensuring comfortable conditions whatever the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, and challenges and competitions will be organised for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
