Races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: 8 January 2027 in Mosina (17:00–20:00) and 10 January 2027 in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). The start, finish and race village are inside the hall. Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators will also be organised, along with the HARPAGANA challenge. The main race starts at 12:00. The event includes a collection for WOŚP.

name: Bieg do Herbacianego Domku #332
description: Tea with Tadek, or the Run to the Tea House, is a social run held in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event attracts runners who want to spend time actively outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The run is recreational and brings people together, encouraging socializing and having fun with fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Bródno Park
A social, recreational run
An atmosphere that encourages socializing and having fun
additional: The run takes place in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event is social and recreational, with no details provided about distances, start waves, or entry fees.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The 7th Żnin Insurrectionist Run is a 5 km race taking place on January 11, 2026, in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small incline and a turnaround halfway through the distance. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis court. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and has a participant limit of 200.
course_highlights: 5 km course with GPS tracking
Flat paved course with one small incline
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis court (property no. 14). The payment reference must include the runner’s first name, last name, and year of birth.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The 13th Winter Grandpa Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has restricted vehicle traffic, helping ensure participants’ safety. The time limit is 90 minutes. The event begins with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Restricted vehicle traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. Information available for the 13th edition relates to the race held on 11 January 2026; the entry fee was PLN 40 during registration and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120. It has not been confirmed whether these conditions will apply in 2027.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti Klaipėdoje yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, skirtas pagerbti žuvusius ir kovojusius už Lietuvos laisvę. Renginys suburia miesto bendruomenę ir svečius, vyksta sausio 18 dieną Klaipėdoje. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš dviejų distancijų - 8 km pagrindinės trasos ir 3 km trumposios trasos, skirtos moksleiviams, senjorams ir visiems, kuriems ilgoji trasa per sudėtinga. Startas vyksta vakare, o trasos driekiasi gražiomis miesto vietomis, įskaitant dviračių taką ir Vasaros estradą.
course_highlights: 8 km trasa driekiasi dviračių taku pro Klaipėdos Vasaros estradą, Liepojos ir H. Manto gatves
Finišas prie Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės (Liepų g. 11)
3 km trasa startuoja prie Klaipėdos Vasaros estrados, skirta moksleiviams ir senjorams
additional: Numeriai su lauko fiksavimo čipu. Numerių atsiėmimas iš anksto rekomenduojamas, kad būtų išvengta eilių renginio dieną. Numerių atsiėmimas 8 km bėgikams vyksta autobuse nuo Rotušės, 3 km bėgikams - prie Vasaros estrados. Autobusų išvykimas į starto vietas 19:00 val. Individualus apšilimas 19:45 - 19:55 val. Trasos uždarymas 21:20 val. Dalyviams suteikiamos medaliai pirmiems 900 finišavusių, renginys organizuojamas su autobusais ir bendruomenės dalyvavimu, startas Klaipėdoje Girulių radijo ir TV bokšte.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: Bėgimas „Aplink Želvos ežerą“ įvyks 2025 m. sausio 11 d. Suginčiuose (Molėtų raj.), skirtas Lietuvos laisvės gynėjų dienai atminti. Varžybos rengiamos siekiant populiarinti bėgimą Lietuvoje, kelti sportinį meistriškumą ir propaguoti sveiką bei aktyvų gyvenimo būdą. Rekomenduojame atvykti ~10:00 val., o varžybų startas – 11:00 val.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race is held in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic, attractive green surroundings
Courses suited to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held in various locations in Wielkopolska and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events. The Łódź editions also include children's races. The cited sources concern previous editions and do not confirm details of the event on January 16, 2027.

name: Dziki w Ogniu & Sztafety Ogniomistrza
location: OSP fire station, Spręcowo, Dywity, Poland
organizer: Gmina Dywity, OSP z terenu gminy Dywity i Gminne Dywickie Zrzeszenie LZS
price_range: 30-40 zł za bieg indywidualny; sztafeta bezpłatnie

description: Dziki w Ogniu & Firemaster’s Relay is a winter cross-country race held in Spręcowo, in the Dywity municipality. The approximately 6 km course runs entirely along forest roads and tracks. It is highly challenging, with numerous climbs and natural terrain obstacles. The event includes an individual race and relays for members of volunteer and state fire services (OSP/PSP). The start and finish are by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The races take place in January and are recreational and sporting in nature, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.
course_highlights: An approximately 6 km course running entirely along forest roads and tracks
A challenging cross-country course with numerous climbs and natural obstacles
Start and finish by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo
additional: Race office open from 9:00 to 10:30 by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The individual race is limited to 100 participants, with additional on-site registration available for 20 runners. Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Information about the distance, course and fees comes from the 2026 edition and may differ from the conditions for the 2027 edition. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

name: Run in Sopot - 1 etap
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata Startowa : 49 PLN lub 40 PLN z Kartą Sopocką

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Opłata Startowa : 49 PLN lub 40 PLN z Kartą Sopocką

description: Run in Sopot - Stage 1 is the first race in the #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series, taking place on January 17, 2026, on Sopot beach. It’s a unique opportunity to tackle a course on the seaside sand and experience the atmosphere of a sporting celebration in one of the most beautiful resorts on the Baltic Sea. The race series also includes further editions on the beach and a race near the Forest Opera, with participants competing for cash prizes in the overall standings. The organizers invite both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this modern, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Course on Sopot beach
A race in a seaside resort with a unique microclimate
Overall standings competition with cash prizes
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes four races: three on the beach and one near the Forest Opera. Participants compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. Sopot residents can receive a discount on the entry fee by using the Sopot Card.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race starting and finishing at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. Shorter races over 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children. The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė yra Backyard ultra tipo bėgimas, sukurtas tam, kad bėgikams būtų lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Jei dar nesate patyrę DNF savo gyvenime, tai čia turėsite galimybę garbingai jį užsitarnauti. Nugalėtojas bus tik vienas arba viena.

name: 9 Miński Bieg Biegiem dla WOŚP
description: The 9th Mińsk Biegiem dla WOŚP Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event is charitable and offers an excellent opportunity to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity through sport. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Asphalt course of moderate difficulty
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to participants’ VDOT levels. Expert support is available during preparation. The organizer encourages the use of its platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration.

name: Trail Kamieńsk
location: OSiR Góra Kamieńsk, Góra Kamieńsk, Poland
description: Trail Kamieńsk is a mountain race held on Mount Kamieńsk in central Poland, offering three distances: 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and attracts runners of varying abilities. The route passes through scenic, varied terrain, offering challenges and beautiful views. The organizers provide professional event management and support for participants along the course.
course_highlights: Mountain routes on Mount Kamieńsk, measuring 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km
Scenic views and varied terrain
Well-marked and secured routes with refreshment points
additional: The race office is located at the OSiR Kamieńsk grounds, by the lower ski-lift station. The routes are well marked and secured, with refreshment points along the course. The event takes place in winter conditions, so appropriate equipment and clothing are required. The rules require a signed statement confirming there are no medical contraindications to participation. In 2027, the minimum age is 16 for the 6 km race and 18 for the 14 km and 30 km distances. The official website lists the date as February 7, 2027, not January 17.

name: Winter Run 2027
description: Winter Run 2027 is a seaside winter run in Narva-Jõesuu, held as part of Estonia Winter Fest. The programme includes a 300 m children’s run and 3.5 km and 7 km distances. The main distances are electronically timed, and every finisher receives a medal. After the run, participants can visit the festival sauna village and attend the main concert free of charge by presenting their bib number.

name: X Ultra River Ultra Świder - zima
6 Nocny Maraton / Półmaraton
organizer: Klub Sportowy Ultra Team Łódź i Fundacja Wybiegaj Marzenia
description: The 6th Night Marathon and Half Marathon with the Ultra Team in Łagiewnicki Forest is a unique running event organized by runners for runners. The race takes place in the scenic Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, offering participants a nighttime atmosphere and a memorable running experience. It is a great opportunity to test yourself on a marathon or half-marathon course surrounded by nature. The event has become a tradition and is attracting growing interest among runners from the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łagiewnicki Forest
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
Organized by the experienced Ultra Team—runners for runners
additional: According to the available information, the participant limit is 250: 170 for the half marathon and 80 for the marathon. The program includes a race pack, a hot meal, prizes for the women's and men's overall categories, and a medal for every participant.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 3/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in the picturesque Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course is entirely natural and highly varied, featuring forest trails, uphill and downhill sections, and different surfaces such as forest floor, grass, sand, and mud. The race requires versatility and good fitness from participants, with volunteers and lead cyclists present along the course. After the race, participants can socialize over music, doughnuts, and tea, adding to the event’s friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course entirely on varied, natural forest terrain
Numerous climbs and descents, with a total elevation gain of 140 m+
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with lead cyclists and volunteers present
additional: Race packs are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Major Henryk Dobrzański, nom de guerre Hubal, at ul. Pietrasze 29. Before the start, a warm-up with a trainer and music takes place from 9:40 to 9:50. After the race, a music event and social gathering with doughnuts and tea continue until 12:00. Participants start from the start zones, where race numbers are checked by officials at 9:55. The series includes multiple races on different dates, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, comes from a running calendar; the organizer’s available pages do not yet confirm details of this edition in Grudna.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event organised under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Committee. The race covers a distance of 10 km and is a charity event, combining sporting competition with a social cause. It takes place in January, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organiser provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: On race day, 25 January 2026, the information point will be open from 10:00 to 11:30 at Plażowa Restaurant, ul. Plażo. Training sessions count from the time of registration until the race. No information is available about start waves, participant limits or additional equipment. Information about the 10th edition gives the date as 25 January 2026; the running calendar tentatively indicates 25 January 2027. Information about the course and entry fee has not been confirmed.

name: 16 Postomiński Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

name: 18 Bieg Policz się z cukrzycą
location: Łasztownia, near Stara Rzeźnia, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Szczecińska Agencja Artystyczna; Klub Biegacza Maratończyk Team Szczecin
description: The 18th Run for Diabetes Awareness is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia, near Stara Rzeźnia, and is a charity event that brings people together and promotes diabetes awareness. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łasztownia in Szczecin
The start and finish are located by Stara Rzeźnia
The race takes place in the afternoon, which helps ensure participants’ comfort
additional: The race is organized by Maratończyk Team - Klub Biegacza Szczecin. The event is charitable and brings people together. Participants can sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with race information. Information about the distance, fees, and course comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026, not from a confirmed edition scheduled for 2027. In 2026, the participant limit was 400; children’s races were also held over distances of 100 m and 500 m.

name: Gramy dla WOSP

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: do 15 stycznia 2026 - 60zł, w tym od każdego uczestnika zostanie przekazana kwota 30zł dla WOŚP

description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, partly along the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances and an 11 km run, which was shortened in 2026 due to weather conditions. The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: The running and walking rally routes pass through the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Aid stations are located in Łażyn and before the finish
additional: Race packs are handed out one hour before the start in the start area. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. Time is recorded before the railway crossing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish to the start locations (Plaża Piecki and Solec Kujawski). Hot drinks, firefighters’ pea soup and a campfire are available at the finish. A mobile bag drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Szczecin by Emerald Lake. The races take place from October to April, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. Each location has its own final standings, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and has a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and city parks
Szczecin: the race takes place by Emerald Lake
The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing the city and nature together
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. The main race starts at 11:00. The programme also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children, with distances from 200 m to 1 km. In Szczecin, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The races follow a regular schedule, and the race office remains at the same location throughout the season. In Szczecin, the 2026/2027 season races are scheduled for 18 October 2026, 15 November 2026, 10 January 2027 and 4 April 2027. The stated date of 24 January 2027 does not appear in Szczecin’s official calendar. The regulations specify an 11:00 start and allow registration online or at the race office on race day.

name: III Urodzinowy Maraton Grzegorza Pawła N...
XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: XX Indywidualny Bieg dla WOŚP
description: The 20th Individual Run for WOŚP in Radom is an annual running event organized to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. The race takes place on city routes that combine sporting competition with bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and comprehensive technical support, ensuring participants’ comfort and safety. The event is for runners of various ability levels and promotes an active lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: City route in Radom
Professional RFID electronic timekeeping
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Timekeeping and technical support are provided by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events with many years of experience. The event uses RFID technology to ensure accurate timekeeping. Results from previous editions and a complaints form are available on the website. The event is part of a broader calendar of races organized by Time-Sport.pl in the region.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź, Poland
price_range: 30–65 zł za pojedynczy bieg; 110–250 zł za cały cykl
description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country trail races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres, respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place on a loop in Modrzew Forest, offering technically challenging routes. Each stage of the series offers a cast medal and a meal for participants, and the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The event promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on the running loops
Scenic woodland with technical cross-country sections
additional: The event base is at Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Mass start with electronic timing. A cast medal and a meal are provided to every participant at each stage. A free stage is available when registering for the whole series. The overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. Parking is limited; parking near the Sanctuary of St Anthony of Padua and Blessed Father Rafał Chyliński, and by the shrine at the junction of Okólna and Wycieczkowa streets, is recommended. A medal and a meal are provided at the finish. In the 2026/2027 season, the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The date 24.01.2027 does not appear in the published schedule; the nearest scheduled stages are 17.01.2027 and 14.02.2027.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz
location: Ogród Botaniczny, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland

description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Winter Edition is a cross-country race organised by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation in Bydgoszcz. The race features beautiful, scenic routes that encourage outdoor activity in a winter setting. The organisers place particular emphasis on the cross-country nature of the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter scenery ideal for outdoor activity
additional: The race is organised by the Biegiem w Las Association. The event is a cross-country race that emphasises the scenic qualities of its locations. In summer 2026, the organisers are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. The Winter Edition page provides a participant guide and an entry form for the main distance.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up at the after-run with a hot drink and refreshments alongside other runners.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus
additional: Everyone who finishes receives a unique winter medal. Aid stations are located at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, close to the metro and bus. After the race, a warming after-run with a hot drink and refreshments is available. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding, with no refunds. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Start and finish at Stora Skuggan. Registration is open until 29 January 2027.

Renginys pritraukia tiek patyrusius bėgikus, tiek mėgėjus, siekiančius išbandyti savo ištvermę ir greitį. Tai tradicinis renginys, vykstantis kasmet, kuris skatina sportiškumą ir bendruomeniškumą.

description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a running series held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event is intimate in scale, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without the need to collect a number separately for each event. The races take place on Sundays at 10:00, offering an active way to spend the weekend amid scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. The source information relates to the 2026 edition, not a confirmed edition on 31 January 2027. In 2026, the races took place on Sundays at 10:00.

name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.
course_highlights: Running routes on a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths
Picturesque, historic Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw
Routes covered with compacted snow and sand, providing winter running conditions
additional: Starts are held over various distances: Nordic walking at 10:00; O-run from 10:30 to 12:00; running routes of 1.86 km (for children and young people up to age 15), 5.43 km, and 9 km; and a 250 m route for children up to age 7. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected in the days before the race at the Decathlon City store in Warsaw, or on event day at the Drukarz Sports Club. After the race, participants receive medals and a gift. Free pea soup (including a vegetarian option) and hot tea are available on site, but water is not provided. Parking is available in public spaces around the park; vehicles are not permitted to enter the park. Archived results confirm that the event has been held regularly from 2011 to 2026. The distances and schedule provided are for the 2026 edition; registration and fee details for 2027 are not available.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in running and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, and welcomes both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Entry is free. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must take part in at least four races or walks at the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Entry is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The league runs from October 2026 to April 2027, with several event dates. This is the 2026/2027 season series. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

description: The 6th Kurpie Winter Ultramarathon is a winter running event held in the scenic forests of the Ostrołęka Forest District, near Łęg Starościński and the Lelis Forest District. Participants can choose from four distances: 56 km, 28 km, 10 km, and 10 km Nordic Walking. The routes follow forest tracks with a few climbs, and the start and finish are at the Running Shelter. The event is well organized, with aid stations along the routes and a limited number of participants, creating an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: The routes follow forest tracks with a few climbs
Aid stations along the route: at 19, 35, and 44 km (56 km), and at 8 and 19 km (28 km)
Start and finish at the Running Shelter
additional: The participant limit is 150 paid entrants. The 56 km and 28 km routes are forest loops, with aid stations operating during specified hours. Starts are staggered: 56 km at 7:00, 28 km at 9:00, 10 km Nordic Walking at 10:00, and the 10 km run at 11:00. In the 2026 edition, aid stations along the route served hot tea and meals, and there were bonfires. The limit was 150 paid participants. Price and route information comes from the 2026 edition.

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

2 Bieg Zwycięskiego Powstania
description: The 3rd Victorious Greater Poland Uprising Run commemorates the 108th anniversary of the victory of the Greater Poland Uprising. The event takes place by Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań and offers three competitions: a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. Participants can expect a patriotic atmosphere, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the event. This sporting and historical event brings together athletes and history enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes by Lake Strzeszyńskie
A patriotic atmosphere commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising
A commemorative cast medal for every participant
additional: All events start at 11:00 (the 5 km Nordic walking event starts at 11:01). Places are limited. Participants can enjoy a hot meal after the event. The runs are scheduled to start at 11:00, and Nordic walking at 11:01. The entry fee is 75 zł until 10 January 2027, 85 zł from 11 January to 3 February, and 90 zł on race day, subject to availability. Places are limited.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
description: The Sybir Memorial Run is an annual sporting event commemorating the first mass deportation of Polish citizens to Siberia on February 10, 1940. The race takes place in two cities: Białystok and Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances in Białystok and a 5 km distance in Wrocław. The route in Białystok runs through the picturesque Turczyński Forest, with evening starts using a wave-start system. The event combines sporting competition with historical remembrance and the emotional significance of commemoration.
course_highlights: The route through Turczyński Forest in Białystok
Evening starts with a wave-start system
Winter scenery and an unobstructed running route
additional: The 10 km race uses wave starts, with starting groups based on declared finish times. Start lines close 10 minutes after the last wave starts. Participants should report 30 minutes before the start. A 50% discount is available to people born in 1961 or earlier. The 2026 edition also offered virtual participation, requiring participants to cover at least 5 km in a single run. Participants received a race package and a commemorative medal.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route through the forests and along the Łyna River near Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—crisp air and forest trails create a unique running atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to regularly check your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition and spend time outdoors. The organizers also cater to participants’ comfort by offering children’s races at various distances. The series concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend in the Łyna River
Variable forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s races take place over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, with different start times. The final race concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor. A one-off race entry can be purchased on race day at the race office. The race number included with a series pass is the same for the entire series and must be brought to every race. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 February 2027 at 23:59.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter competition consisting of a series of four runs and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event center by the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, passing through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race day in the morning.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails through the Warta River forests, along the Warta River
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops (42.6 km)
The course has a natural surface and is slippery and uneven in places, with leaves, puddles, and mud
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running-trail signs. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. Nordic Walking events over 21.3 km are also organized, along with 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event center is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car and by municipal and suburban public transport; free parking is available on site.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging, technical 21 km loop with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-supported and unstaffed, so participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event to warm up cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed if there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unstaffed race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no cut-off time. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event for participants to warm themselves between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Skis are allowed when there is snow. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice. An external race calendar lists the distance as 241.4 km; this information is not confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“
description: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“ kviečia bėgikus į tradicinį žiemos renginį Jonavos apylinkėse. Renginys vyksta dviračių takais aplink Jonavos tvenkinius, suteikdamas galimybę mėgautis žiemos gamta ir aktyviu laisvalaikiu. Tai puiki proga tiek patyrusiems, tiek pradedantiesiems bėgikams pasitikrinti savo ištvermę ir pasimėgauti bendruomeniška atmosfera. Renginys vyksta vasario mėnesį, kai žiema dar pilnai jaučiama gamtoje.
course_highlights: Bėgimas aplink Jonavos tvenkinius
Maršrutas driekiasi dviračių takais
Žiemos gamtos ir švaraus oro aplinka
additional: Renginys pritraukia dalyvius iš įvairių Lietuvos miestų, o dalyvavimas yra atviras visiems amžiaus grupėms. 2024 metų renginio dalyvių skaičius siekė 88, o trasos vaizdingos ir pritaikytos įvairaus lygio bėgikams.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz na Orientację Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore a variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The foundation also works to create courses for blind and visually impaired participants, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, experienced runners, and blind and visually impaired participants
A series of several events during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series comprises six orienteering rounds in different forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. Participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card for each completed round. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government. Available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027.

description: The Chomiczówka Run is a historic road race held in Bielany, Warsaw, with a tradition dating back to 1984. The main race is 15 km long and attracts runners from across Poland, bringing together the local community and running enthusiasts. The event also features a shorter 5 km race for the Bielany Cup. The organizers provide electronic registration and set a participant limit to ensure runners’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: 15 km main race route in Bielany
Historic connection to the first race in 1984
Additional 5 km race for the Bielany Cup
additional: Participant limit: 3,000 (1,800 for the 15 km race, 1,200 for the 5 km race). Registration is exclusively online through the datasport.pl system. Participants can pay extra for clothing and a running shirt when registering. Registration will close if the participant limit is reached. Registration at the Race Office is available from February 19–21, 2027, at different prices. The official website states that registration for the 2027 edition opens on November 9. Available materials indicate that the 44th Chomiczówka Run will take place in 2027, so the stated edition and date may be inconsistent.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
description: The Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the Gdynia Grand Prix. The races take place on urban routes accessible to different age groups and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide rules for the main race, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. The event is well organized and popular with residents and runners from the region.
course_highlights: The 1,926 m distance commemorates the year Gdynia was granted city rights
The race is held as part of the Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia
The event also includes races for children and young people
additional: In the 2026 edition, the 1,926 m race took place on Saturday, while the 10 km main race and Nordic walking were scheduled for Sunday. The schedule and fees for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Ultra River Ultra Świder
description: Ultra River Ultra Świder is a winter race along the Świder River in Mazovia, featuring three distances: 11 km, 21 km, and 47 km. The route passes through areas by three rivers: the Świder, Mienia, and Vistula, offering participants a chance to connect with nature, explore wild landscapes, and enjoy a unique atmosphere without the pressure of competition or timing. This event is for running and adventure enthusiasts who value community and the experience over results. The winter scenery gives the race a distinctive character and an added challenge.
course_highlights: The route follows three rivers: the Świder, Mienia, and Vistula
A winter race through the wild landscapes of Mazovia
No timing; the focus is on the experience and community
additional: There is no timing or competition, and registration is available on-site at the race office. The event is intimate and community-focused, emphasizing a connection with nature and shared experiences. Information about the schedule and the day's events is published on Ultra River's Facebook and Instagram. Volunteer opportunities are available at the winter race. The event takes place without timing or the pressure of competition.

name: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edycja II
location: Leśny parking w Kozłowie, Kozienicki Park Krajobrazowy, Poland
description: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edition II is a race organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association in the picturesque Kozienice Landscape Park. The event will take place on February 8, 2026, offering participants the chance to compete in races of various distances, including a 10 km run, Nordic walking, and a half marathon. This event is for outdoor enthusiasts and combines a passion for sport with the beauty of nature. The organizers invite everyone to take part and share in the excitement of competition.
course_highlights: The routes run through Kozienice Landscape Park
Available categories: 10 km run, Nordic walking, half marathon
Picturesque woodland and natural surroundings
additional: The event is scheduled for February 8, 2026, at 10:00; the start and event facilities are listed at the forest parking lot in Kozłów. This edition is part of the Dziki Cross series.

name: XIX Bieg o Puchar Bielan
location: Ulice Conrada i Pabla Nerudy, Bielany, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 19th Bielany Cup Run is an annual road race held in the Bielany district of Warsaw. Runners set off along Conrada and Pablo Neruda streets, and the organizers provide convenient facilities, including changing rooms, bag storage, and a post-race meal at the finish. The event takes place on a Sunday when shops are closed. Participants can use the parking area and access washbasins, toilets, and showers free of charge. The welcoming atmosphere suits both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Road course in the Bielany district of Warsaw
Start on Conrada Street, finish on Pablo Neruda Street
Portable toilets available at the start and finish
additional: The race office is located in Bemowo Shopping Centre at 126 Powstańców Śląskich Street. Changing rooms and bag storage are at Primary School No. 352, 6 Conrada Street, where runners can use washbasins, toilets, and showers. A post-race meal at the finish consists of soup (meat and vegetarian options), bread, and hot tea. The organizers provide bag-storage sacks, tents, benches, and tables for eating. The parking area is about 1 km from the start line. The event takes place on a Sunday when shops are closed. The race office and race-pack collection were located in Bemowo Shopping Centre. Changing rooms and bag storage were available at Primary School No. 352, 6 Conrada Street; the organizers also provided toilets, washbasins, showers, parking, and a post-race meal.

name: Zimowa Zawierucha
organizer: Klub Biegacza Warta i Atelier Sportu
description: Zimowa Zawierucha is a race organized by the Atelier Sportu Association and held in Bobrowniki. The event has a winter theme and attracts runners who enjoy competing on a 21 km course. Timing is provided using modern electronic systems to ensure accurate results. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness in winter conditions and connect with the running community.
course_highlights: 21 km course
Winter trail race in Bobrowniki
Professional timing using RFID chips
additional: Online registration closes on January 21, 2027, at 23:59. Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides phone support on race day and on business days from 8:00 to 16:00.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging, ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at SILGAN Metal Packaging’s premises at 13 Rokicka Street in Tczew. The course runs through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny; its final route will be announced two weeks before the event. The course has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, and the race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun, and the route is marked with horizontal signs every 1 km.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
Route marked with horizontal signs every 1 km
additional: The participant limit is 200 paid entrants. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The start and finish are at the premises of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. Previous editions were held in May. Price and route information is from the 2026 edition and may differ in 2027.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Walentynkowo Szwungiem przez Przyłęk
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: ARM Race Walentynki
location: Zbiornik Kępina, Zduńska Wola, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland
description: ARM RACE is an extreme obstacle race offering a sporting challenge for people who want to tackle a course packed with obstacles and do something more than an ordinary run. The event offers a variety of formats, from classic 5 km and 10 km distances to multi-hour Selection challenges, dynamic OCR100 races, and family adventures. The starting line brings together both results-focused athletes and people new to OCR, as well as whole families, creating a unique atmosphere of competition and excitement. ARM RACE combines physical activity, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles along the course.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with around 25 and 40 obstacles, respectively
A variety of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, Selection 12H/24H, OCR100, and a family course
An approximately 1 km family course with obstacles for children and parents, with no pressure to achieve a particular result
additional: Season 2027 passes are available, covering 3 ARM RACE starts (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no extra charge) or 2 Selection starts for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. Passes can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of the Rajsport Active Association. The event offers different formats suited to participants’ ability levels, including a format in which participants choose which obstacles to tackle. Races for young competitors aged 6–13 are also available, with timing and rankings.

description: Valentine’s Day Run - Grand Prix of the Tri-City 2/3 - Run in Sopot II is a cross-country race held on the beach in Sopot, starting by the pier. Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walking. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country beach route with sea views
Start and finish by the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot. Information about the distance, fees, and schedule from the previous edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E4. Prienai

description: Trailo Kalvė S4E4 Prienai yra žiemos bekelės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Giraitiškių poilsiavietėje Prienuose. Šis etapas tradiciškai vykdavo rudenį, tačiau šį sezoną dalyviai kviečiami patikrinti trasą žiemą. Varžybos siūlo įvairaus ilgio trasas, pritaikytas skirtingo amžiaus ir patirties bėgikams, nuo vaikų iki suaugusiųjų. Renginys yra dalis Trailo Kalvės taurės, kuri apima skirtingo sudėtingumo trasas su įvairiu aukščio skirtumu.
course_highlights: Trasos ilgiai nuo 5 km iki 23 km su skirtingu aukščio sukilimu
Žiemos sezonas suteikia unikalią galimybę bėgti sniegu padengtais miško takais
Startas Giraitiškių poilsiavietėje, Prienai
additional: Varžybos vyksta be medalių, tačiau pirmą kartą sezone užsiregistravę dalyviai gauna Trailo Kalvės bėgimo juostą. Varžybos vyksta žiemos metu, todėl trasos yra snieguotos ir reikalauja specialaus pasiruošimo. Registracija vykdoma tik komandiniams dalyviams, asmeninėms įskaitoms rekomenduojami paprasti bilietai. Dalyviams siūloma registruotis komandose, renginys vyksta Giraitiškių poilsiavietėje, trasa yra žiemos sąlygomis.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: XI Oleszyce Trail Półmaraton
description: The XI Oleszyce Trail Half Marathon is a winter running event held in the picturesque forests of the Oleszyce Forest District. The 21.09 km half-marathon course follows challenging forest trails with natural obstacles and varied terrain, making it a true test for participants. The event is organised by the Czas na Las Association, which has promoted sport, recreation and environmental protection for years. Alongside the race, there is a Nordic Walking event of approximately 9 km, and all participants receive race packs and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of the Oleszyce Forest District, with natural obstacles and challenging terrain
Passes through the historic grounds of the former village of Miłków, including a replica cottage and the Miłkowskie Ponds
The winter setting and forest trails create a distinctive atmosphere and a challenge for runners
additional: Participants receive race packs and medals. The Nordic Walking route is approximately 8.92 km and calls for maintaining rhythm and technique on slippery sections. The event is organised in close cooperation with the Oleszyce Forest District and local authorities. The forest trails are available to athletes throughout the year as a natural training space. The date of 15 February 2027 is marked as tentative in the running calendar; available sources do not confirm 14 February 2027.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ yra išskirtinis bėgimo renginys Mažeikiuose, skirtas paminėti Vasario 16-ąją - Lietuvos valstybės atkūrimo dieną. Renginys skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą, bendrystę ir laisvės šventimą. Dalyviai kviečiami prisijungti prie šios tradicinės šventės ir bėgti kartu už laisvę.
course_highlights: 10 km bėgimas plentu
Renginys vyksta Mažeikiuose
Skirtas Vasario 16-osios paminėjimui
additional: Rekomenduojama visiems bėgantiems 200 m į startą rinktis 11:35 val. Renginyje dalyvauja įvairaus amžiaus grupės, registracija vyksta M. Račkausko gimnazijoje, o dalyviams suteikiami medaliai.

name: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“, skirtas Lietuvos Valstybės atkūrimo dienai
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“ skirtas Lietuvos valstybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti ir vyksta Ukmergėje. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, kuriame dalyvauja bėgimo mėgėjai iš visos Lietuvos, siekiant skatinti pilietiškumą, aktyvų laisvalaikį ir bėgimo sportą. Varžybos apima 11,6 km distanciją su startu Pabaiske ir 3 km distanciją mokiniams Ukmergės hipodrome. Po finišo dalyviai apdovanojami medaliais, o renginys baigiasi prizininkų apdovanojimu ir arbatos vaišėmis.
course_highlights: 11,6 km distancija su startu Pabaiske
3 km distancija mokiniams Ukmergės hipodrome
Finišas Ukmergės sporto centro stadione
additional: Numerių išdavimas vyksta Ukmergės sporto centro stadiono sporto salėje nuo 9:30 iki 11:00. Išvykimas autobusu į Pabaiską 11:15. Po finišo visi dalyviai gauna atminimo medalius, apdovanojami jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai. Bėgimo prizininkai apdovanojami taurėmis ir medaliais. Visų dalyvių atsakomybę už sveikatos būklę prisiima patys arba juos lydintys asmenys. Renginio metu taip pat vyksta koncertai, parodos ir kiti kultūros renginiai Ukmergės mieste, o dalyvių skaičius siekia apie 120 bėgikų.

name: Bieg Wyzwolenia
organizer: Miejsko-Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Choroszczy oraz Burmistrz Choroszczy
description: The Municipal and Communal Centre of Culture and Sport in Choroszcz and the Mayor of Choroszcz invite you to the Run marking the 107th anniversary of the Liberation of Choroszcz, an important sporting and promotional event for the town. The programme includes a 10 km Main Run to determine the top runners, as well as an inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking event for seniors, families with children and anyone else who wishes to take part. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and social integration. The run and walk start at 12:00 on 21 February at 11 Listopada Market Square in Choroszcz. After the competition, participants are invited to light candles together at the Monument to Independence.
course_highlights: 10 km Main Run on a certified course
Inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking event for families and seniors
Start and finish at 11 Listopada Market Square in Choroszcz
additional: A group warm-up led by a fitness instructor will take place before the start. After the run and walk, participants are expected to light candles in the colours of the Choroszcz flag at the Monument to Independence. Entry fees may be paid only by online bank transfer or in cash on race day, if places are still available. The Main Run course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The available information relates to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or fees for 2027. The previous edition also included an inclusive Nordic walking event.

name: Klajoklio maratonas #25: Kūjagalviai
description: Maratonas KLAJOKLIS yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys Lietuvoje, vykstantis įvairiose vietovėse nuo 2020 metų. Šis renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus į unikalius maratonus, kuriuose galima patirti skirtingas gamtos ir miesto aplinkas. Kiekvienais metais maratonas vyksta skirtingose Lietuvos vietose, o 2027 metų 25-asis maratonas vyks Kūjagalviuose. Renginys yra skirtas tiek patyrusiems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams, siekiantiems išbandyti savo ištvermę ir mėgautis bėgimu gamtoje.

Each race is approximately 7.8 km long and attracts runners who enjoy outdoor activity in scenic surroundings. The participant limit is 135, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The event is organized by Podlaskie Centrum Biegowe Pędziwiatr and takes place on various dates from November to March.
course_highlights: Race and walk distance: 7.83 km
Cross-country course in Białystok
Participant limit: 135
