The entry fee is 30 PLN for the first registration period, 35 PLN for the second period and on the day. The cross-country course is 7.83 km long. The event is organized by Podlaskie Centrum Biegowe Pędziwiatr. Cross-country running and Nordic walking; participant limit of 135; registration from 23 February to 14 March 2026.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses
additional: The event is part of the Puck Running Triad and the STONE TRI & RUN series. Enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere, with prizes and additional attractions such as massages and refreshments. This event is for runners of all abilities.

name: 46 Półmaraton Wiązowski
description: The 46th Wiązowna Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race held in Wiązowna. In 2027, the event will take place in a new, two-day format, with children’s and youth races on Saturday and the main half marathon and accompanying Wiązowna Five on Sunday. It opens the running season and attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The organizers foster a family-friendly atmosphere and a sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Wiązowna Five — a 5 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 2,000 m
additional: The 47th Wiązowna Half Marathon will take place in a new, two-day format: Saturday is for children’s and youth races, while Sunday is for the half marathon and the Wiązowna Five. Youth race distances range from 200 to 2,000 m, and the Little Gnomes race is approximately 100 m. The event is supported by partners including Decathlon and Majaland by Episodia. The available information concerns the 46th edition in 2026; the stated date of 21 February 2027 does not match the official schedule for the 47th edition, which is planned for 28 February 2027.

name: Bieg Zimowy Jarocin
location: Forest near the intersection of al. Niepodległości and ul. Przemysłowej, Jarocin, Poland
description: The Jarocin Winter Run is a unique race of approximately 8 km, held in a picturesque forest in Jarocin. Runners start at 15-second intervals, ensuring safety and an exciting race against the clock. The course is a fast, marked forest loop, ideal for fans of winter running and woodland scenery. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. The participant limit is 300, and the race is open to everyone who enjoys physical activity.
course_highlights: Approx. 8 km fast, marked forest loop
Starts at 15-second intervals — an individual race against the clock
The course winds among snow-covered trees in Jarocin’s picturesque forest
additional: Participant limit: 300. Course time limit: 90 minutes. The race office and Finisher Zone, where a hot recovery meal is served, are open from 11:30 to 15:00 at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Participant limit: 300; time limit: 90 minutes. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, water, and a recovery meal. The race office is located at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Available sources give the date as 28 February 2027, not 21 February.

description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.
course_highlights: A route approximately 3.3 km long along the paths of Marcelin Forest
100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run of Poland’s Marriage to the Sea is a historic race connecting the two Józef Haller monuments in Władysławowo and Puck, inspired by events from 1920. The race route runs from Władysławowo to Puck and opens the Puck Running Triad. STONE TRI & RUN has taken over the organization of the race, bringing it new energy while continuing the tradition of this iconic event. Participants can expect a clearly marked route, a route map, and organizational support during the event.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
A race connecting two Józef Haller monuments
Opens the Puck Running Triad
additional: A personal race guide is available, featuring the current route, a map, rules, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. The 2026 edition also offered an 11.5 km Nordic Walking event. The information provided about the distance and organization refers to the previous edition.

name: Poznań Malta #62
description: Poznań Malta is a recurring running event organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, held in the picturesque area around Lake Malta in Poznań. The event brings together runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time outdoors. The route runs along the lake, providing beautiful views and comfortable conditions for both competition and recreation. It is a great opportunity to connect the local running community and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Malta
Picturesque views of the lake and greenery
Friendly atmosphere for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts
additional: The event is organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, a group that holds regular running and Nordic walking meetups in Poznań. The event is recurring and community-oriented, promoting physical activity and having fun.

name: 11 Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: ul. Droga Leśna - Przylesie, Oborniki, Poland
description: The 11th Captain Witold Pilecki Memorial Run for the Cursed Soldiers is an annual running event held in Oborniki. Runners start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street and run a loop of approximately 2 km, which they can complete as many times as they like, with a minimum of two loops. The race lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The event combines athletic competition with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers.
course_highlights: Start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street
Approximately 2 km loop with a turnaround on Juliana Kubiaka Street
1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the end
additional: Runners may complete as many loops as they like, with a minimum of two. The race has a time limit of 1.5 hours. A fire siren signals the end of the race. In the previous edition, the time limit was 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signaled its end. The date of the 2027 edition is given as approximate.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held on different dates and at different locations in Biskupiec and the surrounding area. The races cover distances from approximately 2 km to 10 km, with routes through scenic areas by Lake Dadaj and Lake Kraksy, as well as the Municipal Park. Each race is electronically timed, and the overall standings are based on gun times. The organizers set a participant limit and offer registration both online and on race day. The event is open to individual runners and relay teams, and the courses are clearly marked and lit.
course_highlights: The Mors Run course is approximately 10 km, on asphalt and cobblestones
The Morning Run is approximately 5 km around Lake Kraksy Małe and the allotment gardens
The Night Run is approximately 8 km along paths, cycling routes, and through the Municipal Park
additional: Each race has a participant limit of 200. The race office is open on race day from 1 to 1.5 hours before the start. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. Bibs must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Courses are marked every 1 km and have hydration points. The Midday Run is an individual race over approximately 5 km. The Night Run starts at 19:53 and lasts about an hour.

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

name: Mistrzowski Bieg
location: Park przy ulicy Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The Mistrzowski Run in Toruń is a recreational family run held in the park on Bema Street. Participants compete over 800 metres for the youngest runners and 4 kilometres for older participants. Every participant receives a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The event promotes physical activity and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park on Bema Street
Two distances: 800 m for children and 4 km for adults
Commemorative T-shirts and medals for participants
additional: Every participant receives a T-shirt and a commemorative medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The run is a family-friendly recreational event held in the city park. Participants receive a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in picturesque forests and urban parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a regular, well-established route. The races are open to anyone aged 16 and over and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a recurring race series.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season across 7 locations. Four races are scheduled in Bydgoszcz: November 7, 2026; December 12, 2026; January 23, 2027; and March 6, 2027. During the 2026/2027 season, the Bydgoszcz races take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Participant Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the event offers two distances: 1,963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, giving participants the opportunity to honor the soldiers’ memory while running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1,963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers and their historical legacy
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. The start and finish are in Zalesie, near Ryki. Information about the 2027 edition in Zalesie, including local distances and registration, has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 3, Kamieńsk, Poland
organizer: Gmina Kamieńsk i Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Kamieńsk
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and patriotic event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held in Kamieńsk. The route starts at the Municipal Stadium at 3 Sportowa Street. The event brings families together and offers an opportunity to pay tribute to KWP soldiers who fought for Poland’s independence. Before the 14:30 start of the ceremony, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc. The race is scheduled to start at 15:00.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kamieńsk
Patriotic run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers
Pre-race ceremony at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants. The event is organized jointly with the Aktywni Kamieńsk Association. At 14:30, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument before the race. The organizer’s information concerns the 2026 edition, so the program, registration, and route details for February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed. In 2026, the race was scheduled to start at 15:00, preceded by a ceremony in which flowers were laid and candles were lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc.

name: Biegi Hrabiego
location: Kosina, Łańcut County, Podkarpackie Voivodeship, Poland
description: Biegi Hrabiego is a series of mountain races held in the scenic surroundings of Kosina and Łańcut. Participants can choose from distances ranging from 10 km to over 70 km, running along well-marked hiking trails with numerous aid stations. The courses feature varied elevation and beautiful views, and the organizers provide transport to the start and professional timing. The event is for runners seeking adventure and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The courses follow well-marked hiking trails
Beautiful views and varied elevation, from approximately 290 m to 664 m
Several aid stations along the route with food in sealed packaging
additional: Participants are transported by bus from the MOSiR parking lot to the start of each race. Mandatory equipment includes a race number, timing chip, charged phone with the coordinator’s number, a cup or bottle for drinks (no disposable cups are provided at aid stations), a bottle or soft flask with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and an NRC emergency blanket. The participant limit for most distances is 140. Time limits depend on the distance—for example, 4 hours for 20 km, 6 hours for 35 km, and 8 hours for 50 km. Bus transport to the start is organized for the Mały Panicz race; participants should bring their own cup or bottle. This information applies to the 10 km distance.

name: I Uliczny Bieg i Marsz Pamięci Żołnierzy...
Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new race series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timing, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is an event for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful views of coastal Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone is available with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala is held at Seaside Park Hotel* and includes a quiz and prizes. Full sanitary facilities are provided: bag drop, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special accommodation discounts at Seaside Park Hotel* are available during the event. The organizers promise professional timing, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel. Available sources describe the 2026 edition and do not confirm a race on the stated date of February 28, 2027.

name: Sielska Piątka
description: Sielska Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin. The event is part of the wide range of running events organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and social integration through sport. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the Lublin Village Museum, allowing participants to enjoy both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all abilities to test themselves and experience the spirit of the running community.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
The course runs through the grounds of the Lublin Village Museum
Picturesque, peaceful surroundings ideal for recreation
additional: The race is organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which has promoted physical culture and the development of sport in the Lublin region since 2011. Lublin is one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, and Sielska Piątka is one of many races held there. The race starts at 09:00.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka” and is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Sopot under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event takes place as part of the National Day of Remembrance of the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timing. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, attendees sing soldiers’ songs together and share food from a field kitchen, creating a unique atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka”
No timing—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal; after the run, there was group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen. Details of the edition on 28 February 2027 are not confirmed by available sources.

name: VIII Tropem Wilczym
location: Leśna Altana, Osiedle Bór, Skarżysko-Kamienna, Poland
description: The 8th Skarżysko edition of the nationwide Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual event held on the first Sunday of March in Skarżysko-Kamienna. The run pays tribute to the Cursed Soldiers and combines athletic competition with historical remembrance. Organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations, the event takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district. It is a special opportunity to honor the heroes and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna
The event combines athletic competition with a tribute to the Cursed Soldiers
An annual edition held on the first Sunday of March
additional: The Tropem Wilczym Run is organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations. The event runs from 08:30 to 13:15. The start and finish are at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna. The source describes the 8th edition as a 2026 event; details about the edition on February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed.

name: XIV Bieg Tropem Wilczym
location: MOSiR przy Parku Miejskim, ul. Parkowa, Lubartów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie we współpracy ze Stowarzyszeniem „Aktywny Lubartów” (poprzednia edycja)
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and educational event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held since 2013. Its 15th edition will take place in 2027, bringing together sport, history, and local communities across Poland and beyond. A distinctive feature of the run is the symbolic distance of 1,963 metres, referring to the year of the death of Józef Franczak, known by the alias “Lalek.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or running experience. Many locations also host additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities.
course_highlights: A symbolic 1,963-metre distance commemorating the year of Józef Franczak, known as “Lalek,” died
An event combining sport with historical education and local community involvement
Additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities in many locations
additional: The event takes place on 28 February 2027. Local organisers decide the scale of the event, additional distances, and accompanying activities. Schools hold a separate edition of the “Tropem Wilczym at School” project on 1 March 2027; it is free and intended for students. Previous editions have featured history meetings, historical reenactment groups, exhibitions, and family activities. In the previous edition, the start and finish were on Parkowa Street, by MOSiR. The local programme and registration for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on the Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km route on the Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km laps
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Manned aid stations at km 15/45 and an additional one near the finish area for the 50 km. Heated cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish through Des ti nation Snogeholm. Start and finish at Gydarps gård in Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km. Emergency blanket and mobile phone are mandatory equipment. Limited number of places.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo # 73
location: Bolechowo, Czerwonak, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night #73, is a free sporting event held in Bolechowo. It is an active gathering for the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
Located in Bolechowo
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This is the 73rd edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night gathering. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Czerwonak series. No information is available about participant limits, start waves, or fees.

name: KoKaIno nr 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny
description: KoKaIno No. 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny is a 10 km night race taking place in Częstochowa. It is a moderately challenging road course, ideal for runners looking for a challenge in a nighttime atmosphere. Participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels, allowing them to prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of Poland’s night-race calendar, attracting runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging road course
10 km night race
Held in Częstochowa, Silesian Voivodeship
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and accompanied by training instructions and expert support. The date in the available calendar is marked as tentative and listed as 6 March 2027, the day after the date given for the event.

Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 81
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: IX Chwaszczyńska 10
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. A. Mickiewicza, Chwaszczyno, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej, Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby oraz Sołectwo Chwaszczyno
description: The 9th Chwaszczyno 10 is a 10 km race and the prologue to the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event takes place in Chwaszczyno. In 2026, due to snowy conditions, the course was changed to a temporary 5 km loop with a hard surface of asphalt and jombo slabs. The event also includes shorter races for children and young people, which are free and do not require advance registration. After the main races, the winners are presented with their awards and prizes are drawn. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort by adapting the course to current conditions.
course_highlights: The 10 km race consists of two laps of a 5 km loop
Hard surface: asphalt and jombo slabs
Additional races for children and young people over 100 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The race office and bag drop open at 08:30 in the sports hall. The children’s races start by the blue inflatable arch. A post-race recovery snack is provided after the 10 km race. The winners’ presentation takes place at 12:40 in the sports hall. Prizes are drawn at 13:10; participants must be present with their race number. The entry package limit for the main races has been reached, and registration is closed. The available details concern the 2026 edition, not a confirmed 9th edition scheduled for 2027. Previous editions also included 5 km races and children’s races.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—the crisp air and forest paths create a unique atmosphere for running. It’s a great opportunity to regularly test your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. The organizers make things comfortable for participants by offering passes for the whole series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish on the beach at a bend in the Łyna River in Stawiguda municipality
Varied forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s Mini Trail!ON races over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, depending on age. Participants can buy a pass for all four races or enter a single race. Single-race entry can also be purchased at the race office on race day. At the final race, winners will be presented with awards, followed by a communal bonfire with the Mayor. Pass holders use the same race number throughout the series and must bring it to every race. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 March 2027; cold-water immersion is also planned.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn Forest Parking, Łyse Lake, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter running tournament consisting of a series of four running events and Nordic Walking walks, held on forest tracks and trails in the forests along the Warta River. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, as well as Nordic Walking walks over the half-marathon distance. This is a small-scale event for both recreational and professional athletes, featuring themed races and seasonal touches. The start and race office are located by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. The gun start for each race is at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with some paved sections and slippery surfaces depending on the weather.
The half-marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of total elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, covering 42.6 km in total.
The course is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail, and passes, among other places, a landmark oak and stream cascades.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, races and walks over 5 km and 10 km distances are also held. Each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and touches. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bicycle computers and a Garmin. The start and event centre are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00; race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. Free parking is available, and the venue can also be reached by bus.

description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race takes place on a scenic route in Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish at Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of accompanying activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of two 2.5 km loops along paths in Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish at Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green space in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: The race office is open on 7 March 2026 (10:00–18:00) at the Szczecin Philharmonic and on 8 March 2026 (09:00–10:30) at the Institute of Pedagogy of the University of Szczecin. Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old are held over 200 m and 1 km. The mini-race participant limit is 300; once the limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limited to 20 race numbers). Official race T-shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The running and Nordic walking routes follow paths through Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic walking and mini-races. The organizers announced that registration for the next edition would open on 12 December 2026 at 12:00.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races held as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, taking place in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide appeal. They are a great opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and its local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through Toruń’s Old Town Market Square
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed landmarks
additional: Children’s races are held at every edition; in March, they take place alongside the main race. Online registration for the first edition of the Trilogy is open until March 1, 2026. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional support and a friendly atmosphere. Available sources describe the edition on March 8, 2026, and do not confirm details of the event planned for March 7, 2027.

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: Tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui - Jonava“ yra Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapas, vykstantis Jonavoje. Šis renginys kviečia bėgimo mėgėjus ir profesionalus dalyvauti įvairiose distancijose, skatinant sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir sportinę dvasią. Bėgimas yra dalis Lietuvos bėgimo taurės, kuri apima keletą etapų visoje šalyje. Renginys organizuojamas VšĮ Bėgimo taurė, siekiant populiarinti bėgimą ir skatinti nuolatinį dalyvavimą varžybose.
course_highlights: Daugiau nei 1100 dalyvių iš Lietuvos ir užsienio šalių
Tradicinės distancijos: 2 km ir 15 km
Kovo 11-osios minėjimo renginiai ir koncertai
additional: Registracijas prižiūri ir dalyvio mokestį renka VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. Sumokėtas starto mokestis negrąžinamas, nebent renginys atšaukiamas. Dalyviai gali keisti distanciją ar perleisti registraciją kitam dalyviui ne vėliau nei uždaroma išankstinė registracija, už tai taikomas 10 eurų mokestis. Pirmasis bėgimo etapas prasideda 08:00 val. Renginys yra Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapas, siūlo apdovanojimus ir nuotraukų galeriją, dalyvauti kviečiami visi amžiaus grupių bėgikai.

Dalyviai kviečiami bėgti įvairiose distancijose, įskaitant vaikų 400 m trasą, kuri vyksta miesto centre prie savivaldybės. Renginys pasižymi draugiška atmosfera ir siekia suburti tiek vietinius gyventojus, tiek svečius.

Vaikų trasa - 400 m miesto centre
Dalyviai bėga su elektroniniu laiko matavimu

Renginys vyksta Šilutėje, dažnai siejamas su Lietuvos nepriklausomybės diena, dalyvių skaičius apie 500, siūlomos įvairios distancijos ir prizai.

description: The Winter Oak Run is an annual sporting event held since 2012. It attracts an ever-growing number of participants and is an important sporting event in Mogilno County. The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.
course_highlights: Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek
additional: The start and finish are by the school sports field of the School Complex in Dąbrowa, ul. Sportowa. The event includes children's races over distances from 60 m to 1,000 m and a 7.5 km Nordic walking event. Electronic timing. Awards ceremonies and prize drawings take place in the sports hall in Dąbrowa. The race office is open from 07:00; registration closes at 10:45. The start and finish are by the School Complex sports field on ul. Sportowa; the race office is in the sports hall. The race pack includes, among other things, a medal, a hot meal and an SMS with the result. Registration is open until 3 March 2027; there is no race-day registration or fee.

Tai apie 14,5 km ilgio bėgimas, skirtas bėgimo mėgėjams ir profesionalams, siekiant populiarinti bėgimą ir skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Renginys vyksta pavasarį ir yra dalis Lietuvos bėgimo taurės serijos, kuri apima įvairius bėgimus visoje Lietuvoje. Dalyviai kviečiami išbandyti savo jėgas ir mėgautis gamtos vaizdais aplink ežerą.
course_highlights: Apytiksliai 14,5 km ilgio distancija aplink Rėkyvos ežerą
Varžybos vyksta Šiauliuose, gamtos apsuptyje
Tai Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapas, skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams
additional: Sumokėtas starto mokestis negrąžinamas, nebent renginys atšaukiamas. Dalyviai gali keisti distanciją ar perleisti registraciją kitam dalyviui iki išankstinės registracijos uždarymo, mokėdami 10 eurų keitimo mokestį. Registracijų ir starto mokesčių administravimą vykdo VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. Renginys vyko 2026-03-15, tačiau planuojama data 2027-03-21; trasa nėra žymėta, dalyviai patys renkasi maršrutą, svarbi orientacija ir taktika.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland surroundings. The Szczecin course is varied and located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, by Emerald Lake, with challenging uphill and downhill sections. The event is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in woodland surroundings by Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at the edge of Kopalniana Street
Varied sections with uphills and downhills, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the 11:00 start, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. Races are held regularly during the season, from October to April. The start and finish are behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street; the race office is next door. According to the official calendar, Szczecin has no race on 14 March 2027—the Szczecin race dates for the 2026/2027 season are 18 October, 15 November, 10 January and 4 April.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie

price_range: 30–65 zł przy płatności do niedzieli poprzedzającej bieg; 40 zł dla juniorów lub 80 zł w kategorii OPEN przy dogłoszeniu
description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country mountain races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place at Primary School No. 61 in Łódź. Each participant receives a cast medal and a meal at every event, with competition in junior and OPEN categories. The series promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest, measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on running loops
Scenic woodland routes with multiple loops (two or three laps)
additional: At every event, each participant receives a cast medal and a meal. A free event is available when registering for the whole series. Four of the five events count towards the overall standings. Event wrap-ups begin at 12:35, and prize giveaways at 12:40. The race office is open from 9:30 on race day. Parking is limited near the event base; parking around the Shrine of St Anthony of Padua and other designated locations is recommended. Electronic timing from a mass start. The fifth race in the series will take place on 14 March 2027 at 11:00. Event base: Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Entry fees for the OPEN category depend on the distance: PLN 55 for 6.6 km, PLN 60 for 10.5 km and PLN 65 for 14.4 km.

name: Riešės krosas
location: Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Riešės krosas yra tradicinis kroso bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Riešės hipodrome Vilniaus rajone. Varžybų tikslas - populiarinti kroso bėgimą ir lengvąją atletiką, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą bei didinti fizinį aktyvumą. Trasos paviršius yra 100% natūralus, sudarytas iš hipodromo rato, lauko keliukų, miško takų ir žolinės dangos, todėl bėgimas yra įvairus ir kalvotas. Dalyviai skirstomi į amžiaus grupes, o finišavus visų laukia atminimo suvenyrai bei prizai amžiaus grupių nugalėtojams.
course_highlights: 100% natūrali danga: hipodromo ratas, lauko keliukai, miško takas, žolinė danga
Kalvota trasa su galimu purvu ar sniegu priklausomai nuo oro sąlygų
Skirtingi ratų skaičiai pagal amžiaus grupes ir distancijas
additional: Numerių išdavimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 09:30 iki 10:50 prie starto-finišo zonos. Varžybų programa gali keistis priklausomai nuo dalyvių skaičiaus, apie pokyčius informuojama atsiimant numerius. Dalyviai privalo patys atsakyti už savo sveikatą, o už nepilnamečius atsako tėvai ar globėjai. Visi finišavę dalyviai gauna atminimo suvenyrus, o amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai ir prizininkai apdovanojami medaliais, piniginiais ir daiktiniais prizais. Renginys vyks 2027-03-27 Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., ir yra skirtas skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą bei bendruomeniškumą.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55 !!! yra gimtadienio ultra bėgimas, skirtas pagerbti ilgamečio bėgimo puoselėtojo Vido Totilo 55-ąjį gimtadienį. Renginys vyksta Bėgimo namuose Kūjagalviuose, Kauno rajone, ir siekia populiarinti ilgus bėgimus Lietuvoje bei plėsti ilgų distancijų bėgikų bendruomenę. Trasą sudaro miško ir lauko keliukai su smėlio ruožais, o startas ir finišas yra tame pačiame taške. Dalyvauti gali visi, nepriklausomai nuo amžiaus, lyties ar tautybės, o dalyvavimas yra nemokamas.
course_highlights: Miško ir lauko keliukai
Smėlio ruožai trasoje
Startas ir finišas Bėgimo namuose Kūjagalviuose
additional: Registracija vyksta internetu ir varžybų dieną nuo 9:30 iki 10:55 val. Dalyvavimas nemokamas. Visų finišavusių laukia atminimo medaliai, apdovanojimai absoliučioje ir amžiaus grupių įskaitose. Po finišo dalyviams vaišės: karšta sriuba, užkandžiai, gėrimai, taip pat pramogos - pirtis ir kubilas. Renginys yra dalis Bėgimo namų varžybų serijos, vyksta kasmet ir pritraukia patyrusius ultrabėgikus.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: Zimowe Biegi Górskie Falenica
location: Falenica Dune, Mazowiecki Landscape Park, Warsaw, Poland
description: The Falenica Winter Mountain Runs are an annual running event held on the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park in Warsaw. Runners can choose from three distances: 3.33 km, 6.66 km, or 10 km, corresponding to one, two, or three loops with elevation gains of 85 m, 170 m, and 255 m, respectively. The race office is located at Primary School No. 124 and is open on race day from 9:00 to 10:30. The course is marked on the ground, and the races traditionally take place on Saturdays, attracting runners who enjoy winter challenges in natural, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park
Three distances available: 3.33 km (1 loop), 6.66 km (2 loops), and 10 km (3 loops)
Elevation gains range from 85 m to 255 m, depending on the distance
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 at Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47. In the event of epidemic-related restrictions, the office may operate outdoors near the start, without changing facilities. Race office: Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47; open from 9:00 to 10:30. If the school cannot be used, the race office may operate outdoors near the start.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, offering accessible road races in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are run on officially measured courses in sunny spring weather. Buying a series pass makes it easy to take part in all the events without registering separately each time. The event has a long tradition and also offers the opportunity to join running classes and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast, high-quality winter races
Races are held in sunny spring weather and attract a wide range of participants
additional: A series pass covers all five events, with no separate registration required. Race numbers must be collected from the race office and returned after each race. Changing distance is possible at the information desk up to half an hour before the start. Members of Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry can take part with a series pass at no cost once their membership fee has been paid. Exact event details and results; no direct mention of the price or any special course features.

Šis renginys suteikia unikalią galimybę bėgti kilimo - tūpimo taku, kuris yra neįprasta ir įdomi bėgimo vieta. Renginys skirtas moksleiviams, kolegijos studentams, bendruomenei ir visuomenei, skatinant aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir sportinę veiklą. Dalyviai gali mėgautis išskirtine atmosfera ir išbandyti savo jėgas šioje specialioje trasoje.
course_highlights: 3 km bėgimas kilimo - tūpimo taku
Vieta: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai
Unikali bėgimo trasa oro uosto teritorijoje

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Finalas yra finalinis etapas tradicinio Lietuvos trail bėgimo taurės sezono renginys, vykstantis Bražuolės apylinkėse. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas, pritaikytas skirtingo amžiaus ir patirties dalyviams, nuo jaunimo iki suaugusiųjų. Trasos pasižymi miškinga aplinka, su įvairaus ilgio ir sudėtingumo maršrutais, leidžiančiais patirti gamtos grožį ir iššūkius. Dalyviai startuoja Bražuolės stovyklavietėje, o renginys yra draugiškas ir atviras visiems bėgimo entuziastams.
course_highlights: Miškingos trasos Bražuolės apylinkėse
Skirtingo ilgio distancijos nuo 4.8 km iki 24.8 km
Trasos su įvairiu aukščio sukilimu ir gamtos vaizdais
additional: Startas Bražuolės stovyklavietėje. Trasos apima įvairius aukščio sukilimus nuo iki 150 m iki virš 500 m, priklausomai nuo distancijos. Renginyje dalyvauja jaunimo ir suaugusiųjų kategorijos. Renginio atributika įkvėpta miško gyvūnų, o dalis pajamų skiriama paramai globos organizacijoms. Renginyje siūlomos skirtingos distancijos, registracija vyksta internetu, o vieta - Bražuolės stovyklavietė, Pugainiai.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“ yra Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapo dalis, vykstanti Panevėžyje, Senvagės ir Kultūros ir poilsio parke. Šis renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus iš įvairių miestų, siekiant skatinti sportinį judėjimą, sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir Lietuvos regionų gamtos bei kultūros grožio pažinimą. Varžybos yra dalis ilgametės Lietuvos bėgimo taurės tradicijos, kuri nuo 2009 metų vienija bėgimo profesionalus ir mėgėjus visoje šalyje. Renginys vyksta pavasarį, suteikdamas galimybę dalyviams mėgautis gamta ir aktyvia veikla.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Senvagės ir Kultūros ir poilsio parke Panevėžyje
Tradicinis Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapas su įvairių miestų bėgikais
Skatina pažinti Lietuvos regionų gamtą ir architektūrą
additional: Registraciją prižiūri VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. Sumokėtas starto mokestis negrąžinamas, nebent renginys atšaukiamas. Dalyviai gali keisti distanciją ar perleisti registraciją kitiems ne vėliau nei uždaroma išankstinė registracija, keičiant distanciją iš brangesnės į pigesnę kainų skirtumas negrąžinamas. Dalyvio keitimo mokestis - 10 eurų. Renginys vyks Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, su galimybe registruotis internetu.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarmilen/): 2027-04-03 — "ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027" (was estimated 2027-03-27)

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen, offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km. The races are open to all runners, from elite athletes to recreational runners, and participants in the 25 km race must be at least 17 years old. The courses include both classic routes and new trails, with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful views of nature. After the race, a classic Giffa burger is included for the 10 km and 25 km races, or a hot dog in a bun for the 5 km race, along with a drink. There is no time limit, and the 25 km race is part of the Skåne Trailcup.
course_highlights: A technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Courses with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful natural views
Three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km, featuring both classic routes and new trails
additional: Showers and changing rooms are available after the race. Water and energy stations are located along the course and at the finish. The 25 km race is the first event in the Skåne Trailcup. There is no time limit; the race ends when all participants have reached the finish. Previous editions have had water and energy stations along the course and at the finish, as well as showers and changing rooms. Food and drink after the finish have been included in the entry fee.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 82
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: SpriT Frontyard - Genarp
description: SpriT Frontyard Genarp is a fast and fun trail running race at Genarpsbadet, suitable for all levels and ambitions. The course is approximately 1 km long and consists of gravel road, forest trail and sand, with no asphalt, and two small hills at the beginning. The aim is to run as many laps as you can within time limits that gradually decrease. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish, and great prizes are awarded to many participants.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel road, forest trail and sand
Two small hills at the beginning of the course
A fast course with a thrilling finish along the final straight
additional: You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish. Great prizes are awarded to many participants. Registration is binding once payment has been made. The organizer recommends insurance in case of injury or illness. The race information found applies to previous editions; the price and details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg relay race that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied gravel and asphalt surface, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, and all teams start at the same time. In the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also held, with a medal and certificate for every participant.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is provided by data chip, and both the total finish time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are also drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing, all children receive a medal, certificate, drink and fruit. The event includes a mini category for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to record total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course runs along the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches, on an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal in recognition of their achievement. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. The warm-up is led by Fitness4You before the start. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is available until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with options for company tents, registration via the website, race bib collection at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm, offering both half-marathon and 10 km distances. The race follows flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to set a personal best. The event is a celebration for all, with the start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half-marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a celebration for all, with flat courses suited to setting a personal best. There is also a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus services and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, children’s race for up to age 13

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainių sporto centras kviečia visus dalyvauti bėgime, skirtame Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti. Renginys yra bendruomeniškas ir aktyvus, skirtas skatinti sveiką gyvenseną, fizinį aktyvumą bei stiprinti bendruomenės fizinę ir protinę sveikatą. Tai puiki proga šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui ir vyresnio amžiaus žmonėms susiburti ir aktyviai praleisti laiką Kėdainiuose. Renginys yra Nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos dalis, skirta masiniams fizinio aktyvumo renginiams organizuoti.
course_highlights: Fizinio aktyvumo veiklos
Sveikatos testavimai
Bendruomenės įtraukimas
additional: Renginys skirtas visoms amžiaus grupėms - šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui ir vyresnio amžiaus gyventojams. Organizuoja Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras. Renginys yra dalis Nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos, skatinančios masinį fizinį aktyvumą. Renginys apima įvairias fizinio aktyvumo veiklas, testavimus, sporto varžybas ir paskaitas, vyks Kėdainių mieste, pagrindinė vieta - centrinis miesto stadionas.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
location: Masłów, Masłów Municipality, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.
