name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Szpęgawsk, Starogard County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
location: Kulka, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can take part in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged over 14 may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must take part in at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be under their supervision. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. All courses feature gentle, winding trails through varied woodland, with stretches alongside water. The longest course, 21 km, is part of Spring i Skåne’s Trail Cup and offers extra elevation and a scenic route. The race is open to both recreational runners and young people; the recommended minimum age for the longest distance is 17.
course_highlights: Gentle, winding trails through varied woodland
Sections alongside water along the courses
The 21 km course is a scenic route at Hovdala with extra elevation
additional: Start and finish at Hovdala Castle. Runners should arrive 10 minutes before the start. Bibs must be collected at the venue at least 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing is used. There are no shower or changing facilities, but toilets are available. Water and sports drink stations are available on all courses. The maximum number of participants is 400. Name changes are possible for a fee of 100 kr via the registration page. The race information specifies electronic timing, aid stations on all courses and a participant limit of 400. The prices and practical details apply to the published information for 2026.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Stockholm, with races for all ages. These include a Mini Race for the youngest participants, Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class through grade 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in disadvantaged suburbs through personal development using running. The day features music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children in preschool class through grade 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different age-group waves; 1.6 km Fun Run at 12:25; 5 km race at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Registration is free and open until 14 May at 17:00. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The event takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC (Tyresö Extreme Challenge) is an ultramarathon held at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö, Stockholm. The race offers several distances, including the 46 km MiniUltra, Backyard Ultra, 50 miles, 100 miles and 200 miles, on a scenic and challenging 11.5 km loop course. The start and finish are at the TEC tent beside the outdoor gym, and the race takes place over a weekend in April, with different start times for each distance. It is a tough and fun challenge for ultrarunners, with the option to change distances during the race.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop course at Alby Friluftsgård
Backyard Ultra course of approximately 6.7 km, with hourly starts
Aid station at the start/finish
additional: Start times: The 200 miles race starts Friday at 10:00, with a 54-hour time limit; Backyard Ultra starts Friday at 18:00, with hourly starts and a 46-hour time limit; the 50 and 100 miles races start Saturday at 10:00, with a 30-hour time limit; MiniUltra 46 km starts Sunday at 08:00, with an 8-hour time limit. Bibs can be collected from Friday at 08:00 at the TEC tent. Changing rooms, showers and sauna are currently unavailable due to renovation. It is not permitted to set up your own tents or aid tables at the start/finish or along the course. Runners’ bags are stored in the tent in the designated area. It is permitted to change distances during the race, but a Swedish record can only be set at the distance entered. The finish closes Sunday at 16:00. Previous editions have also included the 50 miles, 100 miles and Backyard Ultra distances. The sources do not provide information about the 2027 course or registration.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://new.tec100.se/?p=9313): 2027-04-16 — "16-18 april 2027 i Alby, Tyresö!" (was estimated 2027-04-16)

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: Tarptautinis bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“ vyks Vilniuje, Vingio parke, ir skirtas pagerbti antinacistinio, antikomunistinio ir antisovietinio pogrindžio karius. Renginys populiarina bėgimą ir lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą bei siekia suburti įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o renginys organizuojamas su dideliu dėmesiu saugumui ir profesionalumui. Tai puiki proga tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams dalyvauti prasmingame sporto renginyje.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Vingio parke prie estrados
Distancijos: simbolinis 1963 m. bėgimas, 5,2 km, 10,5 km ir pusės maratonas
Trasos uždarymas ir eismo apribojimai saugumui užtikrinti
additional: Varžybų dieną laiko matavimo sistema veikia iki 13:30 val., po to laikas nebus fiksuojamas. Dalyvių skaičius ribotas iki 1200. Galimas rungties keitimas į trumpesnę už 2 Eur mokestį. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Renginys jungia sportą ir istoriją, siūlomos kelios distancijos, įskaitant simbolinę 1963 metrų trasą, ir pabrėžiama bendruomeniškumo svarba. Dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ar asmeninę palydą.

name: Rock The Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kan göras via hemsidan fram till tisdagen 13/4 kl 23.59

late_fee.price: Swish betalning på plats, hamburgare kan ta slut

description: Rock The Trail is a trail race on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten, Uppsala. The race offers four categories, including a children’s race of approximately 1.5 km and longer distances of 8 km, 16 km and 48 km. The start and finish are at OK Linné, and participants are offered hamburgers and drinks after the race. The course features scenic trails and mixed terrain, and the longer distances are registered with ITRA.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten
The longer-distance course is approximately 16 km, adjusted from the previous 15.8 km
Children’s race of approximately 1.5 km around the start and finish area
additional: Late registration is available on site with payment by Swish, but hamburgers after the race may run out. Umara sports drink is served during the race. Toilets are available at the start/finish. Parking is limited; taking public transport or cycling is recommended. The start location is listed as OK Linné, Tallbacksvägen 68.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-metre loop on the Stensö exercise trail. The race starts at 10:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. To continue, runners must complete a lap within one hour. The winner is the person who completes the most laps, making the race an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat, gravel-surfaced trail on the Stensö exercise trail
The course is clearly marked with red-and-white ribbons and arrows
In the evening and at night, the course follows only the floodlit trail
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The 6,706 m loop is on the Stensö exercise trail (gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps equal 100 miles. Organiser: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://irunkalmar.com/kalmar-backyard-ultra/): 2027-04-17 — "Kalmar Backyard Ultra 17 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-17)

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is an annual running race organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb at Sollentunavallen in Sollentuna. The race offers runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete on a well-organized course, with good training facilities. Turebergs Friidrottsklubb is an experienced organizer that also hosts several other athletics and running events throughout the year. Sollentunavallen is a centrally located, easily accessible venue that contributes to a pleasant race environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the running track at Sollentunavallen
Organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb, an experienced club
Centrally located venue with good training facilities
additional: Turebergs Friidrottsklubb covers up to 15 race entries per season for its members. Late registration and failure to participate are charged to the participant. Training at Sollentunavallen may be affected by other events and football matches, but the track is generally available for running. Previous editions have offered Minivarvet for children. Information about the course and event is based on previous years' races and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and refreshment stations along the route. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies, at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bibs are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to finish in over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen. The official club announcement applies to 2026 and lists prices for the marathon and half marathon; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Paszczyna, Dębica County, Subcarpathian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Tradicinis tarptautinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė yra kasmetinė pavasario sporto šventė, vykstanti Baltojoje Vokėje. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, kuris suburia bėgimo entuziastus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Renginys pasižymi ilga istorija ir draugiška atmosfera, skatinančia aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Tradicinis maršrutas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
Pavasario sporto šventės dalis
Kasmet vyksta nuo bent 2018 metų
additional: Renginys vyksta pavasario sporto šventės metu. Registraciją prižiūri Lietuvos bėgimo taurė. Ankstesnių metų starto laikas dažniausiai būdavo 11:00 val. Renginyje dalyvauja keli šimtai sportininkų, vyksta apdovanojimai ir rėmėjų palaikymas, renginys apima ir saugumo užtikrinimą.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet is a trail race organized by Björnstorps IF at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. Races are offered over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, with the 3 km race also having recreational categories for men and women. The courses follow Skryllegården’s fitness trails through varied woodland terrain on gravel surfaces. Skrylleloppet is a welcoming race with professional timing and results reporting, and also serves as a qualifying race for the TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Trail race on varied woodland trails
Gravel surfaces on fitness trails
The 10 km race offers the opportunity to qualify for the TCS Lidingöloppet
additional: Registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants can also register on site and make a name or category change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; payment is by Swish only. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be collected from Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race. Participants who cycle to the race can enter a prize draw at the awards ceremony at 11:30. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly race through the scenic surroundings of Skälby Gård in Kalmar. The event offers several distances, from short 600-metre youth races to 8 km for adults, on routes featuring lovely park paths, gravel, asphalt and trail. It’s a perfect race to kick off the running season, with water available on the lap and at the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and park paths, with a short section on asphalt and some trail.
Water is available on the lap of the long course and at the finish.
The 4 km and 8 km courses are one and two laps respectively, crossing the bridge.
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Skälby loge on race day from 8:30 a.m. Youth races start from 10:00 a.m.; adult men’s and women’s races start at 11:00 a.m. New: a 4 km untimed walking category. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Information about previous editions also lists a 4 km untimed walking category. All finishers receive a medal. The published information applies to the 2026 race and does not confirm the date of 24 April 2027.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon that runs through scenic parts of Gärdet and Södra Djurgården in Stockholm. The start and finish are at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen. The race is perfect preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, but also suits anyone who wants to welcome spring with a great half marathon in an urban setting. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of asphalt, gravel and paving stones, with a total elevation gain of 183 metres.
course_highlights: The course runs through Gärdet and Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel and paving stones
Total elevation gain of 183 metres, with kilometre markers at every kilometre
additional: The race has a time limit of 3 hours. Enervit sports drink will be available during the race. Bib collection takes place at Gärdet sports field on Friday 24 April from 10:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 25 April from 08:00 to 11:00. Participants who collect their bib on Friday receive IcePower Cold Gel and a Scholl foot mask. Registered participants receive 25% off adidas shoes and clothing at the adidas pop-up store at Löplabbet from 20–26 April. Race rules prohibit, among other things, strollers, inline skates, roller skis and competition wheelchairs. Wheelchair participants start in the final starting group, and guides are free of charge. The provisional start time is 11:00 and the time limit is three hours. Minimum age: 17. Race-day registration is available until 09:00, subject to availability.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarhalvan/): 2027-04-24 — "Spring adidas Premiärhalvan den 24 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-24)

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 550:-  för individuell start inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900:- för ett lag inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly trails through forests and meadows and along the archipelago coast, with a soft, gentle surface suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race qualifies runners for seeding at TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to get a better start group in the classic autumn trail race. Water and sports drinks are available at aid stations, and there is entertainment along the course. After the race, refreshments and light food are available to buy at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails and hilly terrain
The course is mostly on soft trails and gravel
Beautiful scenery featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Aid stations with water and sports drinks at 5 km and at the finish. The course is marked with white flagging tape and spray-painted arrows, with course marshals at difficult points. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available at Lidingövallen. Free bag storage is available, but not for electronic items. Valuables storage costs 20 kr. Group warm-up before the start. Public transport or cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Category changes and name changes are possible for a fee. A children’s race (Knattarnas Vårmil) takes place before the main races. The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the 5 km at 11:10 on 24 April 2027. The 10 km course has an aid station at 5 km and drinks at the finish. Parking is limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning festival and Swedish Championships organized by Växjö Löparklubb in collaboration with the Swedish Athletics Association. The event takes place on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö and offers several championship distances, including 24-hour running and 100 km. The course is flat and consists mainly of asphalt with some gravel sections, making it fast and spectator-friendly. Both runners and walkers are welcome for a weekend of challenge and community.
course_highlights: Flat loop course of approximately 820 meters on asphalt and gravel
Approximately 3.2 km loop around Lake Trummen on asphalt and gravel
Event area on open grassy spaces on the southern shore of Lake Trummen
additional: The pre-race dinner is held on Friday, April 24. Lap counting takes place at the arena, where there is room for the organizer's tents and participants' own tents. The women's SM half-marathon walk starts at 10:00. The VXO24h course is approximately 820 m, while the courses for VXO100k and the SM 42 km and 21 km walking events are approximately 3.2 km around Lake Trummen. The organizer's website states that VXO Ultrafest is taking a break after five years; no event in 2027 has been confirmed.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: Kauno Akropolio maratonas yra kasmetinis tarptautinis bėgimo renginys Kaune, pritraukiantis tūkstančius dalyvių. Renginys skirtas visiems, nepriklausomai nuo amžiaus ar fizinio pasirengimo, ir siekia skatinti socialinį bei fizinį aktyvumą bei sveikos gyvensenos tradicijas Lietuvoje. Maratono ir pusės maratono trasos yra sertifikuotos Tarptautinės lengvosios atletikos federacijos (WA) ir Tarptautinės maratonų bei ilgųjų distancijų bėgimo asociacijos (AIMS). Tai sporto šventė tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, vykstanti saugioje ir aukštus standartus atitinkančioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Maratono ir pusės maratono trasos sertifikuotos WA ir AIMS
Trasa išmatuota pagal tarptautinius standartus
Renginys sertifikuotas 5 žvaigždučių kokybės ženklu
additional: Renginys sertifikuotas 5 žvaigždučių kokybės ženklu, užtikrinantis aukščiausio lygio saugumą ir paslaugas. Maratono trasos atitinka tarptautinius standartus. Renginys skirtas tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, vyksta Kauno mieste. Organizuoja VšĮ "Kauno maratono klubas". Renginio metu siūloma nuotolinio bėgimo galimybė, grupinės registracijos ir įvairios distancijos, sertifikuotos trasos.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“ yra aukštos kokybės pusės maratono renginys, skirtas Jurginių šventei. Renginys siekia įtvirtinti Palangą kaip Europos sporto miestą, skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir sveiką gyvenimo būdą tarp gyventojų ir miesto svečių. Bėgimas vyksta Palangos ir Šventosios kurortuose, didinant masinių sporto renginių pasiūlą ir vietos bendruomenės įsitraukimą į sporto veiklas.
course_highlights: Startas Šventojoje ir finišas Palangoje
Trasa pažymėta ir pritaikyta bėgikams
Skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir sporto populiarinimą
additional: Renginyje numatomi eismo apribojimai ir viešųjų ryšių kampanijos, siekiant užtikrinti sklandų renginio vykdymą.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a lovely trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some off-trail terrain, offering a nature-rich and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and welcomes runners in various classes, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser, SK Graal, looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and off-trail terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: The start and finish are at Graalstugan. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each class and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing rooms and showers are available, with limited space. There is a cafeteria near the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 SEK. Clubs may be invoiced when registering more than three participants. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. Timing is electronic, and finishers receive a medal according to the 2026 information; the 2027 terms have not yet been confirmed.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race held on Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, with the start and finish at Fisksjöäng. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting at 11:00 and 12:00, respectively. The course offers a wonderful experience in nature, with varied terrain, and is easy to reach by public transport. The event is open to young people aged 11 and over when accompanied by a parent or guardian, and has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. All participants receive a medal, refreshments along the course and race timing with a bib.
course_highlights: Trail running on Norra Djurgården through varied natural scenery
Start and finish at Fisksjöäng, near Ropsten metro station
Refreshment stations along the course and chip timing
additional: The start and finish are at Fisksjöäng, a 10-minute walk from Ropsten metro station. Bibs can be collected the Friday before the race at the Icebug store in Stockholm or at the venue on race day. The bib is personal and must be worn visibly on the chest, with the chip unfolded. A medal, refreshments along the course, finish-line services and race timing are included. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Participants receive a discount on Icebug running shoes. A bib with race timing, refreshments along the course, a medal and finish-line services are included. The price information applies to the price periods listed on the organizer’s website and may refer to an edition other than 2027.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė yra unikalios ištvermės varžybos Alytuje, Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Šis renginys kviečia bėgikus išbandyti savo ribas, bėgant Backyard ultra formato trasą, kuri padeda lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Varžybose nugalėtojas bus tik vienas, o iššūkis yra didelis - lengva atrodo tik iki tam tikro momento. Tai puiki galimybė patirti tikrą ištvermės bėgimo dvasią ir garbingai užsitarnauti DNF statusą.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“ kviečia dalyvius gegužės 7 dieną aktyviai praleisti laiką nuostabaus grožio Anykščių kraštovaizdyje. Bėgimo trasos ilgis ir sudėtingumas pritaikyti įvairaus amžiaus ir fizinio pasirengimo dalyviams, nuo vaikų pramoginio bėgimo iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems. Renginys yra seniausias Lietuvoje ir garsėja savo tradicija bei draugiška atmosfera, kuri pritraukia sporto entuziastus iš visos šalies. Dalyviai bus apdovanoti atminimo medaliais, o greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje - piniginiais prizais.
course_highlights: Vaizdinga trasa Anykščių kraštovaizdyje, besidriekiančioje Antano Baranausko apdainuotame Anykščių šilelyje
Skirtingos distancijos: nuo 300 m vaikams iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems
Startas šalia Angelų muziejaus, Anykščiuose
additional: Startai pagal amžiaus grupes: 10:30 val. - vaikų pramoginis bėgimas „Puntukėlis“; 11:30 val. - 3 km distancija; 11:50 val. - varžybų atidarymas; 12:00 val. - 6 km ir 11 km distancijos. Registracija vykdoma tik iki balandžio 28 d. 12:00 val., bėgimo dieną registracija nevyks. Dalyviai, pasiekę finišą, gaus atminimo medalius. Greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje apdovanojami piniginiais prizais. Dalyviams siūloma išankstinė registracija, galimybė atgauti jėgas po varžybų baseine ir pirčių komplekse, prizai ir nuolaidos, įvairios amžiaus grupės

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Girulių miško takais Klaipėdoje. Renginyje gali dalyvauti tiek mėgėjai, tiek profesionalai, skatinantys sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Trasos ilgis svyruoja nuo 2 km moksleiviams iki 42,2 km ekomaratono dalyviams, kurie bėga 10 ratų po 4,2 km. Renginys organizuojamas Klaipėdos miesto bėgikų klubo „Maratonas“ ir remiamas Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės.
course_highlights: Ekomaratono trasa - 10 ratų po 4,2 km Girulių miško takais
Moksleivių trasa - 2 km (1 km pirmyn, 1 km atgal)
Startas Girulių miške, dviračių takelio pradžioje už Vasaros Estrados
additional: Varžybų dieną laiko matavimo sistema veikia iki 15:00 val. Dalyvio starto mokestis mokamas vietoje atsiimant numerį. Pirmieji 300 dalyvių gauna atminimo medalius, visi dalyviai - pažymėjimus. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio organizatoriai gali naudoti renginio metu darytas nuotraukas ir filmuotą medžiagą rinkodaros tikslais. 4,2 km ir 42,2 km distancijos, moksleivių 2 km, startas Girulių miške, registracija internetu iki balandžio 30 d.

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: RISEN-loppet is an annual running race organized by Genarps IF, starting and finishing at Ekevallen sports ground in Genarp. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10.7 km. The 5 km route runs mostly on asphalt through the village, while the 10.7 km route is split between the village and Risen Nature Reserve. The course is challenging, with steep elevation changes, and the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup. Participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug at the finish. There are water stations along the course, followed by an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is 95% asphalt and 5% natural trail through the village
The 10.7 km course runs 50% through the village and 50% in Risen Nature Reserve
Steep elevation changes on both distances
additional: Electronic timing, with gun time from the start signal. Race numbers must be collected on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly on the chest. Water and energy drinks are available at 3 km and 8 km (water and squash). At the finish, water, squash, recovery drink (Gatorade), and bananas are available. Rådjursloppet, a 700 m race for children up to age 9, starts at 12:15. All participants receive a medal, and registration is available on site at no charge. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of SEK 100, payable via Swish. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30, after the children's race. All participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug; gold mugs go to approximately the first 25% of finishers in each distance, and silver mugs to the rest. A children's race of approximately 700 metres is also offered. Previous editions have started and finished at Ekevallen sports ground; details of registration and prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 100 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 5 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 kviečia bėgikus patirti unikalią trasų įvairovę Vilniaus gamtoje ir miesto aplinkoje. Renginys siūlo maršrutus nuo pradedančiųjų 15+ km iki iššūkių kupinos 108 km trasos aplink Vilnių. Dalyviai galės mėgautis įvairiu reljefu, įskaitant miško takus, kalnų kelius ir vaizdingas apžvalgos vietas, kurios suteiks nepakartojamų Lietuvos kraštovaizdžio vaizdų. Tai puiki proga išbandyti savo ištvermę ir pažinti miesto gamtą bei kultūrą bėgimo metu.
course_highlights: Unikalūs maršrutai Vilniuje nuo 15+ km iki 108 km
Įvairus reljefas: miško takai, kalnų keliai
Vaizdingos apžvalgos vietos su Lietuvos kraštovaizdžio vaizdais
additional: Renginys vyksta Kalnų parko stadione, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. Dalyvių skaičius viršija 1000. Organizatorius VšĮ, adresas Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, telefonas +370 610 24484. Renginyje siūlomos trasos apima miško takus, kalnų keliukus ir vaizdingas apžvalgas; dalyviai gali pasirinkti iš įvairių distancijų ir amžiaus grupių, įskaitant ultramaratoną ir vaikų bėgimus.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: Vilniaus Pavasario Maratonas kviečia bėgikus visų lygių išbandyti savo jėgas pavasario ritmu Vilniaus Vingio parke. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 600 m vaikams iki klasikinio maratono 42,195 km, taip pat pusmaratonį ir trumpesnius bėgimus. Tai puiki proga pradėti bėgimo sezoną gamtos apsuptyje, judant per miestą ir parkus, mėgaujantis pavasario atgimimu. Renginys organizuojamas su dideliu dėmesiu visų dalyvių patirčiai ir skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Vingio parko estradoje
Bėgimas per Vilniaus miesto parkus ir gatves
Distancijos nuo 600 m vaikams iki 42,195 km maratonui
additional: Renginys vyksta 2026-05-02, startas 10:00 val. Vingio parko estradoje. Distancijos: 42,195 km, 21,098 km, 10,6 km, 5,3 km ir 600 m vaikams. Nuostatai skelbiami https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registracija vykdoma per https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimus, taip pat galimybė dalyvauti su draudimu. Registracija vyksta per myrace.lt.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultrarun held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosa River. The aim is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour allowed per lap. Participants can start again every hour if they have completed the lap. It is a festive, social race with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the event. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and attractive medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to completing multiple laps
700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free Umara silicone cup at bib collection. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, sandwiches and sweets are provided at each lap checkpoint. In the team competition, the three best results from each club count. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is sold out. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches, sweets and food are served during the race. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2027 in Strandbjörket, Växjö. This is a running festival for the whole family, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners. The courses offer a scenic running experience featuring asphalt, forest roads and beautiful views around Lake Växjö and the Bokhultet Nature Reserve. Växjöloppet is a traditional, friendly race that puts the joy of exercise and community at its heart.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket, with the first kilometre on asphalt
A scenic route through the Bokhultet Nature Reserve, mostly among deciduous trees
The final 3.5 km on asphalt around Lake Växjö, with a shared finish on Lagunvallen
additional: There are water stations on the 10 km course (4 stations) and the 21.1 km course (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers four different distances for younger runners, with no timing. Participants receive a race bib, medal and fruit, or a T-shirt and certificate, depending on the distance. The finish line is on Lagunvallen, approximately 300–400 metres from the finish at Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet is not timed. Registration and payment for the children’s races take place on site at Lagunen in Strandbjörket.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun fitness event for women held at Studenternas IP in Uppsala. Participants can choose to run or walk 2.5 km or 5 km on a certified course. The event is all about the joy of exercise and togetherness, with a fantastic atmosphere and entertainment along the course and in the event area. After the finish, teams that have registered five people are treated to a picnic, making it a social and enjoyable spring evening together.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Bib collection takes place May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. A picnic is provided after the finish for teams of five. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. Participants are advised to arrive changed; changing facilities and showers are available. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. Parking is available south of the arena, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. According to the local race information, registration can be completed online until race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing for the 5 km can be opted out of. Teams of five participants are treated to a picnic after the finish.

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focusing on the joy of being active rather than the fastest time or lap. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 900-metre Minivarvet for children born in 2016 or later. It’s a community celebration with entertainment, activities, and food, perfect for families, groups of friends, and companies looking to build team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarvet for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities including basketball, football, table tennis, and boules, as well as food and drink. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for building team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30. The official information currently available describes the 2026 edition: the race starts at 18:30, and activities in Kullaparken begin at 16:00. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: RASA Druskininkų maratonas yra tarptautinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Druskininkuose prie Vijūnėlės ežero. Renginys skatina bėgimą kaip sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje bei didinti Druskininkų gyventojų aktyvumą. Varžybose dalyvauti gali visi norintys, o maratono ir pusmaratonio rungtyse startuoti gali tik sulaukę 18 metų. Dalyviai varžosi įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki maratono, o visi apdovanojami specialiais renginio medaliais.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting occasion that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path beside the Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. Taking part is above all about the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges, regardless of finishing position. The event also includes group activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging integration.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the natural beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and discovering local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.

name: III M Park4RUN
location: Centrum Handlowe M Park, Tarnów, Poland
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Centre. The course is 100% paved, flat, and marked every 1 km, with road traffic restricted for the duration of the race. The event promotes running and recreation and brings the local community together. In addition to the main race, races for children and teenagers are held over distances suited to their ages. Participants in the main race receive a starter pack containing sponsors’ products as well as informational and advertising materials.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course features a variety of surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and a formal awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive feedback from participants in previous editions.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / 9th Provi Run Running Championships is a 5.5 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The race is intended for runners of varying ability levels, and participants can use training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The event is moderately challenging and takes place on an urban asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short
description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the scenic Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The event features a variety of disciplines, including mountain biking, trekking, kayaking, climbing and orienteering. The routes cross mountainous terrain, with beautiful views and demanding sections. The race is open to two-person teams and solo participants, offering an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are in the Košice area, and the organizers provide professional service and support.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in picturesque Olsztyn. The route follows the charming trails of Warmia, along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively, both for experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can take part in the Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races. The event’s atmosphere encourages people to connect and share a sporting adventure.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Bieg Wilka is a 10 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Grajewo. This moderately challenging event attracts runners of various ability levels. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels, with expert support available. The race is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in the spring. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. The race has two formats: a longer course with eleven legs and a shorter course with six legs, allowing both experienced runners and beginners to take part. During the race, teammates and spectators cheer on the participants. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service, with course marshals, a race announcer and timing. The race starts at 10:00, preceded by a joint warm-up.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 67.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 8.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 23.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 5.4 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with spectators and teammates cheering on runners
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead the group warm-up before the start. Course marshals will be stationed along the course, at relay exchanges, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times will be provided. The long course has a women’s class and an open class; the short course has an open class. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. Start at 10:00. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, approximately 200 metres north of Ölands Köpstad. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a grill plate.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections, with an almost entirely paved surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race that is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Route along the Svartån with a 99% paved surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to age 12. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and for exposure.

name: Spångaloppet
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race being held for the third year in a row and welcomes all participants. The race offers several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400-metre children’s race. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum, with the start and finish at Spånga IP. The goal for 2027 is to have more than 600 participants take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race
Start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: There are distances for both adults and younger participants.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online-anmälan är öppen fram till fredagen den 8 maj 20:00

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: När du registrerar din hund, betalar du 50 kr och då ingår en fin Älmhult Fights Cancer scarf

description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race that brings participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances, with both runners and dogs welcome and special start times for dog owners. The event includes inspiring talks by prominent doctors and researchers, as well as a festive after-run at Grillen. It is a community where participants come together to support an important cause and enjoy a great running experience in Älmhult.
course_highlights: Choice of distances, with special start times for dogs in the 2.5 km and 5 km races
After-run party with a barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by experts from Lund University
additional: Online registration is open until 8 May at 20:00, with on-site late registration available from 08:00 on race day. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available. Dogs are welcome during special start times and must be kept on a leash. Älmhult Brukshundsklubb will be on site. The after-run party with a barbecue and music starts at 14:00 at Grillen. Accommodation and breakfast are available at IKEA Hotell during race weekend. Previous editions have offered on-site late registration subject to availability. Dog registration has cost 50 kr and included a scarf.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied mix of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, with prizes for the top three finishers in each category and prize draws. A Mini Race is also held for children, featuring a fun course of approximately 650 metres. All participants receive a medal and a diploma.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs, with exchanges at the portal
Water station at the start/finish and after approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is done using data chips, and both total time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. There is a group warm-up before the start. The children’s Mini Race starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing the Mini Race, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink and fruit. Late registration for the Mini Race is available on site between 09:00 and 10:00. Proceeds go to Rotary’s international relief work and Ryssberget IK’s activities.

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a popular recreational race in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is a wonderful running celebration through the city’s parks and city centre, with a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and finishes inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, where participants can enjoy food and drinks from food trucks. Lundaloppet is a festive event that brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, energetic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km of running fun through springtime Lund
5 km route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly Little Lundaloppet, approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen the day before and on race day. The warm-up takes place at the start on Svanevägen, led by a running coach on raised platforms. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the race bib, and the finish is filmed. The official T-shirt can be purchased during registration or at the venue. Meal packages and food trucks are available after the finish. It is also possible to add training sessions with a running coach before the race. Official information lists water stations at 5, 10 and 15 km; the 2.5 km course has no water station. These practical details and prices on the information page apply to 2026 and have not been confirmed for 2027.
