name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run yra unikalus bėgimas, vykstantis vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vingio parką Vilniuje. Dalyviai bėga tiek, kiek gali, kol juos pasivija „Gaudymo automobilis“. Šis renginys skirtas paremti stuburo smegenų traumų tyrimus, o 100 % dalyvio mokesčio skiriama moksliniams tyrimams. Prisijunkite prie tūkstančių bėgikų visame pasaulyje ir bėkite už tuos, kurie negali.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Vingio parke, Vilniuje
Startas vienu metu su bėgikais visame pasaulyje
Unikalus „Gaudymo automobilio“ formatas, kuris užbaigia bėgimą
additional: Startas vyksta 11:00 UTC. Dalyviai bėga tiek, kiek gali, kol juos pasivija „Gaudymo automobilis“. 100 % dalyvio mokesčio skiriama stuburo smegenų traumų tyrimams. Renginys vyksta vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vilnių. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke, dalyvių pasirinkimas bėgti ar eiti, neturi tradicinės finišo linijos, surenkama lėšų stuburo traumų tyrimams.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos yra skirtos Lietuvos maratono bėgimo pradininko Alfonso Vietrino atminimui. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyno parke, startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo. Dalyviai gali rinktis 2,5 km arba 10 km distancijas, o trasa yra sertifikuota ir sudaryta iš 2,5 km ilgio rato. Renginys populiarina bėgimą Lietuvoje ir kviečia visus norinčius dalyvauti su gydytojo leidimu.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Ąžuolyno parke
Vieno rato ilgis - 2,5 km, sertifikuota trasa
Startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo
additional: 2,5 km distancijos startas 11:30 val., 10 km distancijos startas 12:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai atminimo taurėmis. Varžybose draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą. Renginio tikslas - skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir bėgimo mėgėjų bendruomenę Lietuvoje

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“ Nemenčinėje siūlo unikalią galimybę bėgti per Vilniaus rajono sporto centro apylinkes. Varžybos vyksta birželio 2 dieną, o trasos yra įvairaus ilgio - nuo trumpesnio 6 km Szpurt bėgimo iki ilgesnio 18,6 km Wertep trasos. Renginys pritaikytas tiek profesionaliems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams, su elektroniniu laiko matavimu ir starto numeriu, galiojančiu visą sezoną. Dalyviai gali mėgautis žaliais ir raudonais rodyklėmis pažymėtomis trasomis, o po bėgimo laukia apdovanojimai ir šiltas maistas.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km bėgimas su žaliomis rodyklėmis geltoname fone
Wertep 18,6 km bėgimas su raudonomis rodyklėmis
Du maitinimo punktai Wertep trasoje
additional: Registracija vyksta prieš startą nuo 8:30 iki 9:20 val., ne vėliau kaip 10 min. iki starto. Varžybų biuras veikia birželio 1 d. nuo 15:00 iki 18:00 Vilniaus rajono sporto centre. Laiko limitas trasose - 2 val. 15 min. Elektroninis laiko matavimas ir nemokamas starto numeris su laiko skaitikliu, galiojantis visą sezoną. Po bėgimo dalyviams siūlomas šiltas maistas. Starto sektoriai atskirti pagal distancijas: Szpurt 6 km ir Wertep 19 km. Renginyje yra maitinimo punktų, elektroninis laiko matavimas, nemokamas starto numeris, medicininė apsauga ir apdovanojimai.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a slight uphill section on the connecting path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Organized since 2013, it is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up before the half marathon, as well as races for children. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów to benefit Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers come together to create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: The 9th Pilica Run is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the centrally situated, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route runs along the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, offering distances for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Colorful races tailored to participants’ ages are organized for children and teenagers. Every participant can enjoy a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: The Wings for Life World Run App is a unique race held simultaneously around the world on May 10, 2026. Participants start at the same time wherever they choose, with the goal of outrunning a virtual Catcher Car that starts chasing them 30 minutes after the start. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the race. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is a road race held in Działoszyn on May 10, 2026. The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Atelier Sportu, which specializes in professional timing and running-event organization. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. The event attracts runners who value well-organized races with electronic timing.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

description: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Kuršėnuose, Šiaulių rajone. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą ir skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą, kviečiant dalyvauti įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus. Varžybos vyksta prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto, siūlant tris distancijas: apie 463 m, 2,5 km ir 10 km. Dalyviai gali mėgautis simboliniu maršrutu ir draugiška atmosfera, o renginys baigiasi apdovanojimais ir bendru finišu apie 21:30 val.
course_highlights: Simbolinis apie 463 m maršrutas prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto
2,5 km ratas, kurį 10 km bėgikai įveikia keturis kartus
Varžybos vyksta miesto aplinkoje su patogiu startu ir finišu
additional: Varžybų programa: 19:30 val. 463 m startas, 19:40 val. 2,5 km startas, 20:00 val. 10 km startas. Apdovanojimai vyksta po paskutinio dalyvio finišo apie 21:30 val. Dalyviai privalo būti sveiki arba turėti gydytojo leidimą sportuoti. Nepilnamečių dalyvių sveikata ir elgesys prižiūrimi lydinčių asmenų. bėgimo vieta prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto, registracija ir numerių atsiėmimas prie tilto, dalyvių amžiaus grupės, COVID-19 saugumo reikalavimai

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“ yra tradicinis ir kasmet vykstantis iššūkis, kviečiantis bėgimo entuziastus ir ekstremalaus sporto mėgėjus įveikti 31 aukštą verslo centre „Europa“, aukščiausiame Baltijos šalyse. Renginys suburia tiek profesionalus, tiek mėgėjus, siekiančius pagerinti savo ištvermę ir sportinius rezultatus. Trasą būtina įveikti per ne ilgiau nei 10 minučių, o prizininkai dažniausiai užbėga per 3-4 minutes. Greičiausi bėgikai apdovanojami piniginiais prizais ir rėmėjų dovanomis.
course_highlights: 31 verslo centro aukštas iki terasos
Trasos įveikimo laikas iki 10 minučių
Rekordai siekia 2 min. 55,6 sek. vyrų ir 3 min. 28,6 sek. moterų kategorijose
additional: Visi dalyviai startuoja kas pusę minutės, kad būtų išvengta grūsčių. Greičiausi bėgikai apdovanojami piniginiais prizais bei rėmėjų dovanomis. Renginį organizuoja nekilnojamo turto plėtros kompanija „Hanner“ ir „Lietuvos bėgimo taurės“ komanda. Renginys planuojamas vykti 2027 m. gegužės 22 d., kviečiantis dalyvius iš visos Lietuvos ir užsienio. Dalyviams siūloma įveikti trasą įkopiant į Europa Tower, o renginys yra žinomas kaip vienas iš įdomiausių ir iššūkių pilnų bėgimo renginių Vilniuje.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa “Sokół” Association. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, at the Błękitny San Tourist Center in Dynów. The evening race follows a scenic route, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.

name: Bieg Iskier - IFMSA Poland Oddział Rzeszów
XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The 12th Commandos Quarter Marathon is a uniformed-services race organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk. The 10.55 km course runs through the grounds of the 650th Anniversary Stadium and the Northern Wood, offering extreme racing conditions for uniformed services and running enthusiasts. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, competition, and the training of uniformed services. The race is scheduled to start on May 16, 2026, at 12:00, with a participant limit of 999.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail race organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile (4 km and 828 metres) course runs along dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and is open to people over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event brings people together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The V Szczecinecka 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to a range of runners and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and active recreation.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual race held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. The event includes a main race and Nordic walking, attracting both runners and outdoor enthusiasts. It is open and welcoming to participants, with clearly specified entry fees and professional organization. The start is scheduled for 08:30, and the event runs until 14:20.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: Skärholmsloppet
price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: POKONAJ LUCYFERA - Półmaraton
description: POKONAJ LUCYFERA – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk, taking place on May 17, 2026. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging forest terrain, with numerous uphill climbs and technical descents. The event offers four challenges to choose from: Lucyfer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and 7 km Nordic Walking. This race is for people who value endurance, strength, and determination, and features professional timekeeping and commemorative medals for participants.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail running event taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
description: “Half marathon… Are you up for it?” is a cross-country race covering 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk the course with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional event management for a competition with nationwide reach while ensuring a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Stanisław Komornicz Rector’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, giving participants an appealing course and sporting excitement.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The event features various distances for different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge, and participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize drawing after the event. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event created in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they have time to rest until the next full hour. The competition continues until only one runner remains, and they complete the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is an endurance race where not only speed matters, but also strategy and perseverance.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai tradicinis bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos yra atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikams, vyksta penkiuose etapuose skirtingose vietovėse. Dalyviai varžosi tiek bendroje įskaitoje, tiek amžiaus grupėse, o trasos driekiasi įvairiomis Jonavos rajono vietovėmis, suteikdamos įdomią ir įvairiapusę bėgimo patirtį. Registracija vykdoma internetu, o numerių atsiėmimas - varžybų dieną starto vietoje.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Startas ir finišas įvairiose lokacijose, įskaitant Jonavos miesto centrinį stadioną ir seniūnijų pastatus
Varžybos vyksta vakaro valandomis, startas 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val.
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Renginys yra atviras visiems dalyviams, siūlo internetinę registraciją ir skirtingas trasas, vyksta penkiais etapais nuo gegužės iki rugsėjo.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 och 10 km; Lilla Blodomloppet gratis för de 250 första, därefter 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blodomloppet in Kristianstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children of different ages, with shorter distances inside Tivoliparken. The course passes through the scenic Vattenriket, with a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. Participants can take part with colleagues or friends, or on their own, contribute to a good cause and finish with a shared picnic in the event area.
course_highlights: Scenic course extending into Vattenriket
A mix of grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 inside Tivoliparken
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 12 May. Late registration is available on site in Tivoliparken from 16:00 on 19 May. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km courses have a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. There are several cheer stations along the course. The event area offers picnic facilities, and the event concludes with a shared picnic. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances for children aged 1–12. Teams can have a maximum of five participants.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“ kviečia visus aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo entuziastus dalyvauti 5 km ir 10 km distancijose Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje. Renginys skirtas skatinti fizinį aktyvumą įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams ir suteikti galimybę varžytis bei realizuoti savo bėgimo gebėjimus. Trasos driekiasi miško takais ir keliukais, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gaus atminimo medalį. Varžybos organizuojamos Kėdainių sporto centro ir Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacijos bendradarbiavimu.
course_highlights: Trasos driekiasi Babėnų miško takais ir keliukais
5 km ir 10 km distancijos
Varžybos vyksta Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje, Aušros ir Budrio gatvių gale
additional: Papildoma registracija vyks starto vietoje nuo 17:00 iki 18:15 val. Numeriai išduodami likus valandai iki starto ir baigiami dalinti likus 15 minučių iki starto. Apdovanojami kiekvienos amžiaus grupės nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat greičiausi 3 dalyviai 5 km ir 10 km distancijose. Visi finišavusieji gaus atminimo medalius. Renginys planuojamas 2027 m. gegužės 26 d., tačiau detalių apie trasas ar dalyvio mokestį nėra pateikta.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

price_range: 350–450 kr individuellt; 1 750–2 000 kr per lag om fem

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for individuals and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four different courses: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Courses are measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
Walkers have a separate course and start first to make a shared picnic afterwards possible
additional: There is a special discount of SEK 40 per person for blood donors and ICA members, for both individual entries and teams. You can register individually or in a team of up to 5 participants. Team members can take part in different distances/classes. It is possible to register many participants using an Excel template, and larger organisations can use customer portals to manage registrations. Walkers start first on a separate course to make a shared picnic after the race possible. You can take part individually or in a team of up to five people. Blood donors and ICA members receive a SEK 40 discount per person. Prices may be updated ahead of 2027.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The 13th 5 MILE Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9,260 m), organised in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Association of Polish Navy Officers, in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4,630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees and civilian runners who have been verified in advance. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ungdomslag (alla fem lagmedlemmar födda 2009 eller senare) deltar för halva startavgiften tack vare samarbete med Lejonfastigheter och Maxi ICA Linköping. Gäller endast till och med 30 april.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Sista dag för laganmälan är 14 maj, därefter är det individuell anmälan som gäller.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a recreational race that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individuals and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are located along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile phone number will receive a ticket link by text message for 6 hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Team registration is for 3–5 people, and teams always pay for 5 even if they have fewer members. Bib pickup and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual and team entries. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration for 2027 opens in a few weeks, according to the organizer’s website.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg (ingen specialkost kan fixas tyvärr) = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg (ingen specialkost kan fixas tyvärr) = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 2000 kr (ingen specialkost kan fixas tyvärr) OBS det går endast att anmäla lag till 10 maj.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Knatte 350 m köps och anmäls med kort på tävlingsdagen = 100 kr

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“ vyks 2026 m. gegužės 22 d. Šimkaičių miestelyje, Jurbarko rajone, siekiant paminėti generolo Jono Žemaičio 117-ąsias gimimo metines. Tai 11 km ilgio krosas, kuris startuos nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą, sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir pagerbia Lietuvos laisvės kovotojo atminimą. Dalyviai kviečiami registruotis iš anksto ir dalyvauti bendruomeniškame sporto renginyje.
course_highlights: 11 km ilgio krosas Šimkaičių apylinkėse
Startas nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės
Autobusų transportas į starto vietą nuo Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinės mokyklos
additional: Dalyvių registracija vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 9:30 val. Numerių atsiėmimas - 2025-05-23 nuo 9:00 iki 9:30 val. Registracijos vieta - Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinė mokykla. Išvykimas autobusu į starto vietą 09:45 val. nuo mokyklos. Apdovanojimai numatyti 13:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimą arba būti pasitikrinę sveikatą. Rezultatai bus skelbiami viešai. Renginio metu bus daromos nuotraukos ir filmuojama medžiaga rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys vyks Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinėje mokykloje, dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir registracijos galimybė internetu.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: „If“ Vilniaus pusmaratonis yra didžiausia pavasario bėgimo šventė Vilniuje, vykstanti miesto senamiestyje. Renginys kviečia dalyvauti visų amžių bėgikus - nuo vaikų iki pusmaratonio distancijos dalyvių. Bėgimas skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą, fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą, o dalyviai gali jaustis saugiai, nes visi bėgikai yra apdrausti nuo nelaimingų atsitikimų. Renginys pasižymi įvairiomis distancijomis ir draugiška atmosfera, kuri sukuria ilgalaikius ryšius tarp dalyvių.
course_highlights: Startas Katedros aikštėje Vilniaus senamiestyje
Pusmaratonio distancija - 21,098 km
Vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimai įvairioms amžiaus grupėms
additional: Dalyviai, registruojantis iki balandžio 4 d., gauna vardinius numerius. Galima įsigyti renginio marškinėlius už papildomą mokestį. Renginyje yra vaikų bėgimai nuo 2 metų, jaunimo 4,2 km bėgimas, 5 km ir 10 km distancijos be amžiaus ribojimų. Dalyviai gauna starto paketus su laiko matavimo mikroschema. Renginio programa apima apšilimus ir apdovanojimus kiekvienai distancijai. Renginyje dalyvauja įvairaus amžiaus grupės, yra keli starto laikai ir papildomos veiklos Vilniaus mieste ir senamiestyje.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos yra oficialios 1000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Trakų stadione. Renginys skirtas tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams, norintiems išbandyti savo greitį ir patirti tikrą sportinę atmosferą. Varžybos vyksta profesionaliai paruoštoje aplinkoje su aiškia stadiono trasa. Tai puiki proga išbandyti save klasikinėje bėgimo rungtyje ir pasimėgauti sporto dvasia Trakuose.
course_highlights: 1000 metrų distancija stadiono lengvosios atletikos take
Profesionaliai paruošta trasa stadione
Varžybos vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44
additional: Registracija vykdoma el. paštu drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. Renginys vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44. Varžybos yra oficialios 1000 m rungties varžybos, skirtos tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams. Renginys yra įtrauktas į ištvermės sporto kalendorių, o dalyviams siūloma galimybė varžytis ir mėgautis sportine atmosfera Trakuose.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio rajono kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti kviečia dalyvius registruotis ir varžytis. Renginys organizuojamas Kupiškyje, siekiant skatinti sportinę veiklą ir bendruomeniškumą. Varžybos yra puiki proga pasitikrinti savo jėgas ir pasimėgauti bėgimu gražioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Renginys skirtas visiems amžiaus grupėms
Prizai laimėti Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams
Vieta Kupiškis, Lietuva
additional: Renginys vyks 2027 m. gegužės 29 d., registracija vyksta internetu ir per socialinius tinklus.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among the greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in a 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the route runs along roads through Żurawica. The organizer is the Regional Board of the Police Officers’ Independent Trade Union of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon course runs through the charming grounds of Hajnówka Municipal Park, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organized by the Hajnówka Sports and Recreation Centre, which ensures runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.

name: Bieg Lwa
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, appealing course, and enthusiastic crowds. The festival also features children’s races and a variety of accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. The Lion Run is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the scenic Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races of 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. Organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and numerous activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on May 23, 2026, at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all ability levels, with teams of six covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering relay legs of different distances to make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and for friends, families, and coworkers to come together.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night-time street race taking place on 23 May 2026 in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The course runs along the town’s atmospheric, historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The programme includes two races: a 5 km race at 18:00 and a 10 km race at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals and a great time in charming surroundings.

name: Phoenix RUN
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. It is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging active time with family and friends. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals and attractive prizes, as well as a chance to socialize and enjoy the chillout zone.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Stud Farm in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Horse Ten, which follows field, unpaved and forest roads, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy sporting competition. The event aims to promote running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, as well as to bring the local community together. In addition to the main race, children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to the whole family.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The 15th Run Through the Wichrowo Forests is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending active time outdoors in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District office, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “From Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational running enthusiasts, offering a challenging course in a picturesque area. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding route, which passes through places called Piekło and Niebo, highlighting its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: The 28th Święców Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving and asphalt bike paths. The course is secured and marked, with water stations along the route. The event also includes races for children and young people at the athletics stadium, over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organisers promote community togetherness and a healthy lifestyle.

name: V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
Tolvanloppet 12km
description: Tolvanloppet is a city race with a friendly, charming atmosphere and events for all ages (in 2026, participants ranged from 2 to 98 years old). Adults can choose between two distances, the main event being 12 km (the shorter distance is 6 km). The course winds through the old residential neighborhoods of Bromma and is described as beautiful but challenging, with quite a few hills. Along the route, expect plenty of support from residents, including their own water stations (in addition to the course’s four official ones) and refreshing sprinklers. All this makes the race Stockholm’s most charming street race.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular with both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course
additional: The distance is 10,549 metres.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę yra tradicinis, kasmetinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Marijampolėje ir suburiantis įvairaus amžiaus dalyvius. Tai ne tik varžybos, bet ir regiono gyventojų susitikimas po atviru dangumi, skatinantis aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą. Renginys pasižymi atnaujinta bėgimo trasa, kuri leidžia išbandyti ištvermę gražiame Lietuvos mieste. Taip pat renginyje vyksta pažintinis žygis „Einam už Marijampolę“ su 8 km ir 14 km distancijomis, į kurį registracija yra nemokama.
course_highlights: Atnaujinta bėgimo trasa Marijampolės mieste
Pažintinis žygis 8 km ir 14 km distancijomis
Renginys vyksta po atviru dangumi, skatinantis bendruomeniškumą
additional: Pažintinis žygis „Einam už Marijampolę“ vyksta kartu su bėgimu, registracija į žygį yra nemokama. Renginys suburia daugiau nei 1000 dalyvių, nuo mažiausių iki vyriausių. Organizuoja Marijampolės lengvosios atletikos sporto klubas. Renginio data - 2027 m. gegužės 30 d., dalyvių skaičius ir distancijos nėra nurodyti

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: We Run, We Don’t Click! is a charity 5 km run taking place on May 24, 2026, in the picturesque Chojnowski Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all experience levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event is inclusive and charitable, and all proceeds will be donated to the Special Needs School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed-services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and welcomes everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run is scheduled to start on May 24, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at the AMZ S.A. Training Ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event taking place on May 24, 2026, in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organized by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn, and the “OGRODNIK” School Sports Club. The aim of the run is to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organization.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
Stadionloppet
description: Stadionloppet is a family-friendly running event held at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The main race is 5 km long and takes place on a scenic two-lap course created by Kalle Berglund. The event is marked by a wonderful sense of community, where children, young people and adults can all take part and cheer one another on. The start, lap point and finish are at the beautiful stadium, offering a unique running experience in a setting where the buzz of the city meets greenery and birdsong.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around Stockholm Olympic Stadium
Course created by Kalle Berglund, a former world-class runner
Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
additional: All members of Djurgården Friidrott run for free and receive a registration code when they join. Several shorter distances are available for children and young people. Members can also take part as volunteers and be part of the event. Start times and categories are preliminary and may change. Stadiongirot, a cycling race held in collaboration with Djurgården Cykel, also takes place on the same day. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can run for free with a registration code. Distance and category details for 2027 are preliminary and may change. Free trial training on the course is held ahead of the race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.diffri.se/stadionloppet/): 2027-05-23 — "Stadionloppet 23 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-23)

name: Vårruset Jönköping
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women, where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km on a certified course. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a wonderful atmosphere among women. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finish-line bag, and teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. It’s a festive spring evening with entertainment and encouragement along the course and at the event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
additional: You can opt out of timekeeping when registering, which means your result will not be published in the results list. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. The recommended age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km, with younger participants permitted when accompanied by an adult. Registration is binding and can be completed up to one hour before the first start on race day. All participants who finish receive a medal and a finish-line bag. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
description: Bėgimas „Kutaliai - Kaltinėnai“ yra tradicinis krosas, skirtas Lietuvos Respublikos Prezidento Aleksandro Stulginskio 141-osioms metinėms ir Steigiamojo Seimo dienai paminėti. Varžybos vyksta raižytoje vietovėje, skatinant fizinį aktyvumą ir pagarbą sportui. Startas yra Kutalių kaime, o finišas - Šilalės r. Kaltinėnų Aleksandro Stulginskio gimnazijos stadione. Renginys skirtas miestų ir rajonų mokyklų sportininkams bei visiems norintiems, kurie atitinka sveikatos reikalavimus.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,8 km)

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

description: Blodomloppet in Uppsala is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race is open to everyone, whether taking part alone or with colleagues and friends. There are also special races, including Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet, for different ages and abilities. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is officially measured and runs through Uppsala
The 5 km and 2.5 km courses are popular but not officially measured
Option to participate as a team of 5
additional: Team registration for 5 people is available. An Excel template for large registrations can be downloaded. The 10 km course is officially measured, while the 5 km and 2.5 km distances are approximate. Dogs are welcome to participate. A shared picnic is offered after the race. Water stations are located along the course. Changing facilities and toilets are available. Medical services are on site. Race bibs are distributed before the start. The race highlights the importance of blood donation.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District in Koszalin. The 10 km route passes through charming woodland, with numerous uphill and downhill sections and a stretch alongside a deep ravine, making the race challenging and full of excitement. Every participant who completes the distance will receive a commemorative medal. The start and finish are at the car park by the educational trail, providing easy access and convenient logistics.

description:
The course winds around S:t Hans Backar in Lund. In the ultra classes, the goal is to run as many laps as possible in 6 hours. The 10 km runners complete 4 laps and the 5 km runners complete 2 laps. Extreme One runners complete one lap.

One lap is 2.55 km with 140 metres of elevation gain. This means 10.2 km and 560 m of elevation gain for the 10 km, and 5.1 km and 280 m of elevation gain for the 5 km. Each lap in the ultra classes is extended with a flat section where runners go out and back along the same route so they can cheer each other on. The ultra-class lap is 4.38 km in total.
course_highlights: The course runs through S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km, including an out-and-back section where runners can cheer each other on; ultra-class runners complete as many laps as possible in 6 hours
additional:
The ultra starts at 14:00; the other classes start from 17:45.
Registration is at
