name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-oriented running and Nordic walking event held in Mustla. The race follows a 5 km course, starting near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishing at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honour the memory of the legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races are held at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or in person on race day.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö Stadslopp is a community race that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The race takes you through the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö and offers a wonderful running experience filled with energy, community and joy. Proceeds from the race go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities, so taking part also supports a good cause. The start and finish are at Stora Torget in Eksjö, and the event has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race goes through one of Sweden’s most beautiful wooden towns
The course is available in several distances, including 10 km and 5 km fun runs
Start and finish at Stora Torget in Eksjö
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan beside the swimming pool. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Start times vary by class, with children’s races starting from 18:00 onwards; the men’s and women’s 10 km races start at 19:30, and the 5 km fun run starts at 19:50. Group registration is available by email, with invoicing. Results are published on the club’s website after the race. The race programme also includes a 1,000-metre youth race and a 600-metre children’s race. Proceeds support Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
description: Vilties bėgimas yra pilietinė iniciatyva, skirta kurti solidarumo ir vilties kultūrą onkologinių ligonių bei jų artimųjų palaikymui. Renginys vyksta Klaipėdos senamiestyje ir siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 0,2 km vaikams iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Bėgimas vyksta žiedinėmis trasomis, kurios leidžia dalyviams mėgautis miesto vaizdais ir kartu prisidėti prie svarbios socialinės misijos. Tai tradicinis renginys, suburiantis sportininkus ir bendruomenę vieningam tikslui.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race taking place on 30 May 2026 at Lake Harku beach. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are refreshment points along the course, which is marked and secured by a course marshal team. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome; they start in the last group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also issued and awards presented.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of courses, from short night runs to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which lead through the picturesque Roztocze countryside. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, combining sport, music, and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and first-timers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that stays with you for a long time. The event is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix and emphasizes good organization and enthusiastic support from spectators.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury w Gminie Juchnowiec Kościelny
description: The 13th Konopielka Run is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Dolny, scheduled for May 30 in 2026. The main 10 km race starts at noon, preceded by the traditional Family Run. After the competition, participants are invited to a social gathering in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, author of the novel “Konopielka.” The race pack includes a soft blanket that can be used for a picnic after the race. The event’s family-friendly and literary atmosphere makes it unique.

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forest. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and competing on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, highlighting its importance in the local running calendar.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żelkowo, Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage runners to use the training plans and expert support to prepare for the race as effectively as possible. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in the picturesque Masuria region, promoting running close to nature. The routes pass through forests and along lakes, giving participants the chance to enjoy the beauty of nature. The event attracts runners who value outdoor activity and the charm of Masurian landscapes.

name: Dolska Dycha
organizer: Centrum Promocji, Kultury i Sportu w Dolsku
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Dolsk. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometer. It runs through the Dolsk municipality with traffic closed to vehicles. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect aid stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the town and municipality of Dolsk.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races held amid the scenic natural surroundings of Eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes are marked according to cycling standards to make navigation easier. Distances include the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which features elements of ultra trail. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and local communities, and builds a community of runners in the spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The competition runs throughout the season and concludes with overall and team standings.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze National Park in Józefów. The race offers a variety of courses, from shorter distances to challenging 60 km and 120 km ultras, taking runners through the charming landscapes of Roztocze. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who want to discover lesser-known natural areas and take on off-road challenges. The organizers, the Janosik Race Series Foundation, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paperworkers’ Run is an annual running event established in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from all over Poland. The event accompanies Paperworkers’ Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra is a welcoming race in the deepest forests of Småland, featuring a scenic, hilly 6.7 km backyard loop and a 3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners. The event is organized by Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö, with a focus on community and charity; all proceeds go to charitable causes. The number of laps is limited to 15, creating a challenging but fun experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Hilly 6.7 km backyard loop in the forests of Småland
3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners
Nature-focused race with a charitable purpose
additional: The event runs from Saturday at 09:00 to Sunday at 00:00. The number of laps is limited to 15. All proceeds from the event go to charitable causes. Backyard laps start on the hour. Sources state that the 2026 edition started on Saturday at 09:00; information about the 2027 start time is unavailable.

name: Småland Adventure Race
description: A warm welcome to Småland Adventure Race 2027. After three fantastic years, we’re ready to take on a new challenge and aim for a race that’s at least as good as the last one. Småland Adventure Race is a multisport competition in which teams of 2–4 people use a map and compass to visit all checkpoints (CPs) as quickly as possible. CPs usually consist of a small physical orienteering marker and are marked with circles on the maps. The course will include a number of transition areas (TAs) where teams switch between disciplines. The race will mainly involve running, mountain biking and paddling, along with other adventures. In the three previous races, participants have paddled on air mattresses, climbed, tackled a high ropes course, gone SUPing and run a maze orienteering course. Some checkpoints have been at the top of climbing nets and others in the middle of a slackline, but most are in more accessible locations. We can promise many hours of wonderful adventure! We offer a long and a short class. Provisionally, teams in the long class will be out for 22–26 hours, and teams in the short class for 11–13 hours. In 2027, we’re also offering a Bike and Run class, a recreational class where you’ll be out for just 5–7 hours and take on a few fewer adventures—but still have a great time.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
description: Markaryd Savings Bank Race is a well-organized running race in Markaryd, organized by SK Graal. The race has strong local roots, with Markaryd Savings Bank as its main sponsor, and offers an enjoyable running experience for participants of different ages and levels. SK Graal also offers training opportunities ahead of the race and supports the local running community. The event is a popular tradition that brings together runners from near and far.
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 until 30 minutes before the start. SK Graal offers training sessions on Mondays and Thursdays at 18:00. SK Graal members receive a 15% discount on running shoes at Team Sportia in Markaryd. Held in conjunction with Markaryd’s spring market.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sweden
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon starting at Långe Erik Lighthouse on Öland, with three distances: 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km. The race offers a fantastic running experience along the coast of the Kalmar Strait, through meadows and forest, and across the unique Alvar limestone plain, with views of the Baltic Sea. The finish location depends on the distance: the 50 km finishes in Djupvik, the 50 miles in Lindby and the 100 miles at Långe Jan Lighthouse. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt as a memento.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse and finish at Långe Jan Lighthouse for the 100-mile race
Run along the coast of the Kalmar Strait and through meadows and forest
Views of the Baltic Sea and Öland’s unique Alvar limestone plain
additional: All distances start together on Friday at 15:00 at Långe Erik Lighthouse. Aid stations or energy stations are located approximately every 20 km along the course. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt. Get 15% off accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend when booking with the code Lighthouse Challenge. Medal and T-shirt for everyone who completes the race. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course; the official race website states that they are approximately 20 km apart. Published prices apply to 2026 and may change for 2027.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: “We Run, We Don’t Click! – Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026” is a charity 5 km race taking place on May 24, 2026, in the scenic Chojnów Landscape Park. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all abilities. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community engagement and support, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around scenic Lake Swarzędz, while the 10K offers a dynamic route with forest sections and urban stretches. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a well-stocked food zone, a partner expo, a post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km, and runs along a scenic route around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run to Celebrate the Ropczyce Region Days is a 10 km race taking place on May 31, 2026, in Ropczyce. Organized to mark a local celebration, this running event attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderate-distance course. The route passes through the scenic area of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience surrounded by beautiful natural scenery.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a celebratory road race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized to mark the 200th anniversary of the city being granted municipal rights. Races are held over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon (21 km) distances, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The route runs through the city streets and the municipality of Zapolice to the village of Brzeski in the municipality of Sędziejowice, where the half-marathon turnaround point is located. Several hundred runners take part in this urban road race.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Centre in Zawiercie. The event takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and features two distances: a main 10 km race and an accompanying 5 km race. The course runs along the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and is marked at every kilometre. The event aims to promote running and bring runners from across the country together.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Run for the Crown of Princess Dąbrówka is the 15th-anniversary edition of a running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft ground. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest race held in the picturesque forests of the Mazovia region, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sporting and recreational event combines competition with a love of nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available to runners of different ability levels, as well as to families and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The race has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, as participants in previous editions can attest.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is the 30th-anniversary edition of a nationwide road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport in this picturesque town. The road race attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an appealing course and professional organization.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The SGH Mokotów Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with support for those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants—students, alumni, local residents, and running enthusiasts. The route runs through the streets of Mokotów and finishes in the SGH Rector’s Gardens. Every step makes a real difference in the lives of those in need, thanks to the support of the “Akogo?” Foundation. It’s not just about sport, but also community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app by logging different physical activities, which are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and timeframe, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every milestone in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra-running festival held in Pabianice from May 29 to 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish Championships in their respective categories. The races attract long-distance runners with challenging courses and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the "O Co Biega" Sports Club from Pabianice.

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Szczytnie
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is a race covering approximately 21.1 km, taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route follows a cycling path along a former railway line and local roads, offering scenic views and well-prepared hydration and refreshment stations. The event is organized by the Szczytno County Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre and the Szczytno County Local Tourism Organization. In addition to the half marathon, there are children’s races and a 5 km race, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support people in need. The course follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking. Organizers provide electronic timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
description: Sieradz Cross Social Run is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, which promotes running and brings together the running community in the city of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, with markers every 500 m. The run lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and aimed at popularizing running, and participants receive electronic lap and time tracking.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual race organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event offers 10 km and 5 km running races, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march, with overall, age-group, and municipality residents’ classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held at the “Arena Mistrzów” Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for everyone, and prizes for the top finishers. For those who want to take part virtually, a virtual race option is available from May 27 to June 4, 2026.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer road race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of European community. The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowy Maj 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging exercise and bringing the local community together.

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
location: Olsztyn, Częstochowa County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running event held on 1 June at the Kolga-Jaani School stadium and sports fields. The event offers various distances and age categories suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete and celebrate family-friendly activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the light-traffic path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ yra unikalus penkių dienų bėgimo iššūkis Vilniuje, kuriame dalyviai gali įveikti penkis maratonus, pusmaratonius, 12,6 km arba 4,2 km distancijas iš eilės. Renginys skatina ištvermę, ryžtą ir kasdienį sugrįžimą į trasą, suteikdamas galimybę patirti tikrą etapinio bėgimo nuotykį. Tai pirmas tokio tipo renginys Lietuvoje, įkvėptas pasaulinės tradicijos, kuris vyksta Vingio parko estradoje. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti savo distanciją ir starto laiką, o renginį organizuoja VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ „100 marathon club Lithuania“.
course_highlights: Vingio parko estrada Vilniuje
Galimybė pasirinkti starto laiką 9:00 arba 15:00 pirmosiomis trimis dienomis 4,2 km ir 12,6 km distancijose
Penki startai per penkias dienas su skirtingomis distancijomis: maratonas, pusmaratonis, 12,6 km ir 4,2 km
additional: Varžybų laiko limitai: maratonui - 8 val., pusmaratoniui - 4 val., 12,6 km - 3 val., 4,2 km - 1 val. Trasos GPX failas prieinamas internete. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Už nepilnamečius atsako tėvai, globėjai arba treneriai. Renginio metu bus gaivinimo punktas trasoje. Dalyviai sutinka, kad jų nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais. Daugiadienis bėgimas, trasos Vilniaus Vingio parke, įvairios distancijos, registracija ir sveikatos patikrinimas būtinas.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night race held on Wydmińska Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to take on a 5-kilometer course in picturesque surroundings. The race combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers promise a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: LAMMASMÄE Estonian Night Run - Rakvere 2026 is a night running race taking place in Rakvere on June 12, 2026. This popular sporting event brings together running enthusiasts and offers an exciting, lively night-running experience. The race takes place amid the beautiful scenery around Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban environment at night.
course_highlights: Night run in Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied terrain
Lively and energetic race atmosphere
additional: The event includes a range of distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with ~70 meters elevation gain
Course runs through Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single/double tracks and gravel, day and night same loop
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. Minimum 7 loops (46.9 km) needed for award medal. Runners receive 3, 2, and 1-minute warnings before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. No showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents but are not the organizer's responsibility. Renginyje yra palapinių bazė ir pagalbos stotelės, tačiau yra apribojimų dėl pagalbos trasoje.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko stadione. Dalyviai turi galimybę varžytis kartu su greičiausiais Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikais, mėgautis gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera. Renginys siūlo įvairias rungtis, įskaitant individualius 5000 m bėgimus, 5x1000 m estafetę ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Tai puiki proga pagerinti savo asmeninį rezultatą ir patirti nepamirštamą palaikymą bei bendruomenės dvasią.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupių dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Renginio metu veiks maisto vagonėlis, o dalyviai sutinka, kad jų rezultatai ir foto/video medžiaga gali būti viešai skelbiami. Renginys vyksta Vilniaus Vingio stadione, dalyvių registracija vyksta renginio dieną, ir jame gali dalyvauti tiek profesionalūs, tiek mėgėjų bėgikai.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai Kaune kviečia miesto gyventojus ir svečius dalyvauti įvairiose nemokamose sporto veiklose. Renginyje siūlomos skirtingos bėgimo distancijos: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas, 1988 metrų lietuviškos olimpinės mylios bėgimas, 5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos. Be bėgimo, dalyviai gali išbandyti ekstremalų bėgimą su kliūtimis, orientavimosi sportą ir 3×3 krepšinio turnyrą. Šis renginys siekia suburti bendruomenes ir skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą, kartu suteikiant galimybę susitikti su profesionaliais sportininkais ir olimpiečiais.
course_highlights: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas
1988 metrų lietuviška olimpinė mylia
5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos
additional: Renginyje dalyviams bus išdalinta daugiau nei 15 tūkst. prizų. Taip pat galima dalyvauti edukaciniuose ir olimpinio švietimo renginiuose, žaidimuose bei susitikti su olimpiečiais. Renginys yra nemokamas ir orientuotas į masiškumą bei bendruomenių subūrimą. daugiau nei 100 veiklų, bėgimai, turnyrai, edukaciniai renginiai, koncertas, kino seansas

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is the largest mass-participation sports event in Ida-Viru County, taking place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve better times, and the event also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sports experience.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows paved roads around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. There are also shorter mini-distances and races for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporting and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The routes follow the motocross track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The organiser, Valgamaa Sports Association, welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who value scenic routes and a sporty atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race is divided into start groups with participant limits, ensuring a comfortable experience and smooth organization. Special emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpie Pśejåk Half Marathon is a run along the route of the SGO “Narew” combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with combat bunkers, giving the race a distinctive character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who appreciate both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpie region. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of the Running League, a platform promoting physical activity and running competition in Poland. The event is open to runners competing at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The Running League allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique road race set in the magical surroundings of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as Nordic walking, and there is also a special race for children, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Power Explorers”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packages.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners looking to set a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel. After the finish, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, mingling, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners set personal bests
additional: Water stations are available after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The start is provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Minimum age: 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival in Borgholm, held annually on July 15. The event offers several distances for all ages and levels, from Mini for the youngest runners to the 9 km main race. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event has a long history, dating back to its first edition in 1981, and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast and easy-to-run course
Beautiful coastal views
Live music at several locations along the course
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholm Sports Hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is live music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive a medal or commemorative plaque, depending on the race. Most races use disposable timing chips; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique experience of nature and running right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional supporting program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga Tauragėje yra šventinis renginys, kviečiantis dalyvauti visus bėgimo entuziastus kartu su šeima ir draugais. Tai puiki proga paminėti Tėvo dieną aktyviai ir smagiai, dalyvaujant miesto šventėje. Renginys vyksta Tauragės miesto šventės metu, suteikiant galimybę patirti bendruomeniškumą ir sportinę dvasią.
course_highlights: Šventinis bėgimas Tauragės miesto šventės metu
Draugiška atmosfera šeimoms ir draugams
Galimybė aktyviai paminėti Tėvo dieną
additional: Renginys yra dalis Tauragės miesto šventės, vyks lauke, ir skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį bei šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione. Renginys siūlo ne tik individualius 5000 m bėgimus, bet ir estafetinius bėgimus - 5x1000 m mišrią estafetę bei 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Dalyviai gali mėgautis gyva DJ muzika, šventiška atmosfera ir palaikymu, kuris padeda siekti geriausių rezultatų. Varžybos skirtos tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, o renginio organizatoriai siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje ir skatinti sportinę bendruomenę.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupės dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Po finišo dalyvių laukia maisto vagonėlis. Varžybų nugalėtojai ir prizininkai apdovanojami rėmėjų prizais ir piniginiais prizais už aukštus rezultatus. Varžybos vyks 2027 m. birželio 13 d., siūlomos įvairios kategorijos, įskaitant elitinius ir mėgėjų bėgikus, su išsamia tvarkaraščio informacija. Renginys skatina sporto populiarinimą ir šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
description: The Run Beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, recreational runners, and families, with races over various distances as well as a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and its tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and closeness to nature. The race takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and race village located in the heart of the plantation. The race is part of the Berry Relay and promotes mindful food choices and local products. It is not just a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Lake Zegrzyńskie, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the opportunity to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a unique character to the race.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
description: The 10th Festival of Runs of Northern Poland and Physical Activity in Wdzydze is a celebratory, tenth edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region. The event takes place on June 5–7, 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and celebrates local culture and nature. The programme includes races of various distances, Nordic walking, and cycling rallies.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie, organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, running through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous, fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can look forward to a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes will receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in various races, including children’s races and a team race. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a wonderful atmosphere, with activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected on site, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food bag after the finish, making it a fun, social running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with access to toilets and water refill stations
additional: Race bibs are collected on site in Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food bag after the finish. Toilets and water refill stations are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Race bibs are collected in Vasaparken. Teams of four can receive a food bag/picnic after the race.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throwing events and jumps. Each evening features one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium, and the IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their race bib is valid for the entire season.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“ yra tradicinis respublikinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Krakių miestelyje, Kėdainių rajone. Varžybos kviečia dalyvauti visus - nuo profesionalų iki pradedančiųjų ir mėgėjų, siūlant įvairius distancijų variantus pagal amžiaus grupes. Startas ir finišas yra miesto centre, Laisvės aikštėje, o renginys pasižymi draugiška atmosfera ir apdovanojimais įvairiose amžiaus kategorijose. Dalyviai vaišinami tradiciniu šiupiniu, o renginio metu galima žaisti medinius lauko žaidimus „LPA GAMES“.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Laisvės aikštėje, Krakių miestelyje
Skirtingos distancijos pagal amžiaus grupes: 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km
Krakių garbės rato 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ vaikams ir šeimoms
additional: Starto numeriai išduodami nuo 11:00 val. Varžybų atidarymas ir 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ prasideda 11:30 val. Visi dalyviai vaišinami Krakių bendruomenės centro pagamintu šiupiniu. Renginio metu galima žaisti medinius lauko žaidimus „LPA GAMES“. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai, jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai, greičiausi 10 km bėgimo dalyviai. registracija išankstinė internetu, starto mokesčio mokėjimas banku, įvairios distancijos ir amžiaus grupės, renginio metu taip pat vyksta žaidimai ir pramogos

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilcza 10K is a 10 km road race held in the recreational areas of Bilcza Park in the municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. On race day, children’s races and a family festival are also held. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and earn recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by offering refreshments after the race and awarding the winners.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway beneath the illuminated lights and setting sun, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring an Iskra aircraft, and prizes in the form of trophies and tandem-flight vouchers. After the run, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: The eighth nationwide “Prescription for Health” run will take place on June 13, 2026, at Arturówek in Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km race distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Shorter races for children and young people will be held on the same route. A family picnic with free screenings and consultations will take place near the start and finish.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in woodland surroundings. The course consists of a 5 km loop that runs along forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. A 1.5 km fun run without rankings is planned for children. The start and finish are located in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko in memory of Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until June 10, 2026.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyn zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open to runners with varying levels of experience who want to spend time actively and compete on a moderately challenging course. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the tradition of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June, recalling Józef Piłsudski’s settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the 3.6 km Halina Zielińska Memorial and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum professionals taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, beside Villa Bzów.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run Along the Trail of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating the historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere for participants.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.
