name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Öllsjö Running Festival is a family-friendly and welcoming recreational race for participants of all ages and a range of physical abilities. The event offers several distances, including children’s races and longer routes, and focuses on the joy of movement and community. It features music and activities for the whole family, as well as a team competition with chip timing. This recurring running festival creates a wonderful atmosphere in Öllsjö every June.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 450 m and 1,700 m
5 km and 7.5 km trail-mix races
Automatic chip timing and a team competition
additional: The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00. Bib pickup starts at 10:00. STC Härlöv leads warm-ups before the children’s races and the longer races. A candy shower for children takes place at 12:20. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:10 on the event area’s stage. Showers, changing facilities, and bag drop are available. The event has offered several different races and chip timing.

name: Alytaus maratonas 2026
location: Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkės, Alytus, Alytaus rajonas, Lithuania
description: Alytaus maratonas 2026 vyks 2026 m. birželio 14 d. Alytuje, Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą Lietuvoje ir garsinti Alytų, kviečiant tiek mėgėjus, tiek profesionalus varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m iki pilno maratono. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš kelių bėgimo ir šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijų, o trasos yra techniškai paruoštos varžyboms su elektroniniu laiko matavimu. Renginys organizuojamas VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir užtikrina saugias bei taisyklingas varžybas visiems dalyviams.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 500 m vaikų bėgimo iki 42,195 km maratono
Startas ir finišas prie Didžiosios Dailidės ežero Alytuje
Elektroninis laiko matavimas su mikroschema ant marškinėlių
additional: Varžybų dalyviams draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones trasoje. Laiko matavimas vykdomas elektronine mikroschema, kuri turi būti pritvirtinta ant marškinėlių priekinės dalies. Varžybų limitai: maratonui 6 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., 2 km - 0,5 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 5 val. Startai skirtingoms distancijoms: 12:00 val. daugeliui bėgimų, 16:30 val. 2 km bėgimui, 16:45 val. 500 m vaikų bėgimui. Renginyje bus įrengtos vandens ir maitinimo stotelės, dalyvių limitas - 300, ir įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir šeimų bėgimus. Registracija atidaroma balandžio 1 d. ir galioja iki pat renginio dienos.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Elblągu
description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office where participants can collect their race packs, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and compete on the city’s scenic routes.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of all ages and ability levels. The program includes children’s races, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sporting competition and community spirit.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children in Warmia and Mazury. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is suitable for everyone, including first-time runners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions. Taking part is not only a sporting competition, but above all a way to support children in need. The main race is scheduled to start at 16:30, and the scenic course is also accessible to those who prefer walking.

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas yra bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Ragožių kaime, Jonavos rajone. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, skirtas aktyviems sporto mėgėjams, siūlantis įvairias distancijas ir galimybę išbandyti savo ištvermę bei jėgas. Renginys yra atviras visiems, norintiems aktyviai praleisti laiką ir mėgautis bėgimu gamtoje. Organizuoja Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, kuri rūpinasi sklandžia varžybų eiga ir dalyvių patogumu.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Ragožių kaimo apylinkėse
Skirtingos distancijos pritaikytos įvairaus lygio bėgikams
Gamta ir natūralios trasos suteikia malonų bėgimo potyrį
additional: Renginys yra atviras visiems aktyviems ir sportiškiems Lietuvos žmonėms. Tarp skirtingų distancijų ir kliūčių ruožų kiekvienas gali rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį ar pramogą. Nėra specifinės informacijos apie renginio trasą ar dalyvių skaičių; registracijos vyksta per oficialią platformą.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held on the Baltic Sea, amid the picturesque surroundings of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete over the middle distance, which includes a 1.9 km swim in the Bay of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km bike course across the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for competition. The event is an official qualifying race and takes place on June 19–21, 2026.

name: Nocny Bieg Firmowy Warszawa
description: The Night Corporate Run in Warsaw is a charity relay for five-person company teams, taking place on June 19, 2026, at Służewiec Racecourse. Each participant covers approximately 5 km after dark, and the team’s combined time determines the result. It’s a unique opportunity to spend an evening in an engaging nighttime atmosphere while supporting children from the Everest Foundation. The event combines sport, fun, and social support to create an unforgettable experience for participants.

name: 17 Legionowska Dycha
description: The 17th Legionowo Ten is an annual 10 km race taking place on June 19, 2026, in Legionowo. The start and finish are located outside Arena Legionowo. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is intended for adults and people over 16 who meet the rules and regulations. The event also includes an accompanying race, “Uniformed Services Ten,” for uniformed services personnel and enthusiasts. Participants can expect electronic timing and a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes to complete the course.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: Birštono pusmaratonis. Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas.
location: Birštonas, Birštono savivaldybė, Kauno apskritis, Lithuania
organizer: Všį Birštono sportas, Asociacija Sporto renginiai
description: Birštono pusmaratonis Powered by Vytautas yra kasmetinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Birštone, kuris suburia tiek pradedančiuosius, tiek patyrusius bėgikus. Renginio metu siūlomos kelios distancijos, įskaitant pusmaratonį, 10 km bėgimą, kuris tuo pačiu yra Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas, 5,2 km bėgimą ir estafetę. Trasa veda per miesto centrą, Nemuno pakrantę, promenadą ir Žvėrinčiaus miško prieigas, suteikdama galimybę mėgautis tiek rezultatu, tiek aplinka. Birštonas garsėja savo sveikatingumo tradicijomis, o šis renginys skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Trasa veda per miesto centrą, Nemuno pakrantę ir promenadą
Pusmaratonis sudarytas iš 4 ratų, 10 km bėgimas - 2 ratai
Estafetė 2x5 km mišri (1 vyras + 1 moteris)
additional: Startai: 10 km bėgimas 9:00 Basanavičiaus aikštėje, pusmaratonis 9:05 Jaunimo g., 5,2 km bėgimas 9:05, estafetė 2x5 km 9:05, vaikų 800 m bėgimas 12:15. Dalyvių avalynė turi atitikti LLAF rekomendacijas. 10 km čempionato dalyviams būtinas galiojantis antidopingo mokymų sertifikatas. Registracija tik savo vardu, numerio perdavimas draudžiamas. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu darytos nuotraukos ir filmuotė gali būti naudojamos rinkodarai be atskiro sutikimo. Renginio dalyviams siūloma registruotis užpildant formą, o renginio taisyklėse nurodyta, kad 10 km bėgime būtina turėti doping kontrolės pažymėjimą. Renginyje taip pat vyksta apdovanojimai ir rėmėjų dovanos.

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: Pasvalio maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Pasvalio mieste, kuris siekia populiarinti bėgimą tarp jaunimo ir suaugusiųjų bei skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Renginys vyksta Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadione, kur dalyviai varžosi maratono, pusmaratono ir vaikų bėgimo distancijose. Trasos ilgis ir ratai pritaikyti skirtingoms distancijoms, o trasoje kas 5 km įrengtos vandens ir maitinimo stotelės. Dalyviai apdovanojami prizais ir atminimo medaliais, o renginys yra dalis Pasvalio miesto šventės „Vys par to ãlo“ programos.
course_highlights: 10 km trasa, maratonui 4 ratai, pusmaratoniui 2 ratai
Vandens ir maitinimo stotelės kas 5 km
Startas ir finišas Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadione
additional: Numeriai išduodami nuo 8:00 val. Pasvalio stadione. Vaikų 400 m bėgimas startuoja 11:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimus arba paraiškas su gydytojo viza arba už savo sveikatą varžybų metu atsako patys. Dalyviai, pasiekę finišą per kontrolinį laiką, gauna atminimo medalius. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, dalyvių laukia medaliai, diplomai, prizai ir vaišės.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Parish Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. The event features various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and advanced athletes. It is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Parish.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: The 38th Around Lake Saadjärv Run takes place on June 20, 2026, in Kukulinn, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows a paved road and has three water stations to keep participants well supplied during the event. In addition to the main run, children’s races are held in different age groups, along with a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the top participants are awarded prizes by age group. This traditional, well-organized event offers an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique street race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno. The 21.0975 km course is flat and fast, making it ideal for setting personal bests. Participants can expect professional organisation, certified timekeeping, well-stocked refreshment stations and comprehensive medical support. After the race, every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. It’s an unforgettable experience under the stars in a nighttime atmosphere.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival taking place on June 20, 2026, in Huwniki in the Przemyśl Foothills. The event offers summer courses of 10, 24, 48, and 75 km, winding through scenic forests, meadows, and mountain pastures, and combining sporting competition with the rich cultural dimension of the Wianki festival. The race is for runners seeking adventure and a connection with nature, away from crowded mountain trails. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort by providing transport, refreshment points, and accommodation options nearby.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race taking place on June 13, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The event is held on a tartan track, with the start scheduled for 18:00. The race is divided into heats according to participants’ predicted times, allowing for smooth organization and competition at an appropriate level. The organizer is Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and the participant limit is 200. All runners over the age of 15 are invited to take part in this sporting event.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain half marathon held in Koszalin, on a scenic route around Chełmska Mountain. Participants can choose between a distance of 10.55 km and the full 21.1 km half marathon, which consists of two loops. The start and finish are near the sanctuary and observation tower on Chełmska Mountain, and the route passes through forested areas with scenic views. The event is charitable, and donations support the work of the “SFX” Association.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: The Two Towers Run is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The route follows an unpaved road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. The event is well organized, with water stations along the route and a recovery meal at the finish.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a prestigious middle-distance triathlon held on the Baltic coast in the beautiful setting of Gdańsk. Athletes start from the city beach, completing a 1.9 km swim, a fast, flat 90 km cycling route through the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is on a unique city pier, making the finale unforgettable. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The 6th St. John’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zawichost. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic, moderately challenging course. The organizers encourage runners to prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in Night Street Running is an annual sporting event organized by Łomża Academy under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Łomża. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. on the streets of Łomża, with two course options: 10 km, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), and 5 km, uncertified. The event commemorates the founding of Łomża Academy and promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants must be at least 18 years old, and the time limit for completing the course is 1.5 hours.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Race for the Blue Ribbon is an annual running event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club and held on the streets of Stargard. The main race starts at 21:00, creating a unique atmosphere for night running. The course starts at the Amphitheatre and circles the Jewel of Pomerania, offering views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. The event promotes health, fitness, and positive energy, encouraging an active lifestyle.

name: Zielonka Challenge
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual long-distance running event and Nordic walking race held in the picturesque Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, along forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organization, well-stocked aid stations, and unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event center is in Owińska near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on June 20, 2026.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Mano MAMA juda – Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026
description: Mano MAMA juda - Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026 yra šeimoms ir bėgimo entuziastams skirtas renginys, vykstantis Gelgaudiškio dvaro parke ir apylinkėse. Renginio tikslas - populiarinti bėgimo sportą Šakių rajone ir skatinti fizinį aktyvumą. Trasą sudaro miško takeliai ir asfaltas, o bėgimo metu įrengti spalvų punktai suteikia papildomo džiaugsmo dalyviams. Varžybos vyksta birželio 21 d., siūlant 400 m vaikų bėgimą, 5 km ir 10 km distancijas.
course_highlights: 5 km ratas pagrinde miško takais
10 km distancija - du 5 km ratai
Trasos danga - miško takeliai ir asfaltas
additional: Numerių išdavimas vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 10:00 val. Vaikų 400 m bėgimas startuoja 10:00 val., 5 km ir 10 km distancijos startuoja 10:30 val. Apdovanojimai numatyti 12:00 val. Nepilnamečiai dalyviai privalo turėti raštišką tėvų ar globėjų sutikimą. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu darytos nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiagą organizatoriai gali naudoti rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys apima spalvų bėgimą, įvairias distancijas, iššūkius ir reljefo įvairovę. Dalyvių rezultatai fiksuojami profesionalia laiko matavimo sistema, tačiau svarbiausia - patirtis ir emocijos.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: 55-asis bėgimas „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“ yra tradicinis pusės maratono bėgimas Elektrėnų savivaldybėje, vykstantis gražioje Elektrėnų miesto aplinkoje. Renginys suburia sporto entuziastus ir aktyvaus laisvalaikio mėgėjus, siūlydamas galimybę bėgti aplink didžiulį Elektrėnų marių tvenkinį. Tai puiki proga pažinti Elektrėnų krašto gamtą ir istoriją, mėgaujantis sportu ir bendruomeniškumu. Renginys vyksta birželio mėnesį, tradiciškai prasideda ryte ir tęsiasi iki popietės.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together fitness enthusiasts and recreational runners from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking opportunities. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Cross-Country Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest, reflecting the organisers’ care for participants’ comfort and safety.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and drag their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations every 400 metres along the course, as well as toilets, making the run more comfortable and supporting athletes’ well-being. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Gryf Arena Run
organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"
description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The race route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races ranging from 100 to 600 meters, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
X Bieg STO-nogi
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by the wayside shrine and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5, at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
organizer: Grupa Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY, Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, comprising two identical loops with a total distance of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and hydration stations are located along the course approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable and supports the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run takes place in the wooded areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied surfaces, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the pavement or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top women and men in each distance receive trophies.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the scenic area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race runs through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. The event also includes free children’s races, making it a family-friendly and inclusive occasion. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and race packages with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“ yra renginys, skirtas skatinti visuomenę tapti vyresnių vaikų globėjais ir keisti neigiamas nuostatas apie globojamus vaikus. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, startas ir finišas yra prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų. Renginys skirtas atkreipti dėmesį į globėjų šeimų laukiančius vyresnius nei 10 metų vaikus ir viešinti globos centro teikiamas paslaugas. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį.
course_highlights: 5 km distancija - 2 ratai po 2,5 km
Startas ir finišas prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų
Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, prie paminklo S. Dariui ir S. Girėnui
additional: Varžybose yra trys distancijos: 500 m (gimę 2014 m. ir jaunesni, startas 18:30), 1 km (startas 18:45) ir 5 km (startas 19:05). Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami nugalėtojai ir prizininkai įvairiose amžiaus grupėse, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį. Dalyviams ir palaikantiems asmenims draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą varžybų metu. Registracija vyksta internetu, renginys skirtas vaikams ir jaunimui, siekiant skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir socialinį įsitraukimą

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place on 22 June 2026 in Tori Parish, with the race centre located by the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organised in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and its supporters. This traditional and legendary race offers athletes a varied and memorable experience.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommar 2027 is a personal and unique trail race held on the longest day of the year in Sollentuna, Stockholm. The race starts early in the morning at 02:00 and offers 30 kilometres of wonderful trail running at dawn, as participants meet the light along the way. With a maximum of 100 participants, the race focuses on the experience and the chance to enjoy nature as it awakens. Navigation is by GPS route and map, and a generous breakfast is served after the finish so participants can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, welcoming the summer light
Two aid stations along the course
Navigation by GPS route and map
additional: Maximum 100 participants for a personal experience. Start and finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Take the commuter train to Rotebro station and walk 1.5 km to the start/finish. Parking at Sollentuna Golf Club, followed by a 500 m walk. Registration is open until one hour before the start. Minimum age: 18. Breakfast is served after the race. Participant numbers are limited. A generous breakfast is served after the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.nighttrailrun.se/om-sommartrail): 2027-06-21 — "Måndag 21 juni 2027. Start klockan 02.00." (was estimated 2027-06-20)

name: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Sudeikių miestelyje, Utenos rajone, Joninių nakties išvakarėse. Maratonas suteikia galimybę sporto entuziastams patirti unikalią atmosferą ir išbandyti savo ištvermę gražioje gamtos aplinkoje prie Sudeikių ežero. Renginys prasideda vakare, birželio 23 dieną, 19:30 val., ir kviečia dalyvius bei žiūrovus į aktyvų ir smagų sporto vakarą.
course_highlights: Vyksta Sudeikių miestelyje prie Sudeikių ežero
Renginio pradžia Joninių nakties išvakarėse, birželio 23 d. 19:30 val.
Maratonas vyksta Utenos rajone, gamtos apsuptyje
additional: Registracija vykdoma per oficialią svetainę su galimybe prisijungti per Facebook. Renginys vyksta Joninių nakties išvakarėse, todėl startas numatytas vakare. Renginio vieta pažymėta Google Maps nuoroda Sudeikių miestelyje. Renginys apima ne tik bėgimą, bet ir kitus aktyvius užsiėmimus, registracija vyksta internetu, ir jis yra svarbi vietinė sporto šventės dalis.

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia Reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race route circles the scenic Karksi-Nuia Reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners and offers a chance to enjoy an active day with the community.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Solstice Runs are an annual series of races consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the stages in the series and takes place in the Loode oak forest in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a cycle and pedestrian path and forest trails, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink at the finish.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on June 22, 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 kilometers through the town’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån River and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances, and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket. This annual running celebration is organized by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometers through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course consists of three laps: the first along the Storån River and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighborhood
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday, June 21, from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top flap of the race bib is the timing chip. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket, served on the grass. On-site late registration is available at ICA Supermarket on June 21 from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Only Swish is accepted for on-site late registration. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday, June 22, with a 19:00 start. All participants receive a medal. Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping or on race day in Brunnsparken. Late registration costs an additional 50 kronor.

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in Rõuge Nightingale Valley, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers who want to spend their time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organises the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of exercise while enhancing their well-being.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a traditional community celebration and running race held every year on the Friday after Midsummer in the beautiful summer town of Trosa. The race offers categories for all ages and ability levels, from young children to elite runners, on a varied course through the town centre and close to the water. Chip timing and several start groups create a welcoming, race-friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners. Trosa Stadslopp is known for its positive atmosphere, enthusiastic spectators and compact course, creating a unique running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through summery Trosa, close to the water
Chip timing with two intermediate timing points in the 8.9 km race
Competitive and recreational categories for all ages and ability levels
additional: Race bibs with disposable chips are handed out from 10:00 on race day at Team Sportia Trosa. The cutoff time to reach the lap point in the 8.9 km race is 40 minutes. Start groups are available for elite runners, and runners in categories 1 and 2 can choose their start group. The jogging and Nordic walking events start shortly before the competitive categories. Parking is available, with a voluntary fee supporting youth activities. All runners receive 50 cl of Vitamin Well at the finish of the 8.9 km and 4 km races. Registration is available via the race’s registration portal; late and on-site registration have specific dates and fees.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race began as a stair run and has been called the Promenade Run since 2021. The event offers various distances, from short races for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-oriented and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and important contributions from supporters and volunteers.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will take place on 26–27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa County, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Akkekula (Nut Hill) sports complex. Organized by the non-profit sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with finishers eligible for ITRA points. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and runner-friendly, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian city.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Sławice, Mazowieckie Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, crossing varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and dirt trails, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is challenging and offers beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided into age and gender categories.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew in honor of the Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl underneath them. Held once a year in June, the race attracts people who want to challenge their limits and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to explore the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic walking event held in Unisław as part of the Unisław Days celebrations. The race route follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic walking enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this sporting event.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
description: The 37th Jan Marek St John’s Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, taking place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special sporting event.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, with distances from 0.9 km to the marathon (42.2 km). The race takes place amid the idyllic summer scenery of Kristianopel and offers opportunities to enjoy running and set personal records. Team Blekinge provides enthusiastic support and cheerful encouragement along the course. Make a day of it with some relaxing time in the picturesque town, which has swimming spots, restaurants and cafés. In 2027, the race will also host the Swedish Veteran Championships in the marathon.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the marathon and half marathon
Courses through idyllic summer scenery around Kristianopel
Children’s races and Sommarlunken, a 4 km untimed event
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Standard registration can be paid for by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Distances have assigned bib number series and colour codes, but late registrants may receive a different colour code. Sommarlunken is an untimed 4 km course with no medal; prizes are awarded by draw. Kristianopel offers swimming spots, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The Swedish Veteran Championships in the marathon will be held in conjunction with the race in 2027. Registration opens in January 2027; late registration on race day is available from 08:00, subject to availability. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a half marathon offering a fast, single-lap course through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. Runners pass, among other places, the Tegelviken allotment area, Stensö fishing harbour, Kalmarsund Park with Kalmar Castle in the foreground, and areas around Ängöleden and Skälby. The race is open to both men and women and is known for many runners setting personal records here. There is also a 5 km fun run, Malkars Femman, open to everyone, whether they walk, run or roll. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Single-lap course through Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings
Passes Kalmarsund Park with Kalmar Castle in the foreground
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 18 km and the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Kalmar Malkars Västra, Torsåsgatan, on Friday, June 26, from 15:00 to 17:00 and Saturday, June 27, from 12:00 to 15:00. Late registration is possible until June 25 and then at race-bib collection. Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by June 20 receives a shirt with the Kalmar Malkars logo at race-bib collection. ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Timing and prize-giving are provided for the men’s and women’s categories. All finishers receive a medal. For 2026, the start is listed as 15:00. Refreshment stations are located after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish. A shirt is included for half-marathon runners who register by the final ordinary registration date. Prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Kristianopel Runt 10 km
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kristianopel Runt is part of the running festival in Kristianopel, organised by Team Blekinge LF. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a marathon, with 10 km being a popular distance. The courses pass through idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheers from the race marshals. Participants can combine running with relaxing in picturesque Kristianopel, which offers swimming, restaurants and cafés. This year’s event also includes the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships, adding to the competitive excitement.
course_highlights: Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Several distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the 10 km Kristianopel Runt
Courses with colour-coded number series and family-friendly races
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Payment for regular registration can be made by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Number series and colour codes are used for the different distances. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The organiser’s website lists the 10 km start time as 11:00 and says that electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. It also states that the 2027 race will take place on 3 July, which differs from the date in the race metadata.

name: Muraste jooks
description: The Muraste Run is part of the Harku Municipality running series and takes place on June 28, 2026, at Muraste School Stadium. The course runs along Muraste’s streets and shared-use paths, on marked roads open to traffic. A variety of distances are offered for both children and adults, as well as a family competition. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each age group, and participants who complete the series receive a season medal. The event is organized by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and an active lifestyle.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charity running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at the Kose song festival grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The series aims to bring the community together and make the joy of exercise accessible to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a small-scale, non-commercial trail running event held amid the scenic natural surroundings of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes pass through pristine forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The race is held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultramarathon. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and connections among runners from different backgrounds.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The best runners will be presented with awards after the races. The event is part of a running series and offers starter packages to the first people to register.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer programme, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. An accommodation offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in the race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active people from spring to autumn, offering a chance to test their abilities in different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place on 4 July at Emumäe. The series aims to popularise running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: The Võhma health trail marathon is a trail marathon held on the health trail in the town of Võhma. The course is a 620-metre loop that must be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 9:00, and offers participants a medal, timekeeping, course support, refreshments at the finish, and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, there is an opportunity to run a shorter distance for free and without timekeeping, suitable for everyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running competition held in Viljandi. The event takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances vary from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a small section on soft terrain. The series also includes mini distances and runs for young children, suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different abilities. Navi Run is part of a broader initiative to promote physical activity, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporty day and the joy of movement.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The 34th Beach Run in Jarosławiec is an annual running event organized by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Postomino. The race follows a scenic route along the beach, offering participants a unique seaside running experience. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a sporting atmosphere and promoting active leisure. The event has a long tradition and is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“
location: Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, Kaišiadorys, Lithuania
price_range: 4,- EUR iki 20,- EUR, registracijos ir dalyvio mokesčiai priklauso nuo distancijos ir registracijos laiko

tiers.description: amžiaus grupės M20, M30, M40, M50, V20, V30, V40, V50 – 8,- EUR

late_fee.price: 10 EUR (500 m ir 1 km), 20 EUR (8 km)
