description: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“ skirta paminėti Valstybės (Lietuvos karaliaus Mindaugo karūnavimo) dieną. Renginys vyks Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštėje ir apims įvairias amžiaus grupes bei distancijas, suteikiant galimybę bėgikams varžytis ir mėgautis bėgimu miesto gatvėse bei pažintiniuose takuose. Organizatoriai kviečia visus bėgimo mėgėjus dalyvauti ir populiarinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Varžybų metu bus filmuojama ir fotografuojama, o dalyviai sutinka, kad medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais.
course_highlights: Varžybų vieta - Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, miesto gatvės, Girelės pažintinis takas, Gandriuko takas
Skirtingos distancijos nuo 436 m iki 8 km, pritaikytos įvairioms amžiaus grupėms
Naktinis bėgimas su galimybe įsigyti specialius bėgimo marškinėlius
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas varžybų vietoje nuo 17:00 val. iki 20:45 val. priklausomai nuo distancijos. Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centro ugdytiniams ir darbuotojams dalyvio mokestis netaikomas. Galima įsigyti specialius bėgimo marškinėlius (šviesius arba tamsius) už 15 EUR. Varžybų metu būtina laikytis saugumo reikalavimų. Bėgimo vieta Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė ir aplinkinės vietovės, registracija varžybų dieną, marškinėlių pardavimas, įvairios distancijos

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu Series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has good footing and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by the Joosu Recreational Sports Club, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place on 11 July 2026 at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting recreational triathlon experience. The main distance consists of a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain-bike ride and a 4 km run, which runs largely along the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and aid stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre; one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km cycling course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are staggered in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each start. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, aid-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, access to a sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre and a place to change clothes in the sauna anteroom. The swim number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is allowed during the cycling leg. Trail course, family races, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Resort on Saturday, July 11, 2026. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in a beautiful park setting. Participants are provided with a medal, a race bib, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course on a route of up to 10 km. The event takes place on July 11, 2026, in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a medal as a keepsake. Free parking and hot soup after the run are provided for participants.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

name: V-asis maratonas „Vilniaus tiltai“
location: Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Maratonas „Vilniaus Tiltai“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Vilniaus laisvalaikio zonoje prie Baltojo tilto. Renginyje dalyviai gali varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m bėgimo iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Trasos vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus, suteikdamos unikalų miesto vaizdą bėgikams. Renginys skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams, populiarinant bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir garsinant Vilnių.
course_highlights: Trasa vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus
Maratono distancija sudaryta iš 4 ratų po 10,6 km
Galimybė varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki 42,195 km
additional: Numerių išdavimas prasideda 6:45 val. Maratono, pusmaratonio ir 10,6 km distancijų dalyvių apšilimas 7:50 val. Yra apdovanojimai vyrų ir moterų maratono distancijose, taip pat gausiausios ir ištvermingiausios komandų nominacijos. Laiko limitai: maratonui 7 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 6 val. Varžybų vieta - Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto; būtina registracija ir sveikatos patikrinimas; renginys skatina bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Subcarpathian Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing together Chamber members and their families. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event features 10 km races, a 7 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring together the civil engineering community. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and fun at the finish.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of track and field events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine the rankings. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied track and field experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai atviras bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos vyksta penkiais etapais skirtingose vietovėse, kur bėgikai varžosi tarpusavyje ir renka taškus bendram įvertinimui. Kiekvienas etapas turi savo trasą ir starto laiką, o dalyvavimas yra nemokamas. Turnyrą organizuoja Jonavos sporto centras kartu su Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija ir kitais partneriais.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse
Trasos nuo 6 km iki 8,4 km ilgio
Startas vakare, 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas prieš varžybas
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai internetu. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Varžybų trasos gali kirstis su kelių eismu, todėl dalyviai privalo laikytis kelių eismo taisyklių. 5 etapų serija, registracija internetu, atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio dalyviams, startai dažniausiai 19:30 val.

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis 2026
description: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis yra unikalus bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Trakų pilies apylinkėse. Varžybų startas yra Karaimų gatvėje, o finišas - Birutės gatvėje prie bažnyčios. Renginys pritraukia bėgimo entuziastus, kurie mėgaujasi nepakartojama atmosfera ir gražia Trakų aplinka. Registracija vyksta internetu iki liepos 17 dienos, o dalyvių numerius galima atsiimti likus dienai iki varžybų.
course_highlights: Startas Karaimų g. 13
Finišas Birutės g. 4 prie bažnyčios
Trakų pilies apylinkės ir naktinė atmosfera
additional: Dalyvių numerius ir laiko matavimo elektronines mikroschemas atsiimti galima liepos 18 d. nuo 17 val. Trakuose, Birutės g. 4. Vakarinis naktinis bėgimas, trasa su kalniukais, apšviesta Trakų pilis, pusiasalis, muziejai, cerkvė, Lukos ežeras, startas prie pusiasalio pilies, distancijos: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, vaikų 500 m bėgimas, rekomenduojama pasiruošti ir mityba.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various running competitions in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Municipality Summer Run, takes place on 18 July 2026 at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and support an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lakes Runs is a traditional running series made up of several stages around different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run, taking place on 18 July 2026, is the series’ sixth stage. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers several distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical laps measuring 42,195 m, while the half marathon is one 21,097 m lap; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with support from the City of Szczecin and port partners.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on July 18, 2026, in the scenic Elbląg Upland area by the Vistula Lagoon. The route follows wild trails through varied elevation and quiet, natural surroundings, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a comprehensive race pack.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, taking place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the opportunity to test their fitness over a distance of 5 km.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Kosewo, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special summer edition.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, along a scenic route through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience level, can find a suitable route. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the remarkable atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, sociable atmosphere.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people over the age of 15. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and participants can expect professional event support and timekeeping.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, commemorating the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants, who take part in the 5- and 10-kilometer races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The race starts in waves and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th St. James Street Run is an annual sporting event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The race follows a certified 10 km course through the city streets, with appropriate security provided by the authorities. The ceremonial start takes place at Pokoju Square, and the race start is on Armii Krajowej Street. The finish is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and obey traffic regulations.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the location. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which brings together a passion for running and exploring the natural environment of the Strzyżów Foothills. The routes pass through scenic, diverse landscapes, including old deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the chance to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępina, as well as admire the Brzeżanka range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Mount Chełm. It is the region’s largest running event, attracting trail running and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

name: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“
description: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“ yra seniausias Lietuvoje tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas, skirtas pagerbti Medininkų pasienio poste prie memorialo žuvusius. Renginys vyksta liepos mėnesį, startuojant prie Medininkų memorialo. Estafetė susideda iš 7 etapų po 5 km asfaltuoto kelio, kur dalyviai bėga komandose. Tai išskirtinė proga dalyvauti istorinėje ir prasmingoje sporto šventėje, jungiančioje Medininkus ir Vilnių.
course_highlights: 7 × 5 km estafetė asfaltuotu keliu
Startas prie Medininkų memorialo
Trasa skirta pagerbti pasienio poste žuvusius
additional: Renginį organizuoja Policijos departamentas prie Vidaus reikalų ministerijos, Muitinės departamentas ir LBMA. Renginio rezultatai bus skelbiami oficialioje organizatorių svetainėje. Renginys vyksta asfaltuotu keliu, todėl rekomenduojama tinkama bėgimo avalynė. name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas yra unikalus bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, vykstantis Smiltynėje, Klaipėdoje. Renginys vyksta per Jūros šventę ir suteikia dalyviams nepakartojamų įspūdžių bėgant tarp jūros ir kopų. Varžybos populiarina bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų ir mėgautis nuostabia pajūrio gamta bei švelniu vėju.
course_highlights: Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu
Startas paplūdimyje prie pietinio molo, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distancijos 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km ir 10 km su 2 valandų laiko limitu
additional: Visoms distancijoms skirtas 2 valandų laiko limitas. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą ir pritvirtintą numerį bei elektroninę laiko matavimo mikroschemą ant marškinėlių. Varžybų dalyviai bėga laisva valia ir prisiima visą su dalyvavimu susijusią riziką. Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, įvairios distancijos (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), registracija internetu, nuostatai ir taisyklės, apdovanojimai ir atminimo medaliai.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail run in Southern Estonia, held around the Leigo Lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the event offers a choice of distances and difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths along the lakeshore, with technical climbs and descents and beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. It includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying events such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. The organizers offer a full program and attractive prizes, and the course runs through charming health resort grounds.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka — Summer Edition is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal shaped like a water lily, and the main race starts at 10:00.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual abilities to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and race planning.

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day offers running, food, ice cream, swimming and a wonderful atmosphere. The half-marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog class in which dogs receive an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half-marathon, 21 km around all of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken, 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan, 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: The start and finish are at Svängens Krog. Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half-marathon start at 13:00. There are energy stations and encouragement around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunk participants are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half-marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with another 30 places released later. A dedicated taxi boat runs between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as does Vaxholmsbåt route #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. There will be an evening dinner and party at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half-marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olümpiastarti is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletic Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in various age groups and include a range of athletics events. The 10th stage takes place on July 29, 2026, at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun, motivating competition environment.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the beauty of their settings. The organizers aim to promote running and offer participants a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run, and the Polish 10 km Championships.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle course race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It’s a challenge for the whole family, including children, offering unusual entertainment and the opportunity to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among the elite events of its kind in Poland and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
description: The Wronka Run along the Way of St. James is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The competition includes various age categories, including 500 m races for children and main races of 5 and 10 km on gravel roads. Organizers provide a race pack containing a bib, medal, and voucher for a post-race meal. The event is family-friendly and community-oriented, with routes passing through the charming countryside around Wronka.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s scenic surroundings. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place on August 2, 2026, at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the joy of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate trail-running event organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event in Narewka offers two race distances: Szpurt (7 km) and Wertep (16.6 km), along scenic routes marked with course signs and featuring an aid station. Participants can expect electronic timing, commemorative medals, and a hot post-race meal. The event emphasizes ecology and the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
organizer: Gminne Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury w Krasnopolu
description: Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól is a forest race held in the Krasnopol municipality, offering courses of approximately 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs exclusively along forest gravel and grass roads, offering a connection with nature and pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre in Krasnopol, and the race starts in the afternoon. The event is open to all and is organised for people who enjoy outdoor activities.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti, vyks 2026 m. rugpjūčio 8 d. Jurbarke, Nemuno gatvėje. Varžybose kviečiami dalyvauti tiek vaikai, tiek jaunimas, tiek suaugusieji, siūlomos trys distancijos: 400 m, 3 km ir 12 km. Renginys prasideda 11 val., o visi finišavę dalyviai bus apdovanoti atminimo dovanomis, o geriausi sportininkai - taurėmis. Tai puiki proga aktyviai paminėti Nemuno metus ir bėgti kartu gražioje gamtos aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Trijų distancijų pasirinkimas: 400 m, 3 km ir 12 km
Varžybos vyksta Nemuno gatvėje, Jurbarke
12 km distancija susideda iš 4 ratų
additional: Dalyvių numerių išdavimas nuo 10:00 val. Amžiaus grupės pagal distancijas: 400 m - B12/M12 (2014 m. ir jaunesni), 3 km - B14/M14, B18/M18 (vyresni be konkurencijos), 12 km - vyrai ir moterys skirtingose amžiaus grupėse. Visi finišavę dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo dovanomis, geriausi - taurėmis. bėgimų distancijos: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; amžiaus grupės; išankstinė registracija; renginio dieną registruotis nebus galima

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“ yra naktinis bėgimo renginys, skirtas visiems aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo mėgėjams - nuo šeimų ir pradedančiųjų iki patyrusių bėgikų. Renginys vyksta Šilutėje, su apšviesta naktine trasa, muzika, atmosfera ir įvairiomis pramogomis. Dalyviai gali rinktis 1 km šeimų, vaikų ir augintinių bėgimą arba 5 km ir 10 km distancijas. Renginio metu dalyvių lauks finišo medaliai, prizai greičiausiems ir skanus maistas.
course_highlights: Apšviesta naktinė trasa
Vieta: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distancijos: 1 km, 5 km ir 10 km
additional: Renginio programa: 18:00 numerių atsiėmimas, 19:30 oficialus renginio atidarymas, 20:00 1 km šeimų, vaikų ir augintinių bėgimas, 21:30 5 km ir 10 km bėgimai. Dalyviams bus muzika, prizai greičiausiems, įvairios pramogos ir skanus maistas. Registracija vyksta iki 2026 m. rugpjūčio 7 d. Renginio programa apima įvairias distancijas ir pramogas, dalyviams suteikiami medaliai ir prizai.

name: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas 2026

price_tiers.distance: Bėgimo rungtys (1 km, 4 km, 8 km, 16 km, estafetė 2x4 km)

description: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas yra unikalus vasaros naktinis bėgimas Druskininkuose, kviečiantis dalyvius patirti bėgimo ritmą po žvaigždėmis. Renginys pasižymi spalvinga atmosfera, muzika, šviesos efektais ir vaizdinga trasa aplink Druskonį. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant bėgimą, estafetę ir riedučių važiavimą, todėl tai puiki pramoga šeimoms ir draugams. Bėgimas simbolizuoja draugystę tarp Lietuvos ir Lenkijos ir yra dalis sporto projektų, skatinančių bendruomenių bendradarbiavimą.
course_highlights: Vaizdinga trasa aplink Druskonį (1,2 km ratas)
Naktinis bėgimas su muzika, šviesos ir dūmų efektais
Galimybė dalyvauti bėgimo ir riedučių rungtyse
additional: Startiniai numeriai ir paketai išduodami renginio miestelyje nuo 20:00 iki 21:40 val. Apšilimas su Zumba instruktore. 21:25 val. - 1,2 km važiavimas riedučiais (nefiksuojant laiko). 21:40 val. - 1200 m bėgimas (laikas nefiksuojamas). 22:00 val. - 4 km ir 12 km važiavimas riedučiais. 22:30 val. - 4 km, 8 km, 16 km ir estafetės 2×4 km startai. Renginys yra „Bėk drauge su draugu Druskininkuose“ projekto dalis, finansuojama valstybės biudžeto lėšomis. Renginys finansuojamas Interreg Lietuvos - Lenkijos programos, dalyvių numerių išdavimas rugpjūčio 8 d., startas Druskininkuose, dalyvių skaičius keli šimtai, tarptautinis projektas.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: The Lääne-Viru County Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The events take place in different locations across Lääne-Viru County, giving runners the chance to enjoy both urban and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association to promote an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Śliwice and offers participants an attractive 10 km course. The race attracts both amateur and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and bringing the local community together.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, featuring significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the „SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimas, vykstantis Kretingos Vasaros estradoje. Varžybos vyksta ratų principu, kur maratono dalyviai įveikia vieną 2,2 km ratą ir dvylika 3,3 km ratų. Renginys skirtas pagerbti ilgametį bėgiką Piotrą Silkiną ir pritraukia bėgimo entuziastus iš įvairių vietovių. Dalyviai gali mėgautis tiek sportine varžyba, tiek bendruomeniška atmosfera.
course_highlights: Maratono trasa sudaryta iš 1 rato - 2,2 km ir 12 ratų po 3,3 km
Varžybos vyksta Kretingos Vasaros estradoje
Ratų bėgimo formatas leidžia stebėti varžybas ir palaikyti dalyvius
additional: Renginio metu vyks įvairūs nuotoliai ir amžiaus grupės, skelbiami rezultatai, registracija vyksta internetu.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 4 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai tradicinis bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos yra atviros visiems bėgikams, kurie gali varžytis skirtinguose etapuose ir amžiaus grupėse. Kiekviename etape dalyviai renka taškus bendros įskaitos turnyrui, o trasos driekiasi įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietovėse, suteikdamos įdomią ir įvairiapusę bėgimo patirtį. Registracija vykdoma internetu, o numerių atsiėmimas - varžybų dieną starto vietoje.
course_highlights: Etapai vyksta įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietovėse: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Starto laikas kiekviename etape - 19:30 val.
Numerių atsiėmimas varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje
additional: Varžybų dalyviai registruojasi į kiekvieną etapą atskirai. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Varžybų trasos gali kirstis su kelių eismu, todėl dalyviai privalo laikytis kelių eismo taisyklių. Registracijos terminai skirtingi kiekvienam etapui, numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną starto vietoje. Registracija vykdoma internetu, varžybos vyksta įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietose, skirstymas į amžiaus grupes.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 5. etapp
location: Viljandi Lake Health and Ski Trail, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 5th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race organized by the Joosu sports club. It takes place on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful lake views and varied terrain. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views along the route
Varied terrain suitable for runners

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a community experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture on the region’s running calendar.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is a welcoming urban race for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are on Storgatan in the heart of Vetlanda, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course. Younger participants can choose shorter distances from 400 metres up to 1.7 km. The event is a community celebration, with activities and food service in the square, where runners and spectators alike can enjoy a great day together.
course_highlights: Fast loop course in central Vetlanda
Start and finish on Storgatan in the heart of town
Spectator-friendly, with activities and food service in the square
additional: Race bib collection and on-the-day registration take place at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of each class. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are published live and on the OK Njudung website. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hövdingen sports hall near the start/finish. Previous editions have included children’s and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Race-day bib collection, on-the-day registration and activities have previously been held at Stortorget.

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM is a two-day ultramarathon in an Arctic mountain environment, where participants compete in pairs using mountain navigation across vast areas of unmarked terrain. The event offers several classes with different levels of difficulty and distances, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced adventurers. During the competition, participants experience spectacular mountain scenery and challenging navigation, with an overnight stay in the mountains. BAMM is a unique opportunity to combine physical challenge with a nature experience in one of Sweden’s most scenic environments.
course_highlights: Mountain navigation across unmarked terrain
Two-day competition with an overnight stay in the mountains
Arctic mountain environment with vast areas to navigate
additional: Participants compete in pairs (men’s, women’s or mixed teams). Transfers are available from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen and back, with times adapted to flight departures. Riksgränsen railway station is close to the hotel. Accommodation, equipment rental, food and practical information are available via the organiser’s website. The competition is held in teams of two. Mandatory equipment is part of the preparations; for BAMM 30, tents and sleeping bags are transported to the shared overnight camp. OMM is the main sponsor.

name: VIII-asis Žolinių maratonas
description: VIII Žolinių maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Vingio parke Vilniuje, skirtas švęsti Žolinių šventę sveikai, linksmai ir prasmingai. Renginyje gali dalyvauti tiek profesionalūs sportininkai, tiek pradedantieji, siūlantis įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo iki pilno maratono. Kiekvienas dalyvis apdovanojamas metaline statulėle, simbolizuojančia žolinių augalą, o trasos ilgis yra 5,275 km ratas, kurį bėgikai įveikia pagal pasirinktą distanciją. Renginys skatina bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.
course_highlights: Trasa sertifikuota LAF matuotojo Alfonso Kazlausko
Rato ilgis - 5,275 km, maratonui numatyti 8 ratai
Startas priešais Vingio parko estradą
additional: Dalyviai gali rinktis iš 6 distancijų: maratonas (42,2 km), 31,6 km, pusmaratonis (21,1 km), 10,6 km, 5,3 km (vienas ratas) ir 600 m vaikų bėgimas. Kiekvienas dalyvis apdovanojamas metaline statulėle, kurios dizainas kasmet keičiasi, simbolizuojant skirtingus žolinių augalus. Renginys švenčia tradicijas ir bendruomeniškumą, siūlo įvairias distancijas ir simbolinius apdovanojimus su žoliniais augalais.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
organizer: Polska Fabryka Wodomomierzy i Ciepłomierzy FILA Sp. z o.o.
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon taking place in Sztum, Mazowieckie, Poland, scheduled for August 15, 2026. Runners have access to a professionally prepared training plan tailored to different ability levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners looking to take on the marathon distance in scenic surroundings. Organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers’ goal is to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly and dynamic running event.

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a classic night race held on 14 August 2027, with an evening start. The race offers 10 km and 5 km distances, taking participants through the lively streets of Södermalm in a festive atmosphere filled with music, cheers and camaraderie. In addition to the main races, there is also a costume category and children’s races, making the event a festival for all ages. Midnattsloppet is known for its uniquely late start time and the special atmosphere created among runners, spectators and race staff.
course_highlights: The original course around Södermalm in Stockholm
An evening start with a unique night-race atmosphere
A festive atmosphere with music and cheers from spectators along the course
additional: Start times vary by race: the Mini Race (300 m) starts between 11:45 and 15:30, the 2 km children’s races start at 18:30 and 18:50, the 10 km starts at 21:10, the 5 km starts at 21:40, and the costume category starts at 22:00. Corporate races and team competitions are offered to strengthen camaraderie and workplace health. Midnattsloppet is organised by Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, a wholly owned company of Hammarby IF Friidrott, and the surplus goes back to the sports clubs.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 Lakes is a race through the beautiful forests just outside Uppsala. You’ll run mainly on small forest roads, with shorter sections of trail. All distances loop around at least one lake, while the full marathon takes you around 6 lakes. With the environment in mind, we provide free bus transport for runners from Uppsala Central Station to the start in Fjällnora, and back after the race. The race is also free of disposable cups; instead, every runner receives a reusable cup.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Blodomloppet in Jönköping is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also a children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet, for children up to 12 years old, with shorter courses. The event is a social and health-promoting activity where teams and individual participants can take part, and each team receives a picnic bag as part of the entry fee. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational race series, with a strong focus on health and the importance of blood donation.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km runs
Untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old, with 400/800 m courses
additional: Teams can consist of 3–5 participants, and vacant places can be filled at no extra cost until 5 August by email. Registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount when registering. A picnic bag from ICA is included with team registration and can be ordered separately for 250 kr each. Wellness allowances can be used via Wellnet, Epassi or Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old, with shorter 400/800-metre courses. The event raises awareness of the need for blood donation. Participants can form teams, and the event usually ends with a picnic.
