name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking, and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Physical Activity Competence Centre, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and health. Everyone is welcome to take part, improve their wellbeing, and enjoy being active at every stage of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.

name: Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp /Käru järve jooks
location: Käru, Türi Parish, Järva County, Estonia

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: XXXV-asis tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos kelias“ vyks 2027 m. rugpjūčio 21 - 24 dienomis. Bėgimas simboliškai atkartoja 1989 m. Baltijos kelią, kai milijonai lietuvių, latvių ir estų susikibo rankomis, siekdami laisvės ir nepriklausomybės. Apie 650 kilometrų ilgio trasa veda nuo Vilniaus per Rygą iki Talino, o bėgikai keičiasi estafetės principu, įveikdami skirtingo ilgio atkarpas. Tai ne tik sporto renginys, bet ir gyva istorijos pamoka bei bendruomeniškumo šventė, suburianti dalyvius ir palaikytojus iš trijų Baltijos šalių.
course_highlights: Apie 650 km trasa nuo Vilniaus per Rygą iki Talino
Estafetinis bėgimas per tris Baltijos valstybes
Simbolinis istorinės Baltijos kelio gyvos grandinės atkartojimas
additional: Bėgimas trunka keturias dienas, per kurias bėgikai kasdien įveikia iki 200 kilometrų. Renginio atidarymas vyksta Vilniaus Arkikatedros aikštėje. Dalyviai keičiasi estafetės principu, o bėgimą lydi susitikimai su miestų ir bendruomenių žmonėmis. Renginys yra nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos dalis. Renginys vyksta keturias dienas, su galimybėmis pasitikti ir palaikyti bėgikus pakeliui, ir yra skirtas Baltijos tautų vienybės paminėjimui.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a unique running experience that invites you to walk, jog or run 5 km in a wonderful atmosphere, with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, where runners also pass through on each lap. All participants receive a special medal and, if they register in advance, a unique T-shirt, as well as a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate. The race is open to both men and women, and there is also a walking class without timing. The event is organised by Högby IF with support from Hagbloms and other sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km course with the start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
Run at your own pace with music and lighting along the way
A special medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Race number pickup and late registration take place at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday 21 August from 18:00. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Everyone registered by 16 August receives the Nattloppet’s unique T-shirt. Prizes are drawn, including gift cards from Kallskänken. A walking class without timing is available. Open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal; participants who register in advance also receive the race’s unique T-shirt.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė yra bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniuje, Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione. Renginys skirtas Vilniaus ir kitų Lietuvos miestų bėgimo klubams, sporto klubams, šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui, suaugusiesiems, senjorams ir žmonėms su negalia. Pagrindinė rungtis yra komandinė estafetė 5×1000 m, kurioje dalyvauja penki dalyviai, taip pat vyksta individualūs 1000 m bėgimai ir vaikų 60 m bėgimas. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą, bendruomeniškumą ir sveiką gyvenimo būdą Vilniuje.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
Pagrindinė rungtis - komandinė 5×1000 m estafetė
Taip pat vyksta 1000 m individualūs bėgimai ir vaikų 60 m bėgimas
additional: Varžybų programa: 12:00 vaikų 60 m bėgimas, 13:00 1000 m moterų bėgimas ir moterų su triračiais bėgimas, 13:15 1000 m vyrų bėgimas ir vyrų su triračiais bėgimas. Komandinės estafetės rungtys moterims, mišrios ir vyrams atšauktos. Organizatoriai pasilieka teisę koreguoti startų laikus. Renginys apima įvairius bėgimo renginius, įskaitant vaikų, suaugusiųjų ir žmonių su negalia bėgimus, vyksiantis 2027 m. rugpjūčio 28 d.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place in Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a 9 km run, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and compete in the team category. Registration is easy and the entry fee is affordable, making this a great event for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Maraton Wigry
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held in Wigry National Park, around scenic Lake Wigry. The approximately 42.2 km course runs mainly along forest and unpaved trails, with a small amount of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of the Suwałki and Sejny regions. This is not a marathon for setting personal bests, but for those who want to enjoy its remarkable nature and atmosphere. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, starting at the Monastery in Wigry and finishing at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark.

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drink at set times. Runners finish both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop course in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station with food and drink from Umara served at set times
additional: Maximum 100 participants. Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, a tent, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that parking is available at the venue and that it is close to the metro and buses.

name: Tough Viking
description: Tough Viking Kungl. Djurgården is a spectacular obstacle course race that takes you through Stockholm’s beautiful and historic surroundings. The course offers a varied mix of fast running sections, technical obstacles, strength challenges, and water elements. The race is spectator-friendly and suits both beginners and experienced OCR runners looking to combine speed, nature, and an authentic race atmosphere. The start and finish are located on Djurgårdsbrunnsvägen near the Maritime Museum, with a well-organized event area and services.
course_highlights: The course winds through the lush parks and historic landmarks of Royal Djurgården
Varied terrain with fast running sections and technical obstacles
Includes strength challenges and water elements
additional: Start times are selected during registration and sent by SMS before race day. Race bibs and timing chips are collected at the black Tough Viking tents by the Maritime Museum. The chip must be worn around the right ankle. A group warm-up is held 10 minutes before each start. Shoes with metal spikes are prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants can compete individually or in teams (at least four people per team). Bag storage is available on site. The Open class has a minimum age of 12; participants under 18 need a guardian’s signature. There are four hydration stations along the course. Missing obstacles results in five penalty laps. Parking is limited, and public transport is recommended; changing tents are available, but there are no showers.

name: Rinkebyloppet 2026
location: Ursvikssidan av gångbron, Rinkeby, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Rinkebyloppet is an annual running race that starts on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge in Rinkeby, crosses the bridge and follows Rinkeby Allé to the finish at Rinkeby Square. The race is a welcome tradition that also marks the start of the popular Rinkeby Festival. This year, there is also a class for participants with disabilities who use wheelchairs, following the same course and reaching the same finish as the other runners. Rinkebyloppet welcomes all runners and is part of the active and inclusive Rinkeby Run collaboration.
course_highlights: Start on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge
Run across the bridge and along Rinkeby Allé
Finish at Rinkeby Square, marking the start of the Rinkeby Festival
additional: A new wheelchair class for participants with disabilities follows the same course and has the same finish as the runners. A wheelchair class is offered on the same course, with the same finish as the runners.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin, aiming to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, engaging the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual sporting event held in Police, West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Organized since 2010 by the DZIK Running Club Association, the festival is one of the most recognizable races in the region. The event promotes an active lifestyle, cross-country running, and sporting competition for children and young people, while also showcasing the natural attractions of the Wkrzańska Forest. The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at 99 Piaskowa Street in Police.

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running event held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, with a course that passes through classic surroundings, lined with cheering spectators and featuring more than ten music stations to create a wonderful atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. Children can also take part in the free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, lined with cheering spectators
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 in four waves and is free for children. The children’s warm-up is led by Friskis & Svettis at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race starts at 19:30, with warm-ups 15 minutes before each start. Race numbers can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered water drilled by Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is by chip, and results are published directly after the finish. ARQLY-Spurten is a race within the race on the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet is free for children.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Naktinis bėgimas 2026 kviečia pajusti nakties ritmą ir pasinerti į vasaros pabaigos šurmulį Kaune. Tai unikali galimybė atsipalaiduoti nuo kasdienybės ir užbaigti vasarą energingu bėgimu su muzika, šviesų jūra ir įkvėptų bėgikų kompanija. Renginys vyksta Rotušės aikštėje ir Santakos parke, siūlant įspūdingus vaizdus ir nepamirštamą naktinį nuotykį. Dalyviai varžosi 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km distancijose, o renginys skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams.
course_highlights: Trasa Rotušės aikštėje ir Santakos parke
Naktinis bėgimas su muzika ir šviesų jūra
Varžybos 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km distancijose
additional: Dalyviai privalo prisitvirtinti numerį su laiko matavimo mikroschema ant marškinėlių priekio. Registracijos duomenų ir distancijos keitimas galimas iki 2026-08-23 už 5 € mokestį. Varžybų dalyvių laikas gali būti neužfiksuotas, jei trasos neįveikia per nustatytą laiko limitą. Griežtai draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones trasoje. Renginys vyks Kaune, trasa apima naktinį bėgimą su šviesomis, muzika ir nuotaikinga atmosfera. Registracija ir detalesnė informacija yra oficialioje svetainėje.

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis '26 yra karščiausia vasaros bėgimo šventė Kaune, vykstanti rugpjūčio 29 dieną. Renginys siūlo keturias distancijas: pusmaratonį (21,089 km), 10 km, 5 km ir 400 m vaikų bėgimą. Tai ne tik varžybos, bet ir visa patirtis, kupina jaudulio, adrenalino ir bendruomeniškumo, kviečianti tiek siekiančius asmeninių rekordų, tiek norinčius pasimėgauti bėgimo šventės atmosfera. Šis renginys nuspalvina miestą dalyvių šypsenomis ir kviečia tapti istorijos dalimi.

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The race centre, start and finish are located at Järvevana tee 3. The run takes place on Saturday, 29 August 2026, starting at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked route, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and offers an enjoyable, active experience.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
description: Sillamäe Ultra 2026 is the Estonian 100 km running championship, taking place on the Sillamäe health trail and at outdoor gyms on August 29, 2026. It is a traditional ultrarun in which participants cover a road-running distance while competing for the Estonian championship title. The race offers a challenge for both local and international ultrarunners who appreciate the course’s variety and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
description: The 54th Tallinna Vesi Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race taking place on 29 August 2026. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Runs series, and this year’s race is the series’ final, fourth event. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant at Järvevana tee 3. The event centre opens early in the morning, and race materials are distributed on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race bib.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening road race taking place on August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through central Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel Beach. The course is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with music and lighting awaits. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality. After a one-year break, it returns to Straszyn. The organizer is the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality Sports and Recreation Center, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place on 29 August 2026, with beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned to reduce the total elevation gain while retaining a varied profile with sections through nature, crowd support and several power zones; the marathon course finishes with a spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge. The race attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children’s race, as well as offers for businesses and tent packages in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna, on a redesigned course with less elevation gain
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 aid stations along the course plus 1 in the start/finish area, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: up to five runners can be registered at a time; race bibs are not sent out. The marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and 12+1 aid stations. The organizer offers tent packages for businesses in the start/finish area and the option to use a wellness allowance. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes a team relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and aid stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a business village with tents in the start/finish area.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Nästa år är förresten planerat till lördagen den 28 augusti för er som vill boka in er redan nu.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular half-marathon that runs through central Stockholm, starting and finishing at Strömbron, near the Royal Palace and the Parliament House. The course is 21,098 metres long and offers a fast, scenic route through the districts of Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The race is an annual tradition that attracts runners from across the country and offers a unique opportunity to run through Stockholm’s historic and beautiful urban surroundings. The race starts at 15:30, and after the finish there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Royal Palace and Strömbron
Fast course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Clearly marked kilometres and police/officials at every intersection
additional: The expo and race-number pickup take place in Kungsträdgården in the days before the race. Race numbers are printed on site at the expo. The metro is the easiest way to get to the event area. After the race, there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. Race confirmation is sent by email from mid-August. The first start is provisionally at 15:30. Participants may start from the year they turn 17.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a well-known city race in Sweden’s southernmost city, Trelleborg, with a measured course offering both 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walk or Nordic walk. The race starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken, providing a lovely, spectator-friendly setting. Trelleborgsloppet is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, and participants can enter team competitions and prize draws for an extra chance to win. The event is marked by a sense of community and fun, with a focus on making the race enjoyable for all participants.
course_highlights: Measured city course with gun time
Starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken
Course through an urban setting, with cultural landmarks and parks along the way
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Östervångsstadion no later than 45 minutes before the start, or the day before in the lobby of Söderslättshallen. Changing facilities are available at Söderslättshallen, with clothing transport to the finish. Timing uses a disposable chip (Neptron), and gun time is used. Late registration is available online until 45 minutes before the start and on site for an additional fee. A team competition is available, with extra prizes for groups of at least 8 participants. There is also a 5 km distance for walking and Nordic walking. Participants can compete individually or as part of a team.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers an enjoyable competition setting for runners of different ages and ability levels, with the option to register late on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and membership benefits, such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The course runs along the River Lagan in Strömsnäsbruk.
Previous editions have offered distances of 10 km and 4.8 km.
Children’s and youth categories have been included in previous editions.
additional: Late registration is available on race day until one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for the youngest children, youth, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytaus pusmaratonis 2026 kviečia visus bėgimo entuziastus į ypatingą vasaros finišą Alytuje. Renginys prasideda ir baigiasi Alytaus rotušės aikštėje, o trasa veda per gražiausias miesto vietas - žaliuojančius parkus, jaukias gatves ir Nemuno pakrantes. Dalyviai patirs bendrystę, judesį ir emocijas, o finiše jų lauks šventinė atmosfera ir palaikymas. Tai puiki proga pažinti Alytų ir išsinešti nepamirštamas emocijas tiek siekiant geriausio rezultato, tiek tiesiog praleidžiant prasmingą dieną.
course_highlights: Trasa veda per žaliuojančius parkus
Jaukios miesto gatvės
Įkvepiančios Nemuno pakrantės
additional: various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place on August 30, 2026, at the playground in Löwenruh Park in Tallinn. This family-friendly event features a 5 km main race as well as children’s races for participants up to 10 years old. The event centre, start and finish are located next to Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for people of different age groups.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in scenic Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The courses run across Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding trails, rocky climbs, and open spaces with panoramic views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and marked every kilometre, with times recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. The organizers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim, a fast and flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds—a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are open to both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and small-scale, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju
description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 a.m. The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming pedestrian streets, giving the race a distinctive atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural event through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to everyone; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the event, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km route from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions
additional: The event is non-competitive and open to everyone to run, walk, roll or dance. The start is by the sculpture Protest at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to foster a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 says the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg. Dates and times for 2027 are not specified in the sources.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course runs in the opposite direction from usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies awarded to the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of the Leśne Piątki series and part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging people to stay active throughout the year.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII
Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts and offers a 10 km run, Nordic walking and an evening run. The event takes place in the beautiful city of Pärnu and around its bridges, providing a sporting experience for participants of all ages. The event is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to take part and enjoy being active.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru Trail Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, offering a varied running experience. The series includes different distances, from little ones’ races to main events, suitable for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly athletic company.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers a range of distances and ways to take part, including an evening run, wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful route through the city and along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to recreational and experienced runners alike and celebrates the joy of exercise and community spirit.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on September 5, 2026. The event brings together athletes of different ages and ability levels, offering race-walking competitions over 10 km (women and men, including the Open, U20 and U18 categories), as well as 5 km and 3 km races for younger participants and the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organizer, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by holding wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event in Warsaw that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, adding a distinctive character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packages including an official T-shirt.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces, beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, and the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.

name: XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Anija Parish, Estonia

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km laps, with the start and finish in the same place. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic course along the river promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km courses along the river promenade and the city streets
Certified 5,000 m course measured by an SFIF course measurer
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants; a picnic for 5 people is included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter courses inside the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 people. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to age 12; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje ir populiarina sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške. Dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus, o renginio metu vyksta bendras startas visoms grupėms. Laiko limitas varžyboms yra 120 minučių, išskyrus Mini Rogainingą.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s running event held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers distances suited to different age groups, ranging from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. Organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club, it gives children the chance to enjoy being active and spend time in nature. The run starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and souvenirs are provided for participants.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with meaningful support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on 12 September 2026, inviting participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a fun run offering a unique experience in nature and a challenge, with three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and times are recorded for all distances. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to combine performance with an experience in nature.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: The mass start is from Gränna Square, going through the town to the harbor, where timing begins. Timing and a unique medal for all participants. The race venue is in the heart of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset nature reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across bogs and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. The distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is known for its strong sense of community and festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding trails, bogs and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. There is a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The terrain is challenging and gives runners a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a relay race for teams of 2–4 people, held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The course is approximately 5.4 km long and winds through areas including ESS and Kunskapsparken, on a mix of asphalt and gravel. The relay is part of Innovationsloppet & stafetten, where participants kick off autumn together with an energy boost in a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere. The races celebrate Lund as a city of innovation and are organised in partnership by IFK Lund Friidrott and Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km and runs from Nobelparken via ESS and Kunskapsparken
A mix of asphalt and gravel, with a flat course and approximately 10 metres of elevation difference
Views of northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams can be women's, men's or mixed teams of 2–4 people, and runners may run more than one leg. The start and finish are in Nobelparken in Brunnshög. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal or a sausage. The competition area is easily accessible by tram and bus. Teams compete in women's, men's or mixed categories. Each runner runs approximately 5 km.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Innovationsloppet
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park
description: Innovationsloppet & the relay is a running event held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The event offers an individual 11 km distance or a relay with 4 legs of 5.5 km each. The course winds through areas such as ESS and Kunskapsparken, offering flat, varied terrain with asphalt and gravel. The event celebrates Lund as a city of innovation and is open to women’s, men’s and mixed relay teams, as well as individual runners. The start and finish are centrally located in Nobelparken, with good public transport connections by tram and bus.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km per lap, with two laps for individual runners
The terrain is flat, with approximately 10 metres of elevation difference, and consists of asphalt and gravel
Views over northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams consist of 2–4 people and can be women’s, men’s or mixed teams. Teams with fewer than 4 members must have runners complete more than one leg. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal and a sausage. The entry fee includes a place in the event, a bib with timing, and a medal or sausage after the finish. Participants choose a medal or sausage when registering.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail running event in Parainen, offering varied routes amid stunning archipelago scenery. The event features three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, fitness tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The event’s relaxed atmosphere and careful organisation make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga yra nauja bendruomenės iniciatyva, skirta tiems, kurie mėgsta judesį, muziką ir gerą energiją. Renginys vyksta Palangoje ir apima mobilumo treniruotes, 5 km socialinį bėgimą su DJ muzika, ledinį vonios ritualą bei kavos pertraukėles. Tai puiki proga susipažinti su naujais žmonėmis, užmegzti pažintis ir patirti vasaros energiją viename rytiniame renginyje. Registracija yra būtina, o dalyviai kviečiami pasiimti sportinius batelius, maudymosi šortus ir rankšluostį.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main thoroughfares, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the Northern Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses that give the race its distinctive character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all abilities, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a children’s race—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It is not only a sporting event, but also a journey through the beautiful corners of the coast and an opportunity to connect with nature.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, guaranteeing a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon course winds through picturesque fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also offers races for children and youth. The organizers look after participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on the scenic trails of the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing together the local running community. This event has a well-established tradition and attracts both amateur and experienced runners.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów on the Run is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, both running around the reservoir in multiple laps and finishing on the reservoir grounds. The event promotes physical activity, community, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The race is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race.

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Brotorp Trailrun is a challenging and enjoyable trail race on a technical 7 km loop through the finest parts of Nacka Nature Reserve. The race offers several distances, including a children’s course, 7 km, 14 km and 21 km, with the start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s Brotorp clubhouse in Bagarmossen. The courses offer varied terrain, with trails near lakes and hills, marked with orange ribbons and signs. There are aid stations with water, sports drinks and bananas during the race, and hamburgers are served after the finish to runners in the longer distances. Timing is provided by Sportident, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Technical 7 km loop marked with orange ribbons and signs
The course passes through the finest parts of Nacka Nature Reserve, with lakes and hills
Aid stations every 3.5 km with water, sports drinks and bananas
additional: Start and finish at the Brotorp clubhouse. Bib pickup takes place on race day at least one hour before the start. Food and refreshments are available at the clubhouse. Timing by Sportident. The time limit for the longest distance is 4 hours; everyone must finish before 14:00. Showers are available, but runners are advised to shower at home. The prize-giving ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30. A discount code is available for children running 7 km (50% discount). Start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s Brotorp clubhouse. According to the organizer, children who register for 7 km get a 50 percent discount with the code “barnrabatt”.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn is a running race organized by Bottnaryds IF at Bottnaryds IP. The race offers distances of 7.5 km and 15 km, on a course that includes loops through varied terrain. The event attracts both young people and adult runners and has a wonderful late-summer atmosphere, with energetic participants. The race has a tradition of bringing together a strong field and offers an enjoyable challenge for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 7.5 km and 15 km course options with two loops
Varied terrain and surfaces
Start and finish at Bottnaryds IP
additional: The race has two distances: 7.5 km and 15 km. In previous years, the race has had start groups and attracted over 100 participants. Results and contact details are available via christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. Shorter distances of 1 and 2 km are also available. Bottnaryds IF’s pages list different dates for the 2027 race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bottnarydsif.se/bottnarydsif-rallarloppen-loprallarn): 2027-09-16 — "RallarLoppen 2027 16 sep" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas
description: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas yra specializuotas bėgimo renginys, skirtas akliesiems ir silpnaregiams sportininkams. Varžybos vyksta Zelvėje, Elektrėnų savivaldybėje, ir yra organizuojamos Lietuvos aklųjų sporto federacijos (LASF). Federacija aktyviai remia aklųjų ir silpnaregių sportą Lietuvoje nuo 1990 metų, siekdama sudaryti lygias sąlygas dalyvauti įvairiose sporto varžybose ir renginiuose. Čempionatas yra svarbi tradicija, skatinanti sportininkų fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!“ yra tradicinis Kauno technologijos universiteto organizuojamas renginys, skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui. Renginys kviečia dalyvius išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose bėgimo ir ėjimo trasose, įskaitant naują 5 km bėgimą su šunimis. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir dalyvauti bendruomenės sporto renginyje. Varžybos vyksta KTU stadione ir Ąžuolyne, o dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo medaliais bei prizais pagal amžiaus grupes.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking and hiking event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting everyone who enjoys being active to take part. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Recreational Sport, which aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and support your mental and physical health. Participants can choose the activity that suits them and share the joy of exercise with others.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Keskus in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking and hiking
An event that encourages participants to be active and promotes health
additional: The event includes running, hiking and walking and takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is open, and the event is intended for all age groups and ability levels.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: The Jõhvi People’s Run is a traditional running event, taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated: in addition to city streets, it also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held near the Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to test their endurance and agility. The organizers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located on the grounds of the revitalized EC1 power and heating plant, which is now a center for culture and science. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s most recognizable places, combining its industrial history with modernity. This is a race where not only the result matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the scenic areas around the venue. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km
