description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till loppet är gratis och i din anmälan ingår medalj.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till loppet är gratis och i din anmälan ingår medalj.

description: Kistaloppet is a popular running event in Kista, Stockholm, offering races for the whole family, with distances ranging from 400 metres for the youngest participants to 5 km for adults. The race passes through Kista’s distinctive surroundings, including the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster that has made Kista known as the Silicon Valley of Northern Europe. The event has a festive atmosphere, with music and entertainment along the course, and an inclusive spirit in which all participants receive a medal. Kistaloppet is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works to promote health and physical activity in suburban communities.
course_highlights: A 5 km measured course through Kista’s Million Programme neighbourhood and green spaces
Start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, in central Kista
Entertainment and music stations along the course to keep participants motivated
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the event centre in Kista Galleria, in the premises opposite McDonald’s, on Friday 12:00–18:00 and Saturday 09:15–13:00. Late registration is available on site, subject to availability. There is a water station at the finish. Medical staff will be on site. All participants receive a specially designed medal. Music and DJs along the course create a festive atmosphere. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or registration terms for 2027. The 2026 information also lists a 1.6 km untimed Fun Run and children’s races of approximately 1.6 km and 500 metres.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; other finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has showers and a sauna
additional: Changing rooms, showers and a sauna are available at the clubhouse. Runners can choose to forgo their medal in favour of Médecins Sans Frontières, with 20 kr donated for each medal declined. The race is organised by Västerås Löparklubb. The easiest way to get in touch is via Black River Run’s Messenger. Orientalen has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. Finishers receive a medal; those who complete 100 miles within 24 hours also receive a belt buckle.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and welcoming to runners, and the course runs along the scenic Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and excellent race-day conditions.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place on September 20, 2026, in Augustów, starting at 1:00 p.m. at the Municipal Amphitheatre. Participants will cover the half-marathon distance of 21.0975 km, running a course that is a competition equal to half the length of a marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Association and is an important running event in the region.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg na Zamek po miecz Spycimira
XI Gminna Zadyszka
location: Kurnos Drugi, Bełchatów County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIX Mazowiecki Bieg Norwidowski
location: Dębinki, Gmina Zabrodzie, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a popular fun run held in Linköping, starting and finishing at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race offers a pleasant course through the central parts of the city and a great running experience for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good amenities, including changing rooms, showers and bag drop. It is a traditional autumn race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course passes through central Linköping, with lovely views
Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen
Paved surface with gentle undulations
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. A bag drop is offered. Food and drink, as well as medical assistance, are available on site. Bib numbers and race confirmations are handled according to the terms and conditions. It is possible to transfer an entry and change category. The race also seeks volunteers.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and ability levels. The main event is a 10 km fun run along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest participants. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The event venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race bib collection and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet has start times from 09:15 to 10:15 for different age groups. The Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45 and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition; details about the 2027 event format and registration have not been confirmed.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club and takes place on the Järve health trail in Tallinn. This stage gives participants the chance to enjoy a health trail close to the city, well suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well organized, offering an enjoyable sporting experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy exercise in the fresh air.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Kauno rajono mero Valerijaus Makūno ir olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento taurei laimėti
Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place by Lake Rava in Järvamaa. Runners of all ages take part, from toddlers to seniors. The race features a single lap around the lake, with prizes awarded to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional, community-focused running event that offers both a sporting challenge and a chance to enjoy nature.

name: Greičio ratai 2026
description: Greičio ratai 2026 yra bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko stadione 2026 m. rugsėjo 25 d. Renginys apima 60 m bėgimus vaikams, 1000 m bėgimus su specialiomis kategorijomis neįgaliesiems su triračiais, bei 5×1000 m estafetės varžybas mišrioms, vyrų ir moterų komandoms. Varžybų tikslas - skatinti bėgimą kaip sveiką gyvenimo būdą, populiarinti lengvąją atletiką ir išaiškinti pajėgiausias komandas. Dalyviai privalo laikytis taisyklių, o renginys yra atviras visiems norintiems, registracija vyksta iš anksto.

name: #BeActive bėgimas, skirtas Europos sporto savaitei
description: Europos sporto savaitės #BeActive renginys Vilkaviškyje yra svarbi bendruomenės tradicija, kviečianti įvairaus amžiaus ir fizinio pasirengimo žmones aktyviai praleisti laiką. Renginio programa apima estafetes, judriuosius žaidimus, futbolo, imtynių, šachmatų varžybas, linijinius šokius, mankštą, šiaurietišką ėjimą ir bendrą žygį po miestą. Vakarinę programą vainikuoja bendras šokis ir energingas „Dance party“ su zumbos ritmais, kuris suvienija dalyvius ir pabrėžia judėjimo svarbą bendruomenėje.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: Tarptautinis Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas yra tradicinis ir kasmetinis renginys, vykstantis Kuršių nerijoje, Nidoje. Renginys apima pusmaratonio distanciją, 5 km YIT bėgimą bei trumpesnes vaikų ir jaunuolių distancijas. Tai puiki proga tiek profesionaliems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams pasimėgauti bėgimu unikalioje gamtinėje aplinkoje ir dalyvauti Lietuvos pusės maratono čempionate. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą ir sporto populiarinimą Lietuvoje, o dalyvių laukia profesionaliai paruoštos trasos ir draugiška atmosfera.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius yra Lietuvos vertikaliausios bekelės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniuje. Dalyviai įveikia Liepkalnio šlaitus, varžybos suteikia galimybę pelnyti ITRA reitingo taškus. Taip pat organizuojamas ekologinis „Trash Vertical“ iššūkis, skatinantis dalyvius rūpintis aplinka. Registracija į renginį yra nemokama, todėl kviečiame visus aktyviai prisijungti ir išbandyti savo jėgas šioje unikalioje trasoje.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
description: 26-asis Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono bėgimas vyks 2026 m. rugsėjo 26 d. Nidoje. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas: pusmaratonį, 5 km YIT bėgimą, 2 km jaunuolių bėgimą bei trumpuosius vaikų bėgimus (500 m ir 210 m). Bėgimo trasos yra sertifikuotos pagal World Athletics ir AIMS reikalavimus, o startai vyksta skirtingose Nidos vietose. Tai tradicinis renginys, skatinantis sportuoti ir populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje.

name: Vertical Vilnius
description: Vertical Vilnius yra Lietuvos vertikaliausios bekelės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Liepkalnio šlaituose Vilniuje. Dalyviai įveikia stačius kalnų šlaitus, siekdami pelnyti ITRA reitingo taškus ir dalyvauti ekologiniame „Trash Vertical“ iššūkyje. Varžybos skatina fizinį aktyvumą ir gamtos tausojimą, kviečiant bėgikus išbandyti savo jėgas unikalioje trasoje.

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: The Viking Window Paide-Türi Fun Run is a traditional mass-participation sporting event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features varied terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the main race, includes children’s runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual highlight that brings the community and sports enthusiasts together.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and levels to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km and 10 km, plus a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages fundraising via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact people can be reached via the specified email address. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. Information about the distances and event is based on previous editions; details for 2027 are not confirmed by the sources.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distance options for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, along with the youth and children’s races, are popular and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ stages have secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place mainly in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km). The events have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for nature and local communities. They welcome both beginner and experienced runners and also include Nordic walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with the final race in Michałowo on September 27.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the chance to compete amid beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Cross-Country Running and Nordic Walking Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026
description: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026 yra tradicinis sporto renginys, vykstantis išskirtinėje Kauno rajono vietoje - aikštėje prie Senosios Zapyškio Šv. Jono Krikštytojo bažnyčios. Renginys skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir fizinį aktyvumą, suburia bėgimo entuziastus įvairaus amžiaus ir pajėgumo. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o renginio organizatoriai užtikrina saugią ir techniškai paruoštą trasą bei malonią atmosferą visiems dalyviams.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varžybos ... yra nukeliamos į 2026 m. rugsėjo 30 d.

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: Bėgimas skirtas Sporto ir kūno kultūros dienai paminėti
15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's races are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines apply to distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Bib numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the event is not ranked. The event takes place in Tartu Town Hall Square, with registration available both in advance and on site.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of Poland’s best-known running events, bringing thousands of participants together in the heart of the capital each year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer course passing through Warsaw’s most iconic landmarks. The FUNRUN format focuses on the joy of being active, without pressure or competition, encouraging participants to run, walk, or jog at their own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheering spectators, and motivating partner points, and every participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt and a medal at the finish.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
description: The 8th Run Along the Green Trail of the Masovian Lowland is a 5 km race taking place on September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Masovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and young people over the age of 15 with the consent of a legal guardian.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fairgrounds. The organizers provide professional medical support, timekeeping, and a generous race pack. It is a unique sporting celebration, backed by enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The mixed-surface course includes asphalt, paving blocks, compacted gravel paths, and forest trails, making it an attractive and varied route for runners. The event also features 5 km races and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide at least two refreshment stations along the route and professional race office service. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with 300, 600 and 1,500 metres of elevation gain respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance taking runners up the mountain five times. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and demanding trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails in untouched wilderness
Beautiful views by small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children’s race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Transfer of a race entry is possible under the terms listed on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, plus VMX Kids. Trail running shoes are recommended. The website describes the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Solvalla Sports Institute, Nuuksio, Espoo, Finland
description: Solvalla Trail returns to the trail running calendar in the Nuuksio area of Espoo on Sunday, 4 October 2026. The event gives runners the chance to enjoy scenic trails over two distances: 9 km and 18 km. Organised by Esbo IF, it is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Join us for an exciting and memorable trail running event amid stunning scenery.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Running Series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course loops around Rava Artificial Lake and features varied terrain of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners will be awarded, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, skirtas populiarinti bėgimą, dviračių sportą ir orientavimąsi gamtoje. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o dalyviai varžosi bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo rungtyse. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį įvairaus amžiaus žmonėms ir jaunimo domėjimąsi sportu. Varžybų startas vyksta Šilo pagrindinės mokyklos stadione, o laiko limitas yra 120 minučių (išskyrus Mini Rogainingą).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys vyksta Kopūstėlių miške Ukmergėje ir skirtas skatinti aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje bei populiarinti sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybų startas yra bendras visoms grupėms ir vyksta vakare, o dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus. Pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške, o renginys remiamas kelių Ukmergės įmonių.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026 yra pirmasis maratonas, organizuojamas Kaišiadoryse, kuris vyks 2026 m. spalio 10 d. Šis renginys žymi naują tradiciją, suburiantį bėgikus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Maratonas vyks aktyviame ir sportiškame mieste, kuris garsėja savo sporto renginiais ir aktyviu gyvenimo būdu. Renginį organizuoja BK „Kaišiadorys bėga“, Kaišiadorių rajono savivaldybė, Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centras bei VšĮ „Maratomanija“.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: „Gintarinė jūrmylė“ yra tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios nuostabioje Smiltynėje. Renginys siūlo įvairius nuotolius: 0,5 jūrmylės vaikams, 1 jūrmylę visiems norintiems, 3 jūrmyles moterims ir 6 jūrmyles vyrams bei profesionalams. Startas ir finišas yra Sporto sveikatingumo bazėje, o dalyviai vaišinami kareiviška koše ir arbata. Varžybų tradicija įamžina nugalėtojų vardus atminimo akmenyje, iškeltame iš marių dugno.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru cross-country run and walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, which offers a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, providing a varied course in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the SA Võru Sports Centre ski base in Kubija, known for its beautiful natural surroundings and good course conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The events combine recreation and sport, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race numbers and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is 60 zł. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the participant’s main location, subject to prior notification by email. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born in 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00. The stated date of October 9, 2027, is not confirmed by the available season dates.

VIII Półmaraton Lasy nad Utratą

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to guide participants. Runners can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a pleasant atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the race.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Bib numbers must be collected from Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but late registration may be available on site. Medical staff are available at the start and finish. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. Race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class. Bib numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging cross-country race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet terrain, making it an adventure for anyone who isn’t afraid of getting dirty or tackling challenging terrain. It is a fun and demanding race suited to both seasoned runners and beginners, with an emphasis on fighting spirit and camaraderie. After crossing the finish line, showers and rinse-off facilities are available in tents near the finish. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and trail paths
Challenging natural terrain with wet ground and forest trails
Held in Norra Djurgården, a well-known woodland setting
additional: After the race, hot showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities immediately after crossing the finish line. There are collection bins for clothes that cannot be taken home. Participants are advised to wear clothes they don’t mind getting dirty and shoes with good grip that fit securely to handle the mud.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd terrain at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful nature experience. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd terrain
Passage through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may lead to minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team. Information about the distance and format refers to a previous edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event being held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s most beautiful trails and seaside scenery in the fresh October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Dash to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Dash and continues with several different distances, taking runners along beautiful and varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services, and photos and videos will be taken during the event and used for event communications.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series that offers a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, offering runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running traditional race series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race route goes around Lake Viljandi, and the event is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting competitions, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several recreational sports events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an energetic and enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and professional athletes.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the highlight of the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking one beer, and beer refreshment stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The running series attracts runners of different ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Październikowy
location: Łubianka, Toruń County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting on Św. Wawrzyńca Street and finishing at the city beach by the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish at the city beach
Suitable for beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains the same throughout the season, allowing runners to compare results across months and years. The series also includes children’s races. The official calendar lists the dates for the 2026/2027 season but does not confirm a race in Poznań on 10 October 2027.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sweden
