tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre laps within an hour, continuing for as long as multiple runners are able to keep going. The competition is unique because it has no predetermined finishing time or distance, and the winner is the one who runs one more lap than the others. The event is held at the Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The competition originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km races start on Saturday, 17 October, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A proper headlamp is recommended, ideally with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a time limit of 4 hours and 30 minutes for the 30 km. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running event in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The competition offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas yra unikalus bekelės bėgimo renginys, kuriame bėgikai kas valandą turi įveikti 6,7 km ratą tol, kol lieka paskutinis stovintis. Varžybos vyksta kalnuotose ir bekelės trasose, kurios reikalauja ištvermės ir valios. Renginys yra iššūkis tiek fizinei, tiek psichologinei ištvermei, o nugalėtojas visada yra tik vienas. Trailo Kalvė organizuoja šį renginį su ypatingu dėmesiu trasų kokybei ir dalyvių patirčiai, kviesdama bėgikus išbandyti save ir įveikti save pačius.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
description: Pagarbos ir paramos bėgimas „In Memoriam“ Vilniuje yra iškilus renginys, skirtas pagerbti šiais metais mirusius Lietuvos kariuomenės karius ir paremti jų šeimas. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke ir apima 1 km bei 4 km distancijas be varžybų, taip pat 10 km atvirą Lietuvos kariuomenės bėgimo čempionatą. Bėgimas gimė kaip jautri iniciatyva atminti jauną karininką ir tapo svarbia kasmetine pilietine bei patriotine tradicija. Organizuoja LDK Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų sąjunga kartu su Krašto apsaugos ministerija ir Lietuvos kariuomene.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė yra tradicinis Kelmės rajono bėgimas, skirtas Vaidoto Rimkaus atminimui. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį ir siekia populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir didinti rajono gyventojų aktyvumą. Renginys pritraukia įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus, o dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant 8 km pagrindinį bėgimą. Varžybų metu dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis, medaliais ir atminimo prizais.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The competition is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for all running enthusiasts. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and a drink after the run.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The race showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course run over eight laps around the beautiful Växjösjön. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation change—about 3 metres per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers relay races for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation change per lap
Mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, with a lead cyclist and course marshals. It is not closed to traffic during the race. Relay races are also available for teams, and a children’s race is held. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Löparklubb. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic. Sources do not confirm the details for the 2027 edition.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Brantaste Mini kostar 200 kronor hela vägen fram till start.

description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense, high-energy race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactate threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Uphill on two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views over Stockholm
additional: Race bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. The race bib is personal and must be worn on the chest with safety pins. There are water stations along the course. In the relay, teams complete 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easily accessible by public transport; parking is limited. The 2026 edition is listed as taking place on October 17; information about the 2027 race has not yet been confirmed in the available sources. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valles Kompislopp is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the slope.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Botanic Five Kaunas
location: Botanical Garden of Vytautas Magnus University, Kaunas, Lithuania

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race that starts at the Purila bus stop and finishes at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for schoolchildren, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, with special prizes also awarded to veteran athletes, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participants take part at their own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on a refreshed course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to wrap up the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy the beautiful Kashubian countryside and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering a chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event hub is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, and refreshments and snacks are available.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, with students, teachers and parents taking part. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not on speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and offers the community enjoyable moments of exercise in the fresh air. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holiday.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail is an exciting 5 km evening race through hilly terrain in Älvsjöskogen, with 150 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP, about a 15-minute walk from Älvsjö station. The course is marked with reflective markers and requires a bright headlamp, preferably at least 1,000 lumens, as well as good trail shoes to handle the terrain. After the finish, all runners are offered a sausage and a drink in a friendly atmosphere. The race is organised by OK Älvsjö Örby and is open to everyone, with free entry for club members.
course_highlights: 5 km reflective-marked course through hilly terrain, with 150 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Gamla Älvsjö IP, near Älvsjö station
Requires a bright headlamp and trail shoes with good grip
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are handed out from 18.15 to 18.45. The chip must be returned at the finish. Toilets and changing rooms are available at the venue. Parking is available in the area and at Herr Stens väg 2, but walking, cycling or running to the start is recommended. Live results and the results list are available at alvsjoloppet.se. Sausages and drinks are offered to all runners after the finish; no other refreshments are available. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP. The organiser's published information applies to 2026 and does not give confirmed details for 2027. For 2026, a headlamp of at least 1,000 lumens and trail shoes, preferably with metal studs, are recommended.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumägi in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run. The results of the best four stages count toward the series standings, and prizes are awarded by age group. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can be borrowed if needed. Special prizes are awarded to those who complete the series.
course_highlights: Five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run
Held at Kangrumägi in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed. Every runner or Nordic walker who completes all five stages receives a special prize. Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Points are awarded as follows: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 25 points, and so on. In the event of a tie, the placing in the final stage decides. The fifth stage is scheduled for 8 November 2026, starting at 12:00. The best four stage results count toward the series standings.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports event series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Sporto šventė „Juodšilių ruduo“ yra Vilniaus rajono sporto renginys, vykstantis 2026 m. spalio 24 d. Juodšiliuose. Renginys skatina bendruomenės narius aktyviai sportuoti, populiarina lengvąją atletiką ir bėgimą bei propaguoja sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Varžybose gali dalyvauti visi norintys, o trasos ilgiai yra 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km. Dalyviai registruojami ir gauna numerius renginio vietoje nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val., o varžybos vyksta laisva valia ir su atsakomybe už savo sveikatą.
course_highlights: Trasa Juodšilių seniūnijos teritorijoje, Vilniaus rajone
Rungtys: 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km krosas
Varžybų metu draudžiama vedžioti gyvūnus ir naudotis asmenine palyda
additional: Numerių išdavimas ir registracija vyksta nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Dalyviams draudžiama perduoti numerį kitam asmeniui, naudotis asmenine palyda, vedžioti gyvūnus trasoje ir nukrypti nuo trasos be teisėjo leidimo. Pretenzijos priimamos raštu per 30 min. po varžybų pabaigos su 30 EUR mokestiu. Rungties keitimo mokestis 6 EUR, keičiant į ilgesnę rungtį reikia primokėti skirtumą. Bėgimo rungtys: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registracija nuo 10:00 iki 11:30; dalyvių skatinimas ir atminimo medaliai; dalyvių apribojimai ir taisyklės.

name: Tõstamaa jooks
location: Tõstamaa Keskkool, Tõstamaa, Pärnu County, Estonia

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat. Companies can rent a partner tent at the race venue for team spirit and exposure through Rent a Tent. E2C was title partner for the fourth year in the 2024 edition.

name: VSM terräng

late_fee.price: 530 kr för seniorer och veteraner, 430 kr för juniorer och ungdomar

description: The Swedish Cross Country Championships are organised by Västerås FK and the Swedish Athletics Federation at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The course is 2 km long and consists mostly of grass, with some other surfaces, including fast-running grass and gravel paths. The competition includes several categories, including seniors, youth, masters and para-athletes, with individual races and team competitions. The event also offers the option of pre-booked lunch and good accommodation options close to the venue.
course_highlights: 2 km course consisting mostly of grass, with some other surfaces
Fast-running grass and a 2–3-metre-wide gravel path, crossed four times per lap
Hay-bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected at the start/finish area at least 60 minutes before the start. Access to the start area opens 10 minutes before the start and closes 2 minutes before. Water is available at the lap point and finish, with Dextrosol at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at Expandia Arena. Free parking and local buses are available. Clubs may set up their own tents in the designated area. Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels near the venue. Doping tests may be conducted during the competition weekend. The 2026 event took place at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The organiser’s website states that Västerås FK handed over hosting duties for the 2027 Swedish Cross Country Championships to Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes allowed for each lap. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, and a headlamp is mandatory because almost the entire race takes place in the dark. All participants who complete at least one lap receive a beautiful wooden medal, and the winners receive unique winner’s medals.
course_highlights: 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Running direction changes after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflective markers and trail tape; the surface is mostly trails, with approximately 700 metres of gravel
additional: Energy is served during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), along with sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are very limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and approximately 25 sq m of covered shelter. Toilets are outdoors in the forest. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and anyone who completes a lap faster can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. A headlamp and mobile phone are listed as mandatory equipment. The race website lists 70 places.

name: Halloween Night Trail
location: Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, Ronneby, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting trail race in the dark in the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby, with distances of 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The race offers a unique Halloween atmosphere, with themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave along the course. The venue is at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, where the finish is indoors. After the race, grilled hamburgers and drinks are served and included in the entry fee. The race is organised by Ronneby Orienteering Club, which has extensive experience organising major orienteering competitions.
course_highlights: Run along small trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Themed features such as Zombie Hill, the Cemetery, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors at Karlsnäs outdoor recreation centre
additional: Electronic timing for 5 km and 10 km; no timing for 2 km. Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from 17:00 at the venue. Freshly grilled hamburgers and drinks are served after the race and are included in the entry fee. The prize-giving is provisionally scheduled for 20:45. Shoes with good grip and a headlamp are recommended. Parents may run with children in the 2 km race without registering. A specially designed medal is given to all participants. The entry fee includes a hamburger and a drink. Electronic timing is available for the 5 km and 10 km distances, but not the 2 km. The finish area is indoors.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Rumšiškėse, Lietuvos etnografinio muziejaus teritorijoje. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo 300 m iki pusmaratonio 21,098 km, kuris yra pagrindinis etapas ir įtrauktas į Lietuvos bėgimo taurės įskaitą. Dalyviai startuoja pagal amžiaus grupių handicap taisykles, o renginio programa apima registraciją, startus skirtingoms distancijoms ir apdovanojimus. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką gamtoje ir varžytis su bėgimo entuziastais iš visos Lietuvos.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 300 m vaikų bėgimo iki 21,098 km pusmaratonio
Startai pagal amžiaus grupių handicap taisykles
Vieta - Lietuvos etnografinis muziejus Rumšiškėse
additional: Renginio programa: 09:00 registracija ir numerių išdavimas, 10:45 varžybų atidarymas, startai nuo 11:00 iki 13:00 skirtingoms distancijoms, apdovanojimai nuo 14:00. Pagrindinė distancija - 21,098 km, sudaryta iš 4 ratų. Amžiaus grupių handicap sistema leidžia silpnesniems dalyviams startuoti anksčiau. Renginio vieta Rumšiškės, galimybė registruotis internetu, renginio programa apima startus, apdovanojimus ir specialias grupes.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the season-ending race and final event in the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. It takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu beach area, offering natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city, including the seaside promenade. The event is suitable for recreational and experienced runners alike and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances, available for running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles
Course through Pärnu’s beach area, with beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks
Seaside promenade with views of the sea
additional: The distance options are 5 km and 10 km, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. Children’s races and virtual race distances are also planned. The event includes virtual races and children’s races and takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering a chance to enjoy sport and nature together.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a long-running running race celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. The race is organized by Boxholm-Ekeby Ski Club and takes place at Boxholm ski stadium. It is a popular event for runners of all ages and abilities, with a scenic and challenging course. More information and registration will be available closer to race day.
course_highlights: Scenic route around the Sjögarp area
Challenging 14 km course with a course profile available
The race takes place at Boxholm ski stadium
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. Links to the invitation, race information, start list and preliminary results from previous years are available. A course profile and map are available for runners. The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The gathering is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Castle Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around the historic Löfstad Castle. The race offers a unique running experience as participants run through the castle park, along forest trails and over unmarked terrain lit by headlamps. The event consists of two races: the Little Twilight Race for children in the park and Löfstad’s Darkest, a 7-kilometre night race for adults. Löfstad Castle Trail combines nature, history and community in a beautiful and challenging setting.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and course tape
Little Twilight Race: 1,000 metres in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 at the castle courtyard. Löfstad’s Darkest starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp and trail shoes. The Little Twilight Race is a children’s race with no timing, and all participants receive a prize. The joint awards ceremony takes place after the races. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle. A headlamp is mandatory for the 7 km race, and trail shoes are recommended. The children’s race is untimed. The start and finish are at Löfstad Castle.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Paradiset Nature Reserve in Huddinge. The race offers a unique terrain experience, with scenic views and technical trails that test both endurance and mental strength. It is a well-regarded event for experienced ultrarunners seeking a long-distance challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Running in Paradiset Nature Reserve with varied terrain
Technical trails and scenic views
A challenging 100-mile distance
additional: The race also offers 100 km and 65 km distances. According to the available race information, drop bags and toilets are available, along with water, tea, coffee and broth at Torpet Paradiset.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: Pohjoisbaanan Mile 2026 is a traditional mile race held on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki, on October 31. The race gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. The event is organized by Helsingin Juoksijat ry, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-minded running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: Participation is free for members of Helsingin Juoksijat ry. The start location is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about specific course features or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a variety of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: Panevėžio maratonas 2024 vyks Panevėžyje, Lietuvoje, ir registracija prasidės 2024 m. rugsėjo 13 d. Varžybose gali dalyvauti visi norintys, užsiregistravę ir pasitikrinę sveikatą. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš įvairių distancijų: 400 m ėjimas, 2,8 km, 5 km, 10 km, pusmaratonis ir maratonas, su skirtingais amžiaus reikalavimais.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Panevėžio maratone, džiaugdamasis pergale.

name: XVII-asis bėgimas „Varnutės ruduo“
description: Varnutės bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys Jonavoje, siūlantis trasas įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams. Renginyje yra trys distancijos: 2,5 km, 10 km ir 300 m vaikams, todėl jis pritaikytas tiek pradedantiesiems, tiek patyrusiems bėgikams. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką ir pasimėgauti bėgimu bendruomenės apsuptyje.
course_highlights: Trasa Jonavoje
Distancijos: 2,5 km, 10 km ir 300 m vaikams
Tinka įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams
additional: Renginio data - lapkričio 7 d., 2026 m., ir yra populiarus kasmetinis bėgimo renginys Jonavoje.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė 5 etapas
description: Rugpjūčio 21 d. vakarą Jonavos sporto centras kvietė bėgimo mėgėjus ir entuziastus į ketvirtąjį Jonavos bėgimo taurės etapą. Šį kartą dalyviams teko išbandyti paruoštą 7 km vaizdingą trasą Panoterių kaimelyje, kuri šį rugpjūtį buvo ypatinga dėl Panoterių mokyklos 115 metų sukakties ir 30-mečio, kuomet buvo pašventinta Šv. Kryžiaus Atradimo bažnyčia. Nors bėgikus lydėjo gausus lietus, tai nesutrukdė šventiškai bėgimo nuotaikai – apdovanojimai vyko pačioje Panoterių bažnyčioje.

Bėgikų grupė Jonavos bėgimo taurės varžybose, kelių lenktynės.

description: Bėgam už Kalvariją - bėgimas miesto gatvėmis, kuris vyksta Sodų g., Klimo g., Dariaus ir Girėno g. bei Laisvės g. Startas ir finišas yra prie Nepriklausomybės paminklo, Laisvės g.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo lenktynės Kalvarijoje žiemos metu. Bėgikai bėga snieguotu keliu.

Kalvarijos Nepriklausomybės paminklas, bėgimo starto ir finišo vieta.

name: Juozo Songailos Run
description: 2024 rugsėjo 15.!!! Pasižymėkite šią dieną kalendoriuje!!! Tai renginys, kai mes bėgimu pažymėsime žymiausio Ukmergės bėgiko Juozo Songailos ilgą sportinį kelią! Čia jūs galėsite pasirinkti distancijas: bėgimas - maratonas, pusmaratonis, 7 km, 3 km ir 400 m (vaikų bėgimas). Šiaurietiškas ėjimas - pusmaratonis ir 7 km. Kiekvienas dalyvis, įveikęs savo distanciją, pasipuoš nuostabiai puikiu vienetiniu medaliu!

images.alt_text: Juozo Songailos 70-mečio bėgimo renginio plakatas su bėgiku.
Du vyrai su medaliu Juozo Songailos bėgimo proga. Fone matomas renginio pavadinimas.
Bėgikas bėga per rūką, apšviestas mėlyna šviesa, atrodo kaip kliūčių ruožas.
Juozas Songaila su trofėjumi, bėgimo entuziastas ir sveikos gyvensenos propaguotojas.

name: Bėgimas Kaune
description: Kasmetinis rožinio kaspino paramos bėgimas skirtas krūties vėžio prevencijai Kaune. Tai neilga, mėgėjiška bei smagi bėgimo trasa, džiaugsminga ir pozityvi sporto šventė, papuošta rožiniais kostiumais, dažais, balionais ir kaspinais. PINK RUN metu tiek vyrai, tiek moterys gali išreikšti palaikymą ir meilę savo artimiausioms moterims: mamai, dukrai, seseriai, žmonai ar geriausiai draugei.

images.alt_text: Rožinis bėgimas Kaune: didelis žmonių būrys rožiniais marškinėliais, scena ir renginio atmosfera.
Rožinis kaspinas ant džinsinio audinio, simbolizuojantis kovą su krūties vėžiu.
Moteris su rožiniu megztiniu ir krepšiu su abstrakčiu piešiniu, skirtu krūties vėžio prevencijai.

name: Molėtai Bėga
description: Molėtų sporto centras kartu su Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija kviečia į tradicinį, ketvirtą kartą organizuojamą bėgimą „Molėtai bėga 2024“, kuris vyks 2024 m. spalio 20 d. Bėgimo distancijos apima 3 km (Mergaitės/Berniukai, 2006 m. g. ir jaunesni), 9 km (Moterys/Vyrai, 19-44 m. ir 45 m. ir vyresni) bei 400 m trasą, kurioje amžiaus ribojimo nėra. Šis renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus ir suteikia galimybę dalyvauti įvairiose amžiaus grupėse.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo apdovanojimų ceremonija: vyras su taure, ant kurios bėgikų siluetai.
Bėgimo varžybos mieste, matomos pro langą.

Tai didžiausias bėgimas Lietuvoje, sutraukiantis bėgimo profesionalus ir entuziastus iš visos šalies bei užsienio. Maratone dalyviai galės pasirinkti iš įvairių distancijų: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, bei 200 m vaikų bėgimo.

Rimi Vilniaus maratonas logo, 2024 rugsėjo 8 d.

description: VšĮ Nesustabdomas bėgimas (bėgimo klubas Volvere run) kartu su asociacija „Sporto renginiai“ 2025 m. rugsėjo 19 dieną, Vingio parko stadione rengia 60 m, 1000 m bei estafetinio bėgimo 5×1000 m varžybas. Tai puiki proga bėgimo entuziastams išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose distancijose ir mėgautis sporto dvasia.

Greičio Ratai 2022 afišas. Bėgikas su estafetės lazda.
Bėgikų grupė su vėliavomis, rodanti sporto renginį.

name: Bėgimas "Ateik ir Įveik!"
description: Bėgimas "Ateik ir Įveik" – tai nepamirštamas renginys, kuriame iššūkių ir staigmenų netrūks, o ištvermingiausieji bus kviečiami pasileisti į kalnais ir pakalnėmis vingiuojančio Ažuolyno parko nuotyki! Nuo tikro išbandymo iki aktyvios pramogos – tarp skirtingų distancijų trasų bei įvairių kliūčių ruožų sau tinkamą atras kiekvienas – ir aštrių pojūčių mėgėjas, ir aktyvaus poilsio entuziastas. Šiais metais bėgimas sulaukė rekordinio dalyvių skaičiaus ir buvo organizuojamas KTU Studentų miestelyje bei Ąžuolyno parke.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo "Ateik ir Įveik" renginio nuotrauka. Bėgikai starto linijoje.
Sportininkas su Lietuvos vėliava ant kliūčių ruožo.
Bėgiko nuotrauka su medaliu ir marškinėliais su užrašu "Ateik ir Įveik!"

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: ATSINAUJINĘS ir UNIKALUS REPREZENTACINIS ŠIAULIŲ BĖGIMAS 2024 vyks rugsėjo 22 d. 12 val. DIDYSIS STARTAS. Projekto pagrindinis tikslas – populiarinti fizinį aktyvumą ir sportą, formuojant aktyvų ir kokybišką laisvalaikį, puoselėjant bendruomeniškumą bei sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Bėgimas vyks centrinėmis miesto gatvėmis pro įžymias Šiaulių miesto istorijai vietas, skirtas įvairaus amžiaus žmonėms, mėgėjams ir profesionalams. Programoje: vaikų bėgimas 700 m, „Saulės mūšio“ datos atminimui 1236 m bėgimas, 5 km ir 10 km bėgimai.

images.alt_text: Šiaulių Bėgimas '25 miesto centre. Bėgikai prie starto/finiso linijos.

Registracija vyks tik numerių išdavime, o starto linija bus prie kavinės „Sakutis“.

name: Swampman Backyard Ultra
description: Swampman Backyard Ultra yra ultramaratono varžybos, kuriose dalyviai turi nuosekliai bėgti 6706 metrų (4.167 mylios) atstumą per mažiau nei vieną valandą. Po kiekvieno rato, likusį laiką galima skirti poilsiui ir maistui. Kiekvieną valandą vėl stovėsite prie starto linijos ir bėgsite dar vieną ratą, kol liks tik vienas bėgikas. Lietuvos rekordas yra 22 ratai, o pasaulio rekordas - 108 ratai.

images.alt_text: Backyard Ultra lenktynių logotipas ir trasa.

description: PINK RUN su Antėja – tai kasmetinis rožinio kaspino paramos bėgimas, skirtas kovai su krūties vėžiu bei šios ligos prevencijai. Prisijunkite prie mūsų renginio Kauno širdyje – Laisvės alėjoje – ir bėkite už tas, kurias mylite. Palaikykite kovą su krūties vėžiu dalyvaudami įvairaus nuotolio bėgimuose tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams. Pink Run su Antėja – ne tik bėgimas, tai žinutė, jog mes mylime jas.

name: Vilniaus Kroso Pirmenybė
description: Atviros Vilniaus rajono kroso pirmenybės vyko lapkričio 14 dieną Nemenčinėje, biatlono šaudykloje, organizuojamos Vilniaus rajono savivaldybės Kultūros, sporto ir turizmo skyriaus kartu su Vilniaus rajono savivaldybės sporto mokykla. Varžybose dalyvavo sportininkai iš įvairių Lietuvos rajonų, o jauniausi dalyviai varžėsi 150 m „Olimpinių vilčių“ bėgime. Po finišo vaikai buvo apdovanoti medaliais, o geriausiems įteiktos taurės. Varžybos vyko skirtingose amžiaus grupėse, kur dalyviai turėjo įveikti distancijas nuo 150 m iki 5000 m.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė Krosas
description: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024“ vyks Klaipėdoje, 2024 metų spalio 12 dieną. Bėgimo dalyviai gali pasirinkti 8 km nuotolio distanciją, kurios startas 13:10 val. vyks nuo Girulių televizijos bokšto. Trasa pažymėta dviračių takeliu, o ties Vasaros koncertų estrada bėgikai įsuks į Liepoj.

Varžybos apima 3 jūrmylės (5,55 km – vienas ratas) moterims ir jaunuolėms bei 6 jūrmylės (11,11 km – du ratai) vyrams ir jaunuoliams.

Gintarinė jūrmylė Klaipėda bėgimo varžybų logotipas su bėgančiais žmonėmis.

name: Vilnius 700 Ultra
description: Bėgimas „Vilnius 700 Ultra“ 2024 m. spalio 12 dieną vyks Vingio parke. Renginio partneriai – Amatininkų klubas „Dvaro meistrai“. name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race among the beautiful hiking trails and forests of Vooremäe in Tartu County. The race highlights challenges such as 1,000 metres of elevation gain in a single run, giving participants the chance to test their abilities and enjoy the positive energy of running on forest trails. The race centre is next to the new service building, with convenient shower facilities and a place to change clothes. There is a staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses a contactless SPORTIdent system. Distances range from a 14 km hike to a marathon of over 42 km, with marathon runners completing exactly three 14.1 km laps.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km lap following the direction of travel on Vooremäe’s large loop
More than 1,000 metres of total elevation gain on the marathon distance
A staffed aid station on the course, passed multiple times
additional: Race numbers can be found before the event in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system, with the chip attached to the wrist. Participants can shower and change clothes at the race centre after the event. There is one staffed aid station on the course, offering water, Coca-Cola and light snacks. On-site registration is not available. Transfers and other changes can be made only by email. Trail running, hilly terrain, registration via Stebby, aid stations, finisher medals, awards ceremony

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

Mostly hard-surfaced, with arrows marking the route on the asphalt

additional: Registration is online at timesport.ee until 24 September, and on race day in front of Võhma School from 10:00 to 11:40. Participants receive medals, and prizes are raffled. Competitors are responsible for their own health. Children may take part in the race under their parent’s responsibility. Registration is available both online and on site, and participants receive prizes and medals. The route runs along the town’s streets and asphalt, offering a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event takes place on 26 September 2026.

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!

name: I Bieg NIEUCHWYTNI – Bieg Charytatywny dla Fundacji Podkarpackie Hospicjum dla Dzieci
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Szlachta Biega, Klub Sportowy Ultra Sp. z.o.o. oraz MOSiR Łańcut.
description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

description:

The race will follow the familiar loop through Kurnos Drugi and Kurnos Pierwszy, starting and finishing at the Alfons Brandt Primary School.

description:
1st Apple Blossom Run - Jabłonna Lacka | 5 km

We invite you to the 1st Apple Blossom Run, taking place on October 10, 2026, in Jabłonna Lacka. This is the first edition of an event that aims to bring together sporting competition, activities for the whole family, and local culture and tradition.

The main event will be a 5 km run, starting at 12:45. The course runs through the streets of Jabłonna Lacka and features varied surfaces, consisting mainly of paved roads and a section of unpaved road. The time limit is 45 minutes.

The Main Run is open to anyone who will be at least 16 years old on race day. The entry fee is PLN 40. The participant package includes a race bib with a chip for electronic timekeeping, a commemorative finisher’s medal, water, and a hot recovery meal.

The 5 km race will feature overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories. There will also be a special classification for the fastest female and male residents of the Municipality of Jabłonna Lacka.

But the 1st Apple Blossom Run is about more than just 5 km. Free races for children and young people aged 4–15 will also take place from 10:15, over distances of approximately 150 m, 400 m, 600 m, and 1,100 m. Every child who completes their race will receive a finisher’s medal, and categories D2–D4 will feature electronic timekeeping and separate girls’ and boys’ classifications.

At the Race Village, sport will meet culture, with a Literary and Educational Zone accompanying the event.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.

Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Welcome to the 57th Jätten Bule Run on 31 October 2026 at Bulevallen in Österbymo. The race offers an enchanting forest setting, with trails and gravel roads winding through the area. There are recreational race classes for 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km, where everyone can enjoy a challenging run surrounded by beautiful scenery. IFK Österbymo warmly welcomes all runners to a well-organised event with timing and excellent service.
course_highlights: The 10 km course runs along floodlit trails, forest paths and gravel roads across hilly terrain
The final 4 km take you through an enchanting forest on winding trails with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, marked in blue, while the 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at the IFK Österbymo clubhouse by the start area. Timing is chip-based. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area. Payment by Swish or cash. Bulis will lead a warm-up at approximately 10:00 before the children’s race starts. Start and finish at Bulevallen, Idrottsvägen, Österbymo.

name: Höstmilen
description: Höstmilen is a trail race in the Kolmården forests outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on 1 November 2026. The course follows trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic, challenging terrain for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The event is organised by OK Kolmården and has three main race options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, and races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running through the scenic, hilly terrain of the Kolmården forests
additional: Online registration closes on 29 October at 23:00; after that, it is possible to register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus runs from Jurslaskolan to the start at Sörsjön. The race information sheet will be published approximately one week before the event. The adult races have just two prize categories: Men and Women. A complete list of registered participants will be published on the “Registered” page. Distances and competition formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team, company and school competitions. The Höstmilen race information sheet and registration are available via hostmilen.nu.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was founded in 2015 and can be described as a recreational race where nature, camaraderie and the experience take centre stage, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers all runners, regardless of ability, a fantastic opportunity to take part in one of three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail) and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has 500 metres of elevation gain.

name: Uddloppet
description:
Uddloppet is a spring race in Karlshamn, Blekinge, for both recreational and elite runners. It’s a perfect start to the running season and a great way to check your fitness after winter training.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Distances:
4 km (09:45)
10 km (11:00)
Half marathon (11:00)
Children’s race, 400 m (10:30)
Walking class, 2.5 km (between 09:00 and 13:00)

Course: A scenic, gently hilly route along the sea and through the forest east of Karlshamn. Start and finish at Vägga sports ground.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Practical information: Parking at Vägga IP; changing facilities and showers at Väggahallen. Race numbers can be collected at Intersport in Karlshamn from Wednesday to Saturday, or at the race-day secretariat.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

The event also offers activities for the whole family, including a mascot, prize-giving, face painting and refreshments on site.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km loop with 400 m of elevation gain. After five loops, you’ll have covered the ultra distance of 50 km and 2,000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail running on singletrack and animal trails through dramatic forest! Welcome!
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories
Isaberg Gravel: a circuit of approximately 45 km, starting and finishing in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to age 50: 3 laps, older riders/sport recreation: 2 laps, recreational: 1 lap
additional: Contact GI by mobile at +46 703 815 118 or email at gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Guided rides for cycling groups can be booked; the organisers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group’s needs. Main distance: approximately 10.5 km (Distans Trailtour); Kids Trail: approximately 2 km with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain; start time: Sunday at 12:00; location: Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact: niklas@isabergtrail.se.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organising an evening race for the 53rd time during Hörby Market, with three different distances:

Marknadsloppet 12.6 km: the competitive class starts at 18:30, and the recreational class starts at 18:40.

Bil-Månsson loppet 6.1 km: everyone starts at 18:50.

CAN-CAN loppet 3.4 km: everyone starts at 19:00.

The race starts and finishes in central Hörby, with much of the route running through woodland.
Varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and trails. See maps.

Don't miss this opportunity!
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu — right up until the race starts.

Late registration is available at the entrance to Lågehallarna (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners is available at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Signposting from National Road 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information about preparations, registration, the course and directions is available at the link:
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is the most generous race of the year, where the joy of running meets the beautiful scenery of Djurgården. The course winds along gravel and asphalt roads, offering a wonderful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 people to register will receive a specially designed T-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, a relaxing After Run awaits with a barbecue and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. A portion of the registration fee also goes to Sweden for UNHCR, so every step counts—for you and for someone in need.

name: Altorp Ultra
description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop – “Långa gula”.
~120m of elevation per loop.
May 10 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
Run as many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, your friends and family.

Skogsstig med solljus som strilar ner genom träden.
En skogsstig med en gul markör på ett träd, perfekt för terränglöpning.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!
