name: Stora Sköndalsvarvet
description: A beautiful 5-kilometre course (5,100 metres) on roads and trails, starting at Stora Sköndal, passing through the Orhem allotment area and Flatens Nature Reserve. Hilly in places.
additional: Bag drop and race bib collection from 16:30; warm-up at 17:15. No start waves.

images.alt_text: Luftfoto över Stora Sköndal med texten "Stora Sköndalsvarvet"

name: Hiit Out - Trailrun 2026
description:
Welcome to HIIT OUT – Trailrun – a trail race with challenging running and a wonderful experience in nature!

Choose from four distances: 4 km, 8 km, 12 km or 16 km.

The course takes you through varied terrain, with trails, plenty of elevation gain and sections where you can expect your shoes to get a little wet. It’s not just about the kilometres—the terrain will bring both challenges and running joy along the way.

Four distances. Plenty of trails. Lots of elevation gain. Slightly wet shoes. Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part!

Choose your distance and Hiit Out!

Start times 3/10:
10:30 – 16 km
10:45 – 12 km
11:00 – 8 km
11:15 – 4 km

name: UppLoppet
description: On 6 June 2026, we invite you to UppLoppet—a wonderful running event with 3 km and 10 km distances, filled with the joy of running, community and a festive atmosphere. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best, want to run at a relaxed pace or simply enjoy the atmosphere, UppLoppet is for you. In addition to the race, we’re offering several enjoyable activities for both participants and spectators. Welcome to celebrate movement, health and community with us on National Day!

images.alt_text: Löpare med svenska flaggor springer, UppLoppet 3 km & 10 km, 6 juni.

name: Holje Marknadsloppet
description: The race takes place mainly on pedestrian and cycle paths and trails, with gentle hills.
additional: The race is held in conjunction with Holje Market. The start and finish are at the southern end of the market grounds. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Dannfältshallen. There are also distances for children and young people.

name: Vängeloppet
description: Family-friendly

name: Burlövsloppet
organizer: Arlövs boll- och idrottsförening samt Burlövs kommun
description:
For the fifth year in a row, Burlövsloppet will be held on September 5 in conjunction with Burlövsfesten, right in the center of Burlöv! Anyone can take part, regardless of age, ability, or pace—movement, community, and joy are at the heart of it.

Lilla Burlövsloppet is free; the other races cost SEK 200–250.

name: Vretaloppet
description:
Vreta SoMK welcomes you to a cross-country race in the Olstorp terrain!

Gather your friends, colleagues and teammates, and come to Olstorp. There are races for everyone, big and small.

name: VAIS-loppet
description:
The VAIS race is organised by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn.

The race follows a hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd Nature Reserve, and you can choose between two distances: 4.4 kilometres and 8.4 kilometres.

Both courses start together at 18:30 by the VAIS cabin. After the races, we round things off with coffee and refreshments.
additional: The race is free for members of Växjö AIS. For non-members, the entry fee is 50 kronor.

name: Göinge Spring
description: We invite you to a day dedicated to running and health. Run a half marathon or 10K on an easy-to-run asphalt course, try a 12 km trail race or a shorter 4 km cross-country race. There will be fast, enjoyable courses in wonderful surroundings. If you enjoy being active, mark September 19 in your calendar and make your way to the heart of Göinge, Hässleholm.
additional: https://hassleholmfreeflow.se

name: GUM - Gotland Ultramarathon
description:
One of Sweden’s most beautiful ultramarathons. The race starts at 9:00 at Hallshuk in northern Gotland, and the course heads south along the coast, with the sea on your right all the way to Visby. The route is approximately 50 km, with very varied terrain.

There is also a Half-GUM (28 km), starting at 11:00 in Lickershamn.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km loop through varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class. The 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat, fast course through the heart of the city and along the beautiful shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is a loop course, with 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organised race for all levels.

The race is for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and generous time limits will be set for completing the race.

A warm welcome!

name: Oskarshamn backyard 6h 2026
description:
A Backyard race lasting under 6 hours.

One 6.7 km lap every hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one 8.7 km lap. 42.195 km in total. If you complete the race, you will have covered a marathon! The first to finish the final lap wins.


Registration: https://raceid.com/sv/races/15069/about

name: Uppsala Marathon
description:
UPPSALA MARATHON
17 OCTOBER 2026
Through centuries of history – one step at a time
MARATHON • HALF MARATHON • MARATHON RELAY
Celebrate 10 years with us!
Challenge yourself and experience one of Sweden’s most popular races in beautiful autumnal Uppsala. Run the marathon or half marathon, or gather family, friends or colleagues and take part in the marathon relay.
Uppsala Marathon is turning 10!
Over 42,195 metres, the course takes you through some of Uppsala’s most historic, scenic and remarkable surroundings. From the castle and Carolina Hill to the River Fyris, the city centre and leafy green spaces – a unique combination of running, history, culture and a festive atmosphere.
Whether you’re an experienced marathon runner or taking part for the first time, you’re warmly welcome to help write the next chapter in the race’s history.
All participants are invited to enjoy a post-run gathering, and all finishers receive a technical T-shirt and this year’s exclusive 10th-anniversary medal.
More information and registration:
https://www.uppsalamarathon.se/

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course with no hills, offering the chance to achieve good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025! The event is organized in collaboration by Runner's High and FC POHU. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, and the start is at Lassila Sports Park (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to follow the sold-out event at Nummelanharju! The event takes place on October 11, 2025, starting at 10:00 at Nummelanharju in Vihti. This is a Silver competition, whose winner earns a direct spot in the 2026 Satellite World Championships. The winner receives a €500 cash prize, and second place receives €300. All participants will receive a NUBU sauna bench towel and a wooden participation medal.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Hercules Trail Run, held for the ninth time, invites runners to Porvoo’s stunning trails! The day begins with the children’s Polkuralli, where those born in 2013–2025 can run a 2 km route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Mustijoki River. One hour later, the 7 km, 14 km and 21 km races start in staggered waves. The route is designed for runners and outdoor enthusiasts of all levels, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Porvoo’s finest trails on the second Saturday of October.

Lasten juoksukilpailun lähtöviivalla, ilmapallukoristeet ja luonto taustalla.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 100 km, Maraton, 30 km, Puolimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Tour 2023 is starting! Sign up for the Vantaa Endurance Tour, where you’ll challenge yourself in five different sports. The tour is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. In 2023, one registration gives you access to five endurance events in Vantaa, allowing you to focus on training instead of searching for races.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: The Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be run or walked on 4 September 2026 in Kalkkiranta, Sipoo. Participants can choose between two distances: 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The revamped event also features new categories and a new start location, bringing participants new challenges and experiences.

Nevas Night Run logo, jossa juoksijoita ja tähtiä pimeässä.

name: Nuuksio Classic Trail
description: Nuuksio Classic is one of Finland’s most iconic trail-running events, offering a unique running experience amid stunning scenery. The race takes place in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, including 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy superb courses, wild forest, and excellent organization. Join us on September 5, 2026!

images.alt_text: Maastojuoksija Nuuksion poluilla järven äärellä, aurinkoisena päivänä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, 13 September 2025, with 5 km and 21.1 km distances. Registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up here! The start for both distances is a few minutes’ walk from Eläintarha Sports Field, on Hammarskjöldintie. The courses have been officially measured in accordance with WA standards.

images.alt_text: Nainen juoksee hämärän aikaan. Hyvä kuva juoksusta.

name: Kaljamaili SM-kisa
description: Peräkylän Ponnistus is hosting the Finnish Beer Mile Championships on Friday, 26.08 at 18:00 at the main track of Pirkkola Sports Park. The rules are simple: run a mile, or just over four laps of the track, and drink one beer before the start of each lap. The fastest to the finish wins. There are two categories: Beer (Official) and Non-alcoholic beer, and both are unisex. The world record under international rules is 4:33.6.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä yleisurheiluradalla, yksi heistä viittoo.

name: Visahölkkä
description: Visahölkkä is a traditional running event held in the rural surroundings of Ojakkala on the first Sunday in October. The first Visahölkkä was held in autumn 2007, and participation has settled at between 30 and 50 runners. The event offers several different distances suitable for runners of all ages and abilities, and it is part of the Vihdin Hölkkäkunkkusarja series.

images.alt_text: Visahölkkä-juoksukilpailun kuva. Kaksi juoksijaa juoksee maastossa.

name: Gennarbyviken Runt
description: Gennarbyviken Runt is a great gravel-road route that loops around Gennarbyviken. This year, a half marathon was held for the first time, and the Kero brothers ran the race at a fast pace. Jaakko Kero won in 1:13:42. There were 64 participants in total, fewer than the previous year. Gennarbyviken Runt has been a popular event for over 60 years.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Gennarbyviken Runt -kilpailussa juoksee soratiellä, numero 115.

name: Velo Salo Backyard Ultra
description: The Velo Salo Backyard Ultra course is mostly forest road, but also includes a more challenging section of trail of about 250 metres and an easier gravel/asphalt section of about 400 metres. The course is run clockwise and is 6.7 km long, with each new lap starting on the hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, but unfortunately the organizers will have to end the race after 36 laps if no winner has emerged after just over 240 km of running.

name: Ruissalojuoksut
description: Experience beautiful nature and fresh autumn air at Ruissalo Runs on September 19. Ruissalo Runs is a popular running event held amid the beautiful scenery of Ruissalo Island. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in races of various distances, including a half marathon and a 10-kilometer run. The route passes through scenic surroundings known for their diverse landscapes. The event attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes, and is an excellent opportunity to enjoy running and nature.

images.alt_text: Ruissalojuoksujen kartta: lähtö, maali, pysäköinti ja muut tärkeät kohdat.

name: Espoo Rantamaraton
description: Welcome to run the Espoo Rantamaraton along beautiful routes on the coast of the city of Espoo. On Saturday, September 20, you can take part in the marathon (42.195 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10K (10 km), 5K (5 km timed run), Aalto Walk (5 km untimed walk/run), or the children’s run (1K/600 m).

name: Nuuksio Night Trail
description: Petzl Nuuksio Night Trail 2026 will take place on 25.9.2026! The event center is at Luukki Outdoor Lodge, Luukintie 33 (next to Luukki Manor). The route is approximately 13 kilometers long and runs alongside Nuuksio National Park. All runners must have a headlamp, as the event takes place in a dark forest. The organizer does not rent out headlamps during the event.

images.alt_text: Puinen silta Nuuksion metsässä. Sopii yöjuoksun tunnelmaan.
Nuuksion metsässä oleva puinen polku, sopii yöjuoksutapahtumaan.
Nuuksion Night Trailin reittikartta ja logo. 13km yöpolkujuoksu.

name: Pääkaupunkijuoksu
description: The legendary Pääkaupunkijuoksu will be held in Helsinki’s Central Park on Sunday, 27 September 2026, for the 51st time. The event hub is at the beautifully renovated Pirkkola Sports Park, promising an even more functional and lively event area! The race distances are the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, and walkers can take part in the 7 km Kunnon Kävely, with no timing. The event offers participants unique experiences in pristine Finnish nature in the beautiful Central Park.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat Pääkaupunkijuoksussa, jossa näkyy kilpailun nimi ja päivämäärä.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 100 km, Maraton, 30 km, Puolimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Series gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in five different events. The series is designed for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. With a single registration for the 2023 Vantaa Endurance Series, you can take part in five endurance events in Vantaa, covering skiing, running, cycling, swimming and orienteering.

images.alt_text: Hiihtäjä Vantaan kestävyyskierroksen reitillä.  Aurinkoinen päivä, hyvin hoidettu latu.
Vantaan kestävyyskierros hiihtokilpailu. Kolme hiihtäjää ladulla.
Vantaan Kestävyyskierros -logo. Sininen ja keltainen grafiikka.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori offers beautiful gravel roads in the Uusimaa archipelago, west of Helsinki. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Distances and categories include 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km routes, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The peaceful gravel roads wind through picturesque scenery, with plenty of stopping places along the coast.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: The Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, 3 October 2026, in the city of Hanko. Distance options are the marathon, half marathon and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. Finishes after these limits will be considered disqualified. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2.

name: Vantaan Maraton
description: The Vantaa Marathon is one of Finland’s largest and fastest marathons. Join us to challenge your personal records or simply for the joy of running! The Vantaa Marathon takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, with Tikkurila Sports Park serving as the event hub.

name: Paraisten lenkki
description: The Parainen Run will be held for the 50th time this year. Anyone can take part, whether they run to win or for exercise. The event offers everyone the chance to enjoy running, whatever their level.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held in the Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti area. Several different distances are offered, including a 10 km competitive race for men and women and a 5 km recreational run. The event offers a 10-kilometre distance for different age groups and attracts runners from across Finland. It is known for its good organisation and high standard of competition.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu ilmoitus: juoksutapahtuma, tiedot, reitit
Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu mainos, jossa juoksijoita ja tietoa kilpailusta.

name: Lokakuun Kymppi
description: Lokakuun Kymppi is a traditional running event held in Tolkkinen amid beautiful autumn scenery. This year, a large field took part: a total of 223 recreational runners and 60 competitors completed the officially measured course. Eero Saleva won the men’s race, while Sara Kuivisto was the fastest in the women’s race. The route is mainly on asphalt and offers stunning scenery and an encouraging atmosphere.

images.alt_text: Kaksi juoksijaa kilpailussa juoksevat kohti maalia aurinkoisessa säässä.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025 in Helsinki! The event is organized jointly by Runner's High and FC POHU, with 5 km and 10 km race distances. The event features a mass start, making it a great opportunity for running enthusiasts.

images.alt_text: Haaga Run -juoksun voittajat, iloisia ja medaljit kaulassa.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailuun osallistujia. Lapsi juoksee iloisesti.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailun kuva, jossa juoksijat juoksevat maastossa.

name: NUTS HEL
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event in Helsinki's Central Park, with three different distances: 6 km, 14 km and 25 km. The event is suitable for both first-timers and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Eläintarha Sports Field, and the longest route takes runners along the trails of the Haltiala Forest Nature Reserve. On Friday evening, NUTS Kids & Juniors is also held for the family's youngest trail runners!

images.alt_text: NUTS HEL -polkujuoksun maaliintulo. Juoksijat lähestyvät voittoa.
Eläintarhan urheilukenttä, NUTS HEL -kisan lähtö- ja maalipaikka.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultrarunning race held on Nummelanharju. The race ends when only one runner remains. The race is run on the orange daytime course, which is 6.7 km long, and the blue night loop, which consists of two 3.35 km laps.

images.alt_text: Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun tunnelmaa. Juoksijat lähellä maalia.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva sateisessa säässä. Juoksijat juoksevat maantietä.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Oranssi ja sininen lenkki näkyvät.

name: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu
description: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu is a traditional running event held at Mika Waltari School in Pornainen. The event gives participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful natural surroundings, and the route is designed to offer a suitable challenge. Last year, 73 people took part, and more than 100 runners are expected this year across the different categories, which include distances of 14.3 km, 6.8 km, and 2.2 km.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

images.alt_text: Solvalla Trailin reittikartta Nuuksiossa.  Reitti näkyy kartalla sinisenä.
Solvalla Trailin reitti kartalla. Vanha reittikuva.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

images.alt_text: Kartta Pukinmäki Run -reitistä, jossa näkyy reitti ja maamerkit.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

images.alt_text: Laavu lumisessa metsässä, osa Lepokallion lenkki -polkujuoksureittiä.

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva urheilukeskuksesta, mahdollisesti Tuusula Trailrunin lähtöpaikka.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which is being held for the 47th time this year. Hiidenhölkkä–Nummelan Tarmo. The 10 km and 20 km (2 x 10 km) Hiidenhölkkä routes circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00, and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

images.alt_text: Suunnistuskilpailu Vantaan kestävyyskierroksella. Monet osallistujat juoksevat maastossa.
Vantaan ratikkareitti kartalla.  Reitti kulkee lentokentältä Länsimäkeen.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

images.alt_text: Riston Hölkkä - osallistujia, juoksijoita hymyillen ja kädet ylhäällä.
Riston Hölkkä - juoksija juoksee kilpailussa, kilpailunumero 89.
Riston Hölkkä -juoksija juoksee hiekkatiellä, numero 91 rinnassa.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held on 06.10.2024 from 11:00 to 13:00. The event takes place at Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Pahkalaukkaantie 58, Ilmarinen, Lieto. It is organized by Liedon Luja, TUL V-S.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Lieto, Suomi. Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu tapahtumapaikka.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

description: Alminding Run is the year's running festival and Bornholm's traditional recreational event, taking place on Saturday, September 20, 2025, at 14:00
